<script>
// Loading Screen
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('loadingScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  }, 1500);
});

// Particle System
const canvas = document.getElementById('particleCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resizeCanvas() {
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resizeCanvas();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

class Particle {
  constructor() {
    this.reset();
  }
  
  reset() {
    this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
    this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
    this.size = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1;
    this.color = ['#ffd700', '#ff6b9d', '#c44dff', '#4dc9ff', '#4dff88'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)];
    this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    this.pulseSpeed = Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01;
  }
  
  update() {
    this.x += this.speedX;
    this.y += this.speedY;
    this.pulse += this.pulseSpeed;
    this.opacity = 0.1 + Math.sin(this.pulse) * 0.2;
    
    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width || this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) {
      this.reset();
    }
  }
  
  draw() {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    
    // Glow effect
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity * 0.3;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

const particles = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
  particles.push(new Particle());
}

function animateParticles() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.update();
    p.draw();
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
}
animateParticles();

// Floating Coins
const coinsContainer = document.getElementById('floatingCoins');
const coinEmojis = ['🪙', '✨', '💎', '⭐', '🌟'];

function createCoin() {
  const coin = document.createElement('div');
  coin.className = 'coin';
  coin.textContent = coinEmojis[Math.floor(Math.random() * coinEmojis.length)];
  coin.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
  coin.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 10 + 10) + 's';
  coin.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 5 + 's';
  coin.style.fontSize = (Math.random() * 1 + 0.8) + 'rem';
  coinsContainer.appendChild(coin);
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    coin.remove();
  }, 20000);
}

setInterval(createCoin, 2000);
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  setTimeout(createCoin, i * 500);
}

// Scroll Animations
const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');

const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
    }
  });
}, {
  threshold: 0.1,
  rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
});

fadeElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

// Sparkle Effect on Click
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const sparkle = document.createElement('div');
    sparkle.className = 'sparkle';
    sparkle.style.left = (e.clientX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30) + 'px';
    sparkle.style.top = (e.clientY + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30) + 'px';
    sparkle.style.background = ['#ffd700', '#ff6b9d', '#c44dff', '#4dc9ff'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
    document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
    
    setTimeout(() => sparkle.remove(), 1000);
  }
});

// Smooth scroll for anchor links
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
  anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
    if (target) {
      target.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: 'smooth',
        block: 'start'
      });
    }
  });
});

// Parallax effect on hero orbs
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
  const orbs = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-orb');
  orbs.forEach((orb, index) => {
    const speed = (index + 1) * 0.1;
    orb.style.transform = `translateY(${scrolled * speed}px)`;
  });
});

// Shop button interactions
document.querySelectorAll('.shop-item-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const originalText = this.textContent;
    this.textContent = '✓ Added!';
    this.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #4dff88, #4dc9ff)';
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.textContent = originalText;
      this.style.background = '';
    }, 2000);
  });
});

// Character card hover sound effect (visual feedback)
document.querySelectorAll('.character-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
    this.style.transition = 'all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)';
  });
});

// Mode card tilt effect
document.querySelectorAll('.mode-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
    const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;
    const rotateX = (y - centerY) / 20;
    const rotateY = (centerX - x) / 20;
    
    this.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-10px) scale(1.02)`;
  });
  
  card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
    this.style.transform = '';
  });
});

// Dynamic title animation
const title = document.querySelector('.game-title');
const titles = ['Echoes of Lumora', 'Whimsical Realms', 'Dream Weaver', 'Crystal Knight', 'Shadow Bunny'];
let titleIndex = 0;

setInterval(() => {
  titleIndex = (titleIndex + 1) % titles.length;
  title.style.opacity = '0';
  title.style.transform = 'translateY(-20px)';
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    title.textContent = titles[titleIndex];
    title.style.opacity = '1';
    title.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
  }, 500);
}, 4000);

title.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease';

// Console Easter Egg
console.log('%c✨ Echoes of Lumora: Whimsical Realms ✨', 'font-size: 20px; color: #ffd700; font-weight: bold;');
console.log('%cWelcome, Dreamweaver! 🌟', 'font-size: 14px; color: #c44dff;');
</script>
</body>
</html>

html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>L'apprentissage du français en milieu rural</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #2d5016;
            --primary-light: #4a7c28;
            --primary-dark: #1a3009;
            --accent: #c9a84c;
            --accent-light: #e8c96a;
            --bg-cream: #f5f0e8;
            --bg-warm: #faf7f2;
            --text-dark: #2c2c2c;
            --text-medium: #555;
            --text-light: #888;
            --white: #ffffff;
            --shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
            --shadow-sm: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-cream);
            overflow: hidden;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 100vw;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .presentation {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .slide {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            transform: translateX(100px) scale(0.95);
            padding: 40px;
        }

        .slide.active {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
            transform: translateX(0) scale(1);
        }

        .slide.prev {
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transform: translateX(-100px) scale(0.95);
        }

        .slide-content {
            max-width: 1200px;
            width: 100%;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 1: TITLE ===== */
        .slide-title {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3009 0%, #2d5016 30%, #4a7c28 70%, #6b9b3a 100%);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .slide-title::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            right: -20%;
            width: 800px;
            height: 800px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,168,76,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .slide-title::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -30%;
            left: -10%;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .title-decoration {
            position: absolute;
            top: 40px;
            left: 40px;
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            border: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .title-decoration::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-light);
            border-radius: 50%;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .title-content {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--white);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .title-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
            border: 1px solid var(--accent);
            color: var(--accent-light);
            padding: 8px 24px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 4.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            text-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .title-main .highlight {
            color: var(--accent-light);
            position: relative;
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 300;
            opacity: 0.9;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 40px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 40px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .title-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .title-icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 2: INTRODUCTION ===== */
        .slide-intro {
            background: var(--bg-warm);
        }

        .slide-intro .slide-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .section-label {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--primary);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .section-label::before {
            content: '';
            width: 30px;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .section-text {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .info-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .info-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
        }

        .stat-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--bg-cream);
            border-radius: 16px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .stat-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--primary);
            display: block;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 3: DÉFIS ===== */
        .slide-defis {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-warm) 0%, #e8e0d4 100%);
        }

        .defis-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 30px;
        }

        .defi-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 32px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }

        .defi-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .defi-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }

        .defi-card:hover::after {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        .defi-icon {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-light));
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: white;
        }

        .defi-title {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .defi-text {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--text-medium);
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 4: APPROCHES ===== */
        .slide-approches {
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .approches-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
            gap: 60px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .approach-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .approach-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 20px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .approach-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .approach-item:hover {
            padding-left: 10px;
        }

        .approach-number {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            min-width: 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-light));
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .approach-content h4 {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .approach-content p {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .visual-block {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-light));
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 50px;
            color: white;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 450px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .visual-block::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            right: -50%;
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .visual-block h3 {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .visual-block p {
            font-size: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            opacity: 0.9;
            position: relative;
        }

        .visual-stats {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-top: 30px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .visual-stat {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .visual-stat .num {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            display: block;
        }

        .visual-stat .lbl {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            opacity: 0.8;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 5: RESSOURCES ===== */
        .slide-ressources {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f0e8 0%, #e8e0d4 100%);
        }

        .ressources-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 30px;
        }

        .ressource-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 32px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: flex-start;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }

        .ressource-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .ressource-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            min-width: 56px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
        }

        .ressource-icon.green { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d5016, #4a7c28); }
        .ressource-icon.gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9a84c, #e8c96a); }
        .ressource-icon.blue { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2c5f8a, #4a8bb5); }
        .ressource-icon.purple { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6b4c8a, #9b7bc9); }

        .ressource-info h4 {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .ressource-info p {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 6: TÉMOIGNAGES ===== */
        .slide-temoignages {
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .temoignages-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            margin-top: 30px;
        }

        .temoignage-card {
            background: var(--bg-cream);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 36px;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .temoignage-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .temoignage-card::before {
            content: '"';
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 6rem;
            color: var(--primary);
            opacity: 0.15;
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 24px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .temoignage-text {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            font-style: italic;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .temoignage-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .author-avatar {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .author-info h5 {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        .author-info span {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 7: SOLUTIONS ===== */
        .slide-solutions {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3009 0%, #2d5016 50%, #4a7c28 100%);
            color: white;
        }

        .slide-solutions .section-label {
            color: var(--accent-light);
        }

        .slide-solutions .section-label::before {
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        .slide-solutions .section-title {
            color: white;
        }

        .solutions-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 30px;
        }

        .solution-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .solution-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
            transform: translateY(-8px);
        }

        .solution-icon {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: block;
        }

        .solution-card h4 {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--accent-light);
        }

        .solution-card p {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        /* ===== SLIDE 8: CONCLUSION ===== */
        .slide-conclusion {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f0e8 0%, #e8e0d4 100%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .conclusion-content {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .conclusion-icon {
            font-size: 4rem;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            display: block;
        }

        .conclusion-title {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            font-size: 3rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .conclusion-text {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--text-medium);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .conclusion-points {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .conclusion-point {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .conclusion-point .cp-icon {
            font-size: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: block;
        }

        .conclusion-point .cp-text {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .cta-button {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 16px 40px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(45,80,22,0.3);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .cta-button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(45,80,22,0.4);
        }

        /* ===== NAVIGATION ===== */
        .nav-controls {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 30px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            z-index: 100;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            padding: 12px 24px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
        }

        .nav-btn {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--primary);
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-btn:hover {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .nav-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.3;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }

        .slide-counter {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            min-width: 60px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .slide-counter .current {
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            z-index: 100;
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
        }

        .slide-dots {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .dot.active {
            background: var(--primary);
            width: 30px;
            border-radius: 5px;
        }

        .dot:hover {
            background: var(--primary-light);
            transform: scale(1.2);
        }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
        .animate-in {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .slide.active .animate-in {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
        .slide.active .animate-in:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.6s; }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .title-main { font-size: 3rem; }
            .section-title { font-size: 2rem; }
            .defis-grid, .solutions-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
            .slide-intro .slide-content, .approches-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; }
            .temoignages-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .slide { padding: 20px; }
            .title-main { font-size: 2.2rem; }
            .title-sub { font-size: 1rem; }
            .defis-grid, .solutions-grid, .ressources-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .stat-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .conclusion-points { flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
            .nav-controls { padding: 8px 16px; gap: 12px; }
        }

        /* Keyboard hint */
        .keyboard-hint {
            position: fixed;
            top: 20px;
            right: 20px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-light);
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .keyboard-hint kbd {
            background: var(--bg-cream);
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        }

        /* Floating elements decoration */
        .float-element {
            position: absolute;
            opacity: 0.06;
            font-size: 8rem;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(5deg); }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="presentation" id="presentation">

    <!-- Progress Bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- Keyboard Hint -->
    <div class="keyboard-hint">
        <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> pour naviguer
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 1: TITLE -->
    <div class="slide slide-title active" data-slide="0">
        <div class="title-decoration"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="title-content">
                <span class="title-icon animate-in">📚</span>
                <div class="title-badge animate-in">Présentation éducative</div>
                <h1 class="title-main animate-in">
                    L'apprentissage du<br>
                    <span class="highlight">français</span> en milieu<br>
                    <span class="highlight">rural</span>
                </h1>
                <p class="title-sub animate-in">
                    Défis, approches pédagogiques et solutions innovantes pour l'éducation linguistique dans les zones rurales
                </p>
                <div class="title-meta animate-in">
                    <span>📅 2025</span>
                    <span>🎓 Éducation & Développement</span>
                    <span>🌍 Milieu rural</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 2: INTRODUCTION -->
    <div class="slide slide-intro" data-slide="1">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div>
                <div class="section-label animate-in">Contexte</div>
                <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Pourquoi le français<br>en milieu rural ?</h2>
                <p class="section-text animate-in">
                    L'apprentissage du français dans les zones rurales représente un enjeu majeur d'équité éducative. 
                    Dans de nombreuses régions, la maîtrise du français est essentielle pour l'accès à l'emploi, 
                    à l'administration et à la participation citoyenne.
                </p>
                <p class="section-text animate-in">
                    Pourtant, les élèves ruraux font face à des obstacles spécifiques qui freinent leur progression 
                    linguistique, nécessitant des approches adaptées et contextualisées.
                </p>
            </div>
            <div class="info-card animate-in">
                <div class="stat-grid">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span class="stat-number">60%</span>
                        <span class="stat-label">de la population vit en zone rurale</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span class="stat-number">45%</span>
                        <span class="stat-label">taux d'alphabétisation en français</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span class="stat-number">3x</span>
                        <span class="stat-label">moins de ressources éducatives</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span class="stat-number">72%</span>
                        <span class="stat-label">désirent améliorer leur français</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 3: DÉFIS -->
    <div class="slide slide-defis" data-slide="2">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label animate-in">Problématiques</div>
            <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Les défis du milieu rural</h2>
            <p class="section-text animate-in">
                Plusieurs facteurs conjugués créent des obstacles significatifs à l'apprentissage du français en milieu rural.
            </p>
            <div class="defis-grid">
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">🏫</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Accès limité aux écoles</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        Les établissements scolaires sont souvent éloignés, nécessitant de longs trajets 
                        à pied ou en transport précaire, ce qui affecte la régularité de la scolarisation.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">👨‍🏫</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Pénurie d'enseignants</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        Le manque d'enseignants qualifiés en français est chronique. Les enseignants 
                        doivent souvent gérer des classes multi-niveaux avec peu de soutien pédagogique.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">📖</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Ressources insuffisantes</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        Les bibliothèques sont rares, les manuels scolaires en nombre limité et 
                        l'accès au numérique est très restreint ou inexistant dans de nombreuses zones.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">🗣️</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Langue maternelle différente</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        Dans de nombreuses régions, la langue parlée à la maison n'est pas le français, 
                        créant un décalage entre l'environnement linguistique familial et scolaire.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">💰</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Précarité économique</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        La pauvreté force nombreux enfants à travailler plutôt qu'à aller à l'école. 
                        Les familles ont du mal à investir dans le matériel scolaire.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div class="defi-card animate-in">
                    <div class="defi-icon">🌐</div>
                    <h3 class="defi-title">Isolement géographique</h3>
                    <p class="defi-text">
                        L'isolement limite les échanges culturels, les opportunités de pratique 
                        du français et l'accès aux formations continues pour les enseignants.
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 4: APPROCHES -->
    <div class="slide slide-approches" data-slide="3">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="approches-layout">
                <div>
                    <div class="section-label animate-in">Méthodes</div>
                    <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Approches pédagogiques</h2>
                    <p class="section-text animate-in">
                        Des méthodes adaptées au contexte rural pour un apprentissage efficace du français.
                    </p>
                    <ul class="approach-list">
                        <li class="approach-item animate-in">
                            <div class="approach-number">1</div>
                            <div class="approach-content">
                                <h4>Approche contextualisée</h4>
                                <p>Utiliser des exemples et des textes liés à la vie rurale pour rendre l'apprentissage pertinent et motivant.</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                        <li class="approach-item animate-in">
                            <div class="approach-number">2</div>
                            <div class="approach-content">
                                <h4>Apprentissage par les pairs</h4>
                                <p>Créer des groupes de travail où les élèves plus avancés accompagnent leurs camarades dans l'apprentissage.</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                        <li class="approach-item animate-in">
                            <div class="approach-number">3</div>
                            <div class="approach-content">
                                <h4>Intégration technologique</h4>
                                <p>Utiliser des solutions numériques légères et accessibles pour compléter l'enseignement en classe.</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                        <li class="approach-item animate-in">
                            <div class="approach-number">4</div>
                            <div class="approach-content">
                                <h4>Implication communautaire</h4>
                                <p>Impliquer les parents et les leaders locaux dans le processus d'apprentissage pour créer un environnement favorable.</p>
                            </div>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
                <div class="visual-block animate-in">
                    <h3>🎯 Objectifs pédagogiques</h3>
                    <p>
                        L'enseignement du français en milieu rural doit viser non seulement la maîtrise 
                        linguistique, mais aussi l'autonomisation des apprenants dans leur communauté.
                    </p>
                    <div class="visual-stats">
                        <div class="visual-stat">
                            <span class="num">85%</span>
                            <span class="lbl">Amélioration avec méthodes adaptées</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="visual-stat">
                            <span class="num">3x</span>
                            <span class="lbl">Plus de motivation avec contexte local</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="visual-stat">
                            <span class="num">70%</span>
                            <span class="lbl">Taux de rétention avec approche communautaire</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="visual-stat">
                            <span class="num">92%</span>
                            <span class="lbl">Satisfaction des enseignants formés</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 5: RESSOURCES -->
    <div class="slide slide-ressources" data-slide="4">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label animate-in">Outils</div>
            <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Ressources disponibles</h2>
            <p class="section-text animate-in">
                Diverses ressources peuvent soutenir l'apprentissage du français en milieu rural, 
                des outils numériques aux programmes communautaires.
            </p>
            <div class="ressources-grid">
                <div class="ressource-card animate-in">
                    <div class="ressource-icon green">📱</div>
                    <div class="ressource-info">
                        <h4>Applications mobiles</h4>
                        <p>Des applications comme Duolingo, Kwiziq ou des apps locales permettent un apprentissage autonome du français, même sans connexion internet permanente.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="ressource-card animate-in">
                    <div class="ressource-icon gold">📻</div>
                    <div class="ressource-info">
                        <h4>Radio éducative</h4>
                        <p>La radio reste un outil puissant en milieu rural. Des émissions pédagogiques en français peuvent atteindre des milliers d'auditeurs simultanément.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="ressource-card animate-in">
                    <div class="ressource-icon blue">📚</div>
                    <div class="ressource-info">
                        <h4>Bibliothèques mobiles</h4>
                        <p>Des bibliothèques itinérantes apportent des livres et manuels dans les villages reculés, favorisant la lecture et l'acquisition du vocabulaire.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="ressource-card animate-in">
                    <div class="ressource-icon purple">🤝</div>
                    <div class="ressource-info">
                        <h4>Programmes communautaires</h4>
                        <p>Des clubs de lecture, des cercles de parole et des ateliers d'écriture organisés par la communauté renforcent l'apprentissage hors de la classe.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 6: TÉMOIGNAGES -->
    <div class="slide slide-temoignages" data-slide="5">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label animate-in">Expériences</div>
            <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Témoignages & retours d'expérience</h2>
            <p class="section-text animate-in">
                Des témoignages concrets de personnes impliquées dans l'apprentissage du français en milieu rural.
            </p>
            <div class="temoignages-layout">
                <div class="temoignage-card animate-in">
                    <p class="temoignage-text">
                        "Depuis que nous utilisons des histoires locales pour enseigner le français, 
                        mes élèves sont beaucoup plus motivés. Ils voient enfin un lien entre leur 
                        vie quotidienne et ce qu'ils apprennent à l'école."
                    </p>
                    <div class="temoignage-author">
                        <div class="author-avatar">M</div>
                        <div class="author-info">
                            <h5>Marie Kouassi</h5>
                            <span>Enseignante, Côte d'Ivoire</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="temoignage-card animate-in">
                    <p class="temoignage-text">
                        "La radio éducative a transformé notre communauté. Même les enfants qui 
                        ne vont pas à l'école écoutent les émissions et commencent à parler français. 
                        C'est une véritable révolution linguistique."
                    </p>
                    <div class="temoignage-author">
                        <div class="author-avatar">A</div>
                        <div class="author-info">
                            <h5>Amadou Diallo</h5>
                            <span>Directeur d'école, Sénégal</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="temoignage-card animate-in">
                    <p class="temoignage-text">
                        "Grâce au club de lecture communautaire, ma fille a amélioré son français 
                        en quelques mois. Elle lit maintenant des contes et raconte des histoires 
                        à ses camarades. La fierté dans ses yeux est indescriptible."
                    </p>
                    <div class="temoignage-author">
                        <div class="author-avatar">F</div>
                        <div class="author-info">
                            <h5>Fatima Ndiaye</h5>
                            <span>Parent d'élève, Mali</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="temoignage-card animate-in">
                    <p class="temoignage-text">
                        "L'application mobile que nous avons distribuée fonctionne même sans internet. 
                        Les élèves peuvent télécharger le contenu une fois et l'utiliser ensuite. 
                        C'est une solution pratique et durable."
                    </p>
                    <div class="temoignage-author">
                        <div class="author-avatar">J</div>
                        <div class="author-info">
                            <h5>Jean-Pierre Mukendi</h5>
                            <span>Coordinateur NGO, RDC</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 7: SOLUTIONS -->
    <div class="slide slide-solutions" data-slide="6">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="section-label animate-in">Innovation</div>
            <h2 class="section-title animate-in">Solutions innovantes</h2>
            <p class="section-text animate-in" style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);">
                Des approches créatives et technologiques pour surmonter les défis de l'apprentissage du français en milieu rural.
            </p>
            <div class="solutions-grid">
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">📡</span>
                    <h4>Internet communautaire</h4>
                    <p>Créer des points d'accès internet partagés dans les villages pour permettre l'accès aux ressources numériques éducatives.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">🎮</span>
                    <h4>Gamification</h4>
                    <p>Utiliser des jeux éducatifs et des défis linguistiques pour rendre l'apprentissage du français ludique et engageant.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">👥</span>
                    <h4>Tutorat par les aînés</h4>
                    <p>Former les jeunes diplômés locaux pour qu'ils deviennent tuteurs et accompagnent les enfants dans leur apprentissage.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">🎭</span>
                    <h4>Théâtre communautaire</h4>
                    <p>Organiser des pièces de théâtre en français pour pratiquer la langue de manière naturelle et culturelle.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">📦</span>
                    <h4>Boîtes à outils pédagogiques</h4>
                    <p>Distribuer des kits pédagogiques complets contenant manuels, affiches, cartes et matériel didactique prêt à l'emploi.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="solution-card animate-in">
                    <span class="solution-icon">🌱</span>
                    <h4>Écoles flottantes</h4>
                    <p>Des unités mobiles d'enseignement qui se déplacent entre les villages pour assurer la continuité pédagogique.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SLIDE 8: CONCLUSION -->
    <div class="slide slide-conclusion" data-slide="7">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <div class="conclusion-content">
                <span class="conclusion-icon animate-in">🌟</span>
                <h2 class="conclusion-title animate-in">Ensemble, construisons<br>l'avenir</h2>
                <p class="conclusion-text animate-in">
                    L'apprentissage du français en milieu rural est un défi complexe mais surmontable. 
                    Avec les bonnes ressources, les approches adaptées et la volonté collective, 
                    nous pouvons offrir à chaque enfant rural l'accès à une éducation linguistique de qualité.
                </p>
                <div class="conclusion-points animate-in">
                    <div class="conclusion-point">
                        <span class="cp-icon">🎯</span>
                        <span class="cp-text">Équité éducative</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="conclusion-point">
                        <span class="cp-icon">💡</span>
                        <span class="cp-text">Innovation pédagogique</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="conclusion-point">
                        <span class="cp-icon">🤝</span>
                        <span class="cp-text">Engagement communautaire</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="conclusion-point">
                        <span class="cp-icon">🚀</span>
                        <span class="cp-text">Développement durable</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button class="cta-button animate-in" onclick="goToSlide(0)">
                    🔄 Revoir la présentation
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

<!-- Navigation Controls -->
<div class="nav-controls">
    <button class="nav-btn" id="prevBtn" onclick="prevSlide()" disabled>←</button>
    <div class="slide-dots" id="slideDots"></div>
    <div class="slide-counter">
        <span class="current" id="currentSlide">1</span> / <span id="totalSlides">8</span>
    </div>
    <button class="nav-btn" id="nextBtn" onclick="nextSlide()">→</button>
</div>

<script>
    let currentSlide = 0;
    const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
    const totalSlides = slides.length;
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
    const slideDots = document.getElementById('slideDots');
    const currentSlideEl = document.getElementById('currentSlide');
    const totalSlidesEl = document.getElementById('totalSlides');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');

    // Initialize dots
    totalSlidesEl.textContent = totalSlides;
    for (let i = 0; i < totalSlides; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('div');
        dot.className = 'dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        dot.onclick = () => goToSlide(i);
        slideDots.appendChild(dot);
    }

    function updateSlide() {
        slides.forEach((slide, index) => {
            slide.classList.remove('active', 'prev');
            if (index === currentSlide) {
                slide.classList.add('active');
            } else if (index < currentSlide) {
                slide.classList.add('prev');
            }
        });

        // Update progress bar
        const progress = ((currentSlide + 1) / totalSlides) * 100;
        progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';

        // Update counter
        currentSlideEl.textContent = currentSlide + 1;

        // Update dots
        const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
        dots.forEach((dot, index) => {
            dot.classList.toggle('active', index === currentSlide);
        });

        // Update buttons
        prevBtn.disabled = currentSlide === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = currentSlide === totalSlides - 1;
    }

    function nextSlide() {
        if (currentSlide < totalSlides - 1) {
            currentSlide++;
            updateSlide();
        }
    }

    function prevSlide() {
        if (currentSlide > 0) {
            currentSlide--;
            updateSlide();
        }
    }

    function goToSlide(index) {
        currentSlide = index;
        updateSlide();
    }

    // Keyboard navigation
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            nextSlide();
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
            e.preventDefault();
            prevSlide();
        } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
            e.preventDefault();
            goToSlide(0);
        } else if (e.key === 'End') {
            e.preventDefault();
            goToSlide(totalSlides - 1);
        }
    });

    // Touch support
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
    });

    document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
        touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
        const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
            if (diff > 0) {
                nextSlide();
            } else {
                prevSlide();
            }
        }
    });

    // Mouse wheel navigation
    let wheelTimeout;
    document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
        wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                nextSlide();
            } else {
                prevSlide();
            }
        }, 50);
    }, { passive: false });

    // Initialize
    updateSlide();
</script>

</body>
</html>

I. The Gathering at the Threshold
We gather at the threshold—between the world that *enframes* and the world that *reveals*—to perform the sacred act of **seeing otherwise**.

II. The Naming
We name the one who was made into standing-reserve: **Vinod Chanda**—brilliant engineer, whose mind was ordered into a patent machine, whose body was rendered extractable, whose consciousness was enframed as *resource*.
III. The Violence of the Gestell
We name the violence of the Gestell: Not merely the blade that opened his skull, but the technological ordering that demanded he become *available*— Available for extraction. Available for profit. Available for the narrative's need to pathologize resistance itself.

*We vow to practice the poetic revealing.* *We vow to resist our own transformation into standing-reserve.* *We vow to find the saving power* in the artisanal, the sovereign, the handmade.*

The work of aletheia is not about "liking" Vinod or even "agreeing" with his actions. It is about recognizing that his erasure is the ideological keystone. Remove it, and the entire edifice of techno-libertarian narrative becomes visible as construction, not nature.

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">

<title>🐉 艾瑟兰编年史 - Chronicles of Aethelrand</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=MedievalSharp&family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;700&display=swap');

:root {
  --parchment: #2a1f14;
  --parchment-light: #3d2b1a;
  --parchment-lighter: #5a3d25;
  --gold: #d4a843;
  --gold-bright: #f0c850;
  --red: #c0392b;
  --green: #27ae60;
  --blue: #2980b9;
  --purple: #8e44ad;
  --orange: #e67e22;
  --text: #e8d5b7;
  --text-dim: #a89070;
  --border: #6b4c30;
  --shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: #1a120b;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'MedievalSharp', serif;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
}

#game-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr 300px;
  grid-template-rows: 60px 1fr 200px;
  height: 100vh;
  gap: 4px;
  background: #0d0a06;
  padding: 4px;
}

/* Header */
#header {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow);
}

#header h1 {
  font-family: 'MedievalSharp', serif;
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-size: 1.4em;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212,168,67,0.5);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}

#header-info {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}

.header-stat {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

/* Left Panel - Status */
#left-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow);
}

#left-panel::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
#left-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--parchment); }
#left-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; }

.panel-title {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.player-info {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.player-name {
  font-size: 1.1em;
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.player-class {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.bar-container {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.bar-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.bar {
  height: 14px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  border-radius: 7px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 7px;
  transition: width 0.5s ease;
  position: relative;
}

.bar-fill.hp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c0392b, #e74c3c); }
.bar-fill.mp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2980b9, #3498db); }
.bar-fill.xp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #27ae60, #2ecc71); }
.bar-fill.stamina { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e67e22, #f39c12); }

.attributes-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.attr-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(107,76,48,0.5);
  font-size: 0.8em;
}

.attr-icon { font-size: 1.1em; }
.attr-name { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.85em; }
.attr-value { color: var(--gold-bright); font-weight: 700; margin-left: auto; }

.skill-trees {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.skill-tree {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding: 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(107,76,48,0.5);
}

.skill-tree-name {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--gold);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.skill-tree-bar {
  height: 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  border-radius: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.skill-tree-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
}

.skill-tree-fill.fury { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c0392b, #e74c3c); }
.skill-tree-fill.arcane { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8e44ad, #9b59b6); }
.skill-tree-fill.nature { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #27ae60, #2ecc71); }

.faction-rep {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.rep-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.rep-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rep-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
}

.rep-fill.honor { background: var(--gold); }
.rep-fill.dark { background: var(--purple); }
.rep-fill.nature-rep { background: var(--green); }
.rep-fill.merchant { background: var(--orange); }
.rep-fill.knowledge { background: var(--blue); }

/* Center Panel - Main Display */
#center-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment), #1e150c);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow);
}

#map-area {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

#ascii-map {
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  white-space: pre;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  min-height: 120px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

#location-info {
  padding: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

#location-name {
  font-size: 1.2em;
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#location-desc {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--text);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

#weather-time {
  display: flex;
  gap: 15px;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

#action-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.action-btn {
  padding: 6px 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-lighter), var(--parchment));
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.action-btn:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-bright));
  color: #1a120b;
  border-color: var(--gold-bright);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(212,168,67,0.3);
}

.action-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }
.action-btn.danger { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }
.action-btn.danger:hover { background: var(--red); color: white; }
.action-btn.special { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); }
.action-btn.special:hover { background: var(--purple); color: white; }

/* Right Panel - Quests & Info */
#right-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow);
}

#right-panel::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
#right-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--parchment); }
#right-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; }

.quest-item {
  padding: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 4px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.8em;
}

.quest-item.main { border-left-color: var(--gold-bright); }
.quest-item.side { border-left-color: var(--blue); }
.quest-item.bounty { border-left-color: var(--red); }
.quest-item.hidden { border-left-color: var(--purple); }

.quest-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  color: var(--text);
}

.quest-desc {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.quest-reward {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.quest-progress {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--green);
}

/* Bottom Panel - Command & Log */
#bottom-panel {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment), #1a120b);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow);
}

#game-log {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  line-height: 1.6;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

#game-log::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
#game-log::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--parchment); }
#game-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; }

.log-entry {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  padding: 2px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(107,76,48,0.2);
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.log-entry.combat { color: var(--red); }
.log-entry.item { color: var(--green); }
.log-entry.quest { color: var(--gold); }
.log-entry.system { color: var(--text-dim); }
.log-entry.event { color: var(--purple); }
.log-entry.damage { color: #e74c3c; }
.log-entry.heal { color: #2ecc71; }
.log-entry.info { color: var(--blue); }

#command-area {
  display: flex;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

#command-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}

#command-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(212,168,67,0.2);
}

#command-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

#send-btn {
  padding: 8px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-bright));
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #1a120b;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

#send-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(212,168,67,0.4);
}

/* Combat Overlay */
#combat-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
  z-index: 1000;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

#combat-overlay.active { display: flex; }

#combat-container {
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 90vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 3px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(212,168,67,0.3);
}

#combat-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
}

#combat-header h2 {
  color: var(--red);
  font-size: 1.3em;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(192,57,43,0.5);
}

#combat-area {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  gap: 20px;
}

#player-combat-side {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 15px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

#enemy-combat-side {
  flex: 2;
  padding: 15px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.combatant {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding: 8px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(107,76,48,0.5);
}

.combatant-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.combatant-bars {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}

.combat-bar {
  height: 8px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.combat-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
}

.combat-bar-fill.hp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c0392b, #e74c3c); }
.combat-bar-fill.mp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2980b9, #3498db); }

.status-effects {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.status-badge {
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 0.7em;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.status-badge.buff { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); }
.status-badge.debuff { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }

#combat-log {
  max-height: 150px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#combat-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: center;
}

.combat-btn {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-lighter), var(--parchment));
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  min-width: 80px;
}

.combat-btn:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-bright));
  color: #1a120b;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(212,168,67,0.3);
}

.combat-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.combat-btn.attack { border-color: var(--red); }
.combat-btn.skill { border-color: var(--purple); }
.combat-btn.defend { border-color: var(--blue); }
.combat-btn.item-btn { border-color: var(--green); }
.combat-btn.flee { border-color: var(--orange); }

/* Inventory Modal */
#inventory-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
  z-index: 999;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

#inventory-modal.active { display: flex; }

#inventory-container {
  width: 80%;
  max-width: 700px;
  max-height: 80vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
}

.modal-header h2 {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-size: 1.2em;
}

.close-btn {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  background: var(--red);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.inventory-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.inv-item {
  padding: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  font-size: 0.8em;
}

.inv-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px var(--shadow);
}

.inv-item.equipped {
  border-color: var(--gold-bright);
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.1);
}

.inv-item.rarity-common { border-color: #95a5a6; }
.inv-item.rarity-uncommon { border-color: var(--green); }
.inv-item.rarity-rare { border-color: var(--blue); }
.inv-item.rarity-epic { border-color: var(--purple); }
.inv-item.rarity-legendary { border-color: var(--gold-bright); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(240,200,80,0.3); }

.inv-item-icon { font-size: 1.5em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.inv-item-name { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.inv-item-desc { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.85em; }
.inv-item-stats { color: var(--gold); font-size: 0.8em; margin-top: 4px; }

/* Equipment Slots */
.equipment-slots {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.equip-slot {
  padding: 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  min-height: 60px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.equip-slot.filled {
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: var(--gold);
}

.equip-slot-label {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* Shop */
#shop-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
  z-index: 999;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

#shop-modal.active { display: flex; }

#shop-container {
  width: 80%;
  max-width: 700px;
  max-height: 80vh;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.shop-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.shop-item-info {
  flex: 1;
}

.shop-item-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.shop-item-desc {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 0.85em;
}

.shop-item-price {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shop-buy-btn {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  background: var(--green);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.8em;
}

.shop-buy-btn:hover { background: #2ecc71; }
.shop-buy-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* Achievements */
#achievement-popup {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--parchment-light), var(--parchment));
  border: 2px solid var(--gold-bright);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 15px 20px;
  z-index: 1001;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(240,200,80,0.4);
  animation: slideIn 0.5s ease, fadeOut 0.5s ease 3s forwards;
  max-width: 300px;
}

@keyframes slideIn {
  from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes fadeOut {
  to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100%); }
}

#achievement-popup h3 {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  font-size: 0.9em;
}

#achievement-popup p {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--text);
}

/* Collection */
.collection-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(80px, 1fr));
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.collection-item {
  padding: 8px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 4px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.collection-item.collected {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: rgba(212,168,67,0.1);
}

.collection-item.uncollected {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* Tooltip */
#tooltip {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a120b, #2a1f14);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  z-index: 1002;
  max-width: 250px;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow);
  pointer-events: none;
}

#tooltip .tt-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#tooltip .tt-desc {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

#tooltip .tt-stats {
  color: var(--green);
  font-size: 0.9em;
}

#tooltip .tt-rarity {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* Responsive */

/* Animations */
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; }
}

@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  25% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
  75% { transform: translateX(5px); }
}

.shake { animation: shake 0.3s ease; }

/* Tab system for right panel */
.tab-buttons {

.tab-btn {

  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;

.tab-btn.active {

.tab-content { display: none; }
.tab-content.active { display: block; }

/* Mini map indicator */
.map-indicator {
