          { name: '树人之盾', cost: 25, type: 'buff', stat: 'def', value: 15, duration: 3, desc: '增加15点防御，持续3回合' },
          { name: '自然之怒', cost: 30, type: 'magic', multiplier: 2.5, element: 'nature', aoe: true, desc: '对全体敌人造成自然伤害' }
        ]
      }
    }
  },

  // Initialize game
  init() {
    this.loadGame();
    this.updateUI();
    this.updateQuestList();
    this.updateAchievementList();
    this.updateEventList();
    this.updateMap();
    
    // Start time progression
    setInterval(() => this.tick(), 30000); // Every 30 seconds = 1 game hour
    
    // Command input
    document.getElementById('command-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') this.processCommand();
    });

    // Tooltip
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
      if (tooltip.style.display === 'block') {
        tooltip.style.left = (e.clientX + 15) + 'px';
        tooltip.style.top = (e.clientY + 15) + 'px';
      }
    });

    this.log('🐉 游戏已初始化完成！输入 "帮助" 查看可用命令。', 'system');
  },

  // Game tick (time progression)
  tick() {
    this.state.world.time++;
    if (this.state.world.time >= 24) {
      this.state.world.time = 0;
      this.state.world.day++;
      this.log(`📅 第 ${this.state.world.day} 天开始了！`, 'system');
    }

    // Weather change
    this.state.world.weatherTimer++;
    if (this.state.world.weatherTimer >= 6) {
      this.state.world.weatherTimer = 0;
      const weathers = this.weatherTypes;
      this.state.world.weather = weathers[Math.floor(Math.random() * weathers.length)];
      this.log(`🌤️ 天气变为：${this.weatherNames[this.state.world.weather]}`, 'system');
    }

    // Economy fluctuation
    this.state.economy.fluctuation = 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    
    this.updateUI();
    this.updateMap();
  },

  // Update UI
  updateUI() {
    const p = this.state.player;
    const w = this.state.world;

    // Header
    document.getElementById('header-day').textContent = `第${w.day}天`;
    document.getElementById('header-time').textContent = this.timePeriods[w.time];
    document.getElementById('header-weather').textContent = this.weatherNames[w.weather];
    document.getElementById('header-gold').textContent = p.gold;
    document.getElementById('header-location').textContent = this.getLocationName();

    // Player stats
    document.getElementById('player-name').textContent = p.name;
    document.getElementById('player-level').textContent = p.level;
    document.getElementById('hp-text').textContent = `${p.hp}/${p.maxHp}`;
    document.getElementById('mp-text').textContent = `${p.mp}/${p.maxMp}`;
    document.getElementById('xp-text').textContent = `${p.xp}/${p.xpToNext}`;
    document.getElementById('stamina-text').textContent = `${p.stamina}/${p.maxStamina}`;

    document.getElementById('hp-bar').style.width = `${(p.hp / p.maxHp) * 100}%`;
    document.getElementById('mp-bar').style.width = `${(p.mp / p.maxMp) * 100}%`;
    document.getElementById('xp-bar').style.width = `${(p.xp / p.xpToNext) * 100}%`;
    document.getElementById('stamina-bar').style.width = `${(p.stamina / p.maxStamina) * 100}%`;

    // Attributes
    document.getElementById('attr-str').textContent = p.attributes.str;
    document.getElementById('attr-dex').textContent = p.attributes.dex;
    document.getElementById('attr-int').textContent = p.attributes.int;
    document.getElementById('attr-vit').textContent = p.attributes.vit;
    document.getElementById('attr-lck').textContent = p.attributes.lck;
    document.getElementById('attr-atk').textContent = this.calculateAttack();

    // Skill trees
    document.getElementById('skill-fury').style.width = `${p.skills.fury}%`;
    document.getElementById('skill-arcane').style.width = `${p.skills.arcane}%`;
    document.getElementById('skill-nature').style.width = `${p.skills.nature}%`;

    // Factions
    document.getElementById('rep-honor').style.width = `${this.state.factions.honor}%`;
    document.getElementById('rep-honor-text').textContent = this.state.factions.honor;
    document.getElementById('rep-dark').style.width = `${this.state.factions.dark}%`;
    document.getElementById('rep-dark-text').textContent = this.state.factions.dark;
    document.getElementById('rep-nature').style.width = `${this.state.factions.nature}%`;
    document.getElementById('rep-nature-text').textContent = this.state.factions.nature;
    document.getElementById('rep-merchant').style.width = `${this.state.factions.merchant}%`;
    document.getElementById('rep-merchant-text').textContent = this.state.factions.merchant;
    document.getElementById('rep-knowledge').style.width = `${this.state.factions.knowledge}%`;
    document.getElementById('rep-knowledge-text').textContent = this.state.factions.knowledge;

    // Location info
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (loc) {
      document.getElementById('location-name').textContent = `📍 ${loc.name}`;
      document.getElementById('location-desc').textContent = loc.desc;
    }

    // Weather/time in location info
    document.getElementById('weather-time').innerHTML = `
      <span>📅 第${w.day}天</span>
      <span>🕐 ${this.timePeriods[w.time]}</span>
      <span>${this.weatherNames[w.weather]}</span>
      <span>🌡️ ${15 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)}°C</span>
    `;
  },

  // Get current location
  getCurrentLocation() {
    const continent = this.worldData.continents[this.state.world.currentContinent];
    const region = continent.regions[this.state.world.currentRegion];
    return region.locations[this.state.world.currentLocation];
  },

  // Get location name
  getLocationName() {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    return loc ? loc.name : '未知';
  },

  // Update quest list
  updateQuestList() {
    const list = document.getElementById('quest-list');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    
    this.state.quests.forEach(q => {
      const questData = this.worldData.quests[q.id];
      if (!questData) return;
      
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = `quest-item ${questData.type}`;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="quest-title">${questData.title}</div>
        <div class="quest-desc">${questData.desc}</div>
        <div class="quest-reward">🎁 ${questData.rewards.xp} XP, ${questData.rewards.gold} G${questData.rewards.item ? `, ${this.worldData.items[questData.rewards.item]?.name || questData.rewards.item}` : ''}</div>
        <div class="quest-progress">进度: ${this.getQuestProgress(q)}</div>
      `;
      list.appendChild(div);
    });

    if (this.state.quests.length === 0) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: var(--text-dim); text-align: center; padding: 20px;">暂无任务</div>';
    }
  },

  // Get quest progress
  getQuestProgress(quest) {
    const questData = this.worldData.quests[quest.id];
    if (!questData) return '';
    
    return questData.objectives.map(obj => {
      const current = obj.current || 0;
      const target = obj.count || 1;
      return `${current}/${target}`;
    }).join(', ');
  },

  // Update achievement list
  updateAchievementList() {
    const list = document.getElementById('achievement-list');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    
    Object.entries(this.worldData.achievements).forEach(([key, ach]) => {
      const collected = this.state.achievements.includes(key);
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = `collection-item ${collected ? 'collected' : 'uncollected'}`;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div>${ach.name}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.8em; color: var(--text-dim);">${ach.desc}</div>
      `;
      list.appendChild(div);
    });
  },

  // Update event list
  updateEventList() {
    const list = document.getElementById('event-list');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    
    this.state.events.slice(-10).reverse().forEach(e => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'quest-item';
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="quest-title">${e.icon} ${e.title}</div>
        <div class="quest-desc">${e.desc}</div>
      `;
      list.appendChild(div);
    });

    if (this.state.events.length === 0) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: var(--text-dim); text-align: center; padding: 20px;">暂无事件</div>';
    }
  },

  // Update map
  updateMap() {
    const map = document.getElementById('ascii-map');
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc) return;

    const connections = loc.connections || [];
    const mapText = `
<pre>
    ╔══════════════════════════════════╗
    ║          🏔️ 艾瑟兰大陆          ║
    ╠══════════════════════════════════╣
    ║                                  ║
    ║   🌲森林    🏰王城    🌋火山     ║
    ║      \\      |      /             ║
    ║       \\     |     /              ║
    ║   🏘️村庄──⚔️营地──🏛️遗迹        ║
    ║      /     |     \\              ║
    ║   🌊湖泊    |    🏜️沙漠          ║
    ║          📍${' '.repeat(Math.max(0, 10 - String(loc.name).length))}  ← 你在这里               ║
    ║                                  ║
    ╠══════════════════════════════════╣
    ║  连接: ${connections.map(c => this.getShortLocationName(c)).join(' → ') || '无'}              ║
    ║  天气: ${this.weatherNames[this.state.world.weather]}                  ║
    ║  时间: 第${this.state.world.day}天 ${this.timePeriods[this.state.world.time]}               ║
    ╚══════════════════════════════════╝
</pre>
    `;
    map.innerHTML = mapText;
  },

  // Get short location name
  getShortLocationName(locId) {
    const continent = this.worldData.continents[this.state.world.currentContinent];
    for (const region of Object.values(continent.regions)) {
      if (region.locations[locId]) {
        return region.locations[locId].name.replace(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1F9FF}]/gu, '').trim();
      }
    }
    return locId;
  },

  // Explore current location
  explore() {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc) return;

    this.log(`🔍 你开始探索 ${loc.name}...`, 'info');
    
    // Random event
    const roll = Math.random();
    if (roll < 0.3) {
      // Find item
      if (loc.items && loc.items.length > 0) {
        const itemKey = loc.items[Math.floor(Math.random() * loc.items.length)];
        const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
        if (item) {
          this.addItem(itemKey);
          this.log(`✨ 你发现了 ${item.name}！`, 'item');
          this.addEvent('✨', '发现物品', `在${loc.name}发现了${item.name}`);
        }
      }
    } else if (roll < 0.6) {
      // Encounter enemy
      if (loc.enemies && loc.enemies.length > 0) {
        const enemyKey = loc.enemies[Math.floor(Math.random() * loc.enemies.length)];
        const enemy = this.worldData.enemies[enemyKey];
        if (enemy) {
          this.log(`⚠️ 遭遇了 ${enemy.name}！`, 'combat');
          this.startCombat([enemyKey]);
        }
      }
    } else if (roll < 0.8) {
      // Random event
      this.triggerRandomEvent();
    } else {
      this.log(`🔍 你仔细搜索了${loc.name}，但没有发现什么特别的东西。`, 'system');
    }

    // Stamina cost
    this.state.player.stamina = Math.max(0, this.state.player.stamina - 5);
    this.updateUI();
  },

  // Travel to connected location
  travel() {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc || !loc.connections || loc.connections.length === 0) {
      this.log('🚶 这里没有可以前往的地方。', 'system');
      return;
    }

    const connections = loc.connections;
    this.log(`🚶 可前往: ${connections.map(c => this.getShortLocationName(c)).join(', ')}`, 'info');
    this.log('💡 输入 "旅行 [地点名]" 或选择快捷命令。', 'system');
  },

  // Move to a specific location
  moveTo(locationId) {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc || !loc.connections || !loc.connections.includes(locationId)) {
      this.log('🚶 无法前往该地点。', 'system');
      return;
    }

    this.state.world.currentLocation = locationId;
    this.state.visitedLocations.add(locationId);
    
    // Stamina cost for travel
    this.state.player.stamina = Math.max(0, this.state.player.stamina - 10);
    
    const newLoc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    this.log(`🚶 你来到了 ${newLoc.name}`, 'info');
    this.log(`📍 ${newLoc.desc}`, 'system');
    
    this.addEvent('🚶', '旅行', `从${loc.name}来到了${newLoc.name}`);
    
    this.updateUI();
    this.updateMap();
    this.updateQuestList();

    // Random encounter on travel
    if (Math.random() < 0.3 && newLoc.enemies && newLoc.enemies.length > 0) {
      const enemyKey = newLoc.enemies[Math.floor(Math.random() * newLoc.enemies.length)];
      const enemy = this.worldData.enemies[enemyKey];
      if (enemy) {
        this.log(`⚠️ 在旅途中遭遇了 ${enemy.name}！`, 'combat');
        this.startCombat([enemyKey]);
      }
    }
  },

  // Rest at current location
  rest() {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc) return;

    this.state.player.hp = Math.min(this.state.player.maxHp, this.state.player.hp + 30);
    this.state.player.mp = Math.min(this.state.player.maxMp, this.state.player.mp + 20);
    this.state.player.stamina = Math.min(this.state.player.maxStamina, this.state.player.stamina + 50);
    
    // Advance time
    this.state.world.time = Math.min(23, this.state.world.time + 4);
    
    this.log(`🏕️ 你在${loc.name}休息了一会儿，恢复了部分状态。`, 'heal');
    this.log(`❤️ HP +30, 💎 MP +20, ⚡ 体力 +50`, 'heal');
    
    this.updateUI();
  },

  // Open inventory
  openInventory() {
    document.getElementById('inventory-modal').classList.add('active');
    this.renderInventory();
  },

  closeInventory() {
    document.getElementById('inventory-modal').classList.remove('active');
  },

  renderInventory() {
    const p = this.state.player;
    
    // Equipment slots
    const slotsDiv = document.getElementById('equipment-slots');
    slotsDiv.innerHTML = '';
    
    const slotTypes = ['weapon', 'armor', 'helmet', 'accessory'];
    const slotNames = { weapon: '⚔️ 武器', armor: '🛡️ 护甲', helmet: '⛑️ 头盔', accessory: '💍 饰品' };
    
    slotTypes.forEach(slot => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = `equip-slot ${p.equipment[slot] ? 'filled' : ''}`;
      const item = p.equipment[slot] ? this.worldData.items[p.equipment[slot]] : null;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="equip-slot-label">${slotNames[slot]}</div>
        <div>${item ? item.name : '空'}</div>
        ${item ? `<div style="font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--text-dim);">${item.desc}</div>` : ''}
      `;
      slotsDiv.appendChild(div);
    });

    // Inventory grid
    const grid = document.getElementById('inventory-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    
    p.inventory.forEach((itemKey, index) => {
      const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
      if (!item) return;
      
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = `inv-item rarity-${item.rarity}`;
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="inv-item-icon">${item.name.match(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1F9FF}]/gu)?.[0] || '📦'}</div>
        <div class="inv-item-name">${item.name.replace(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1F9FF}]/gu, '').trim()}</div>
        <div class="inv-item-desc">${item.desc}</div>
        <div class="inv-item-stats">${item.type === 'consumable' ? '💊 消耗品' : item.type === 'weapon' ? '⚔️ 武器' : item.type === 'armor' ? '🛡️ 护甲' : '📦 材料'}</div>
      `;
      div.onclick = () => this.useItem(index);
      div.onmouseenter = (e) => this.showTooltip(e, item);
      div.onmouseleave = () => document.getElementById('tooltip').style.display = 'none';
      grid.appendChild(div);
    });

    document.getElementById('inv-count').textContent = `${p.inventory.length}/50`;
  },

  // Use item from inventory
  useItem(index) {
    const p = this.state.player;
    const itemKey = p.inventory[index];
    const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
    if (!item) return;

    if (item.type === 'consumable') {
      if (item.effect) {
        if (item.effect.hp) {
          p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.hp + item.effect.hp);
          this.log(`🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，HP +${item.effect.hp}`, 'heal');
        }
        if (item.effect.mp) {
          p.mp = Math.min(p.maxMp, p.mp + item.effect.mp);
          this.log(`🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，MP +${item.effect.mp}`, 'heal');
        }
        if (item.effect.stamina) {
          p.stamina = Math.min(p.maxStamina, p.stamina + item.effect.stamina);
          this.log(`🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，体力 +${item.effect.stamina}`, 'heal');
        }
        if (item.effect.poison) {
          this.log(`☠️ 使用了 ${item.name}，准备涂在武器上！`, 'combat');
        }
      }
      p.inventory.splice(index, 1);
      this.log(`📦 使用了 ${item.name}`, 'item');
    } else if (item.type === 'weapon' || item.type === 'armor' || item.type === 'helmet' || item.type === 'accessory') {
      this.equipItem(index, item.type);
    }

    this.renderInventory();
    this.updateUI();
  },

  // Equip item
  equipItem(index, slot) {
    const p = this.state.player;
    const itemKey = p.inventory[index];
    const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
    if (!item) return;

    // Unequip current
    if (p.equipment[slot]) {
      p.inventory.push(p.equipment[slot]);
    }

    p.equipment[slot] = itemKey;
    p.inventory.splice(index, 1);

    // Apply stats
    if (item.stats) {
      Object.entries(item.stats).forEach(([stat, value]) => {
        if (p.attributes[stat] !== undefined) {
          p.attributes[stat] += value;
        }
      });
    }

    this.log(`⚔️ 装备了 ${item.name}！`, 'item');
    this.addEvent('⚔️', '装备', `装备了${item.name}`);
  },

  // Add item to inventory
  addItem(itemKey) {
    const p = this.state.player;
    if (p.inventory.length >= 50) {
      this.log('🎒 背包已满！', 'system');
      return false;
    }
    p.inventory.push(itemKey);
    return true;
  },

  // Open shop
  openShop() {
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    if (!loc || !loc.hasShop) {
      this.log('🏪 这里没有商店。', 'system');
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('shop-modal').classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('shop-gold').textContent = `💰 ${this.state.player.gold} G`;
    this.renderShop();
  },

  closeShop() {
    document.getElementById('shop-modal').classList.remove('active');
  },

  renderShop() {
    const container = document.getElementById('shop-items');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    
    // Generate shop items based on location
    const loc = this.getCurrentLocation();
    const shopItems = this.getShopItems(loc);
    
    shopItems.forEach(itemKey => {
      const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
      if (!item) return;
      
      const price = Math.floor(item.price * this.state.economy.fluctuation);
      
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'shop-item';
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="shop-item-info">
          <div class="shop-item-name">${item.name}</div>
          <div class="shop-item-desc">${item.desc}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="shop-item-price">💰 ${price} G</div>
        <button class="shop-buy-btn" onclick="Game.buyItem('${itemKey}', ${price})" ${this.state.player.gold < price ? 'disabled' : ''}>购买</button>
      `;
      container.appendChild(div);
    });
  },

  getShopItems(loc) {
    // Generate shop items based on location type
    const items = [];
    switch (loc.type) {
      case 'village':
        items.push('potion', 'bread', 'water', 'iron_sword', 'iron_armor');
        break;
      case 'oasis':
        items.push('water', 'date', 'silk', 'potion', 'magic_scroll');
        break;
      case 'elf_village':
        items.push('elf_arrow', 'magic_scroll', 'elf_bread', 'rare_herb');
        break;
      default:
        items.push('potion', 'bread', 'water');
    }
    return items;
  },

  buyItem(itemKey, price) {
    const p = this.state.player;
    if (p.gold < price) {
      this.log('💰 金币不足！', 'system');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!this.addItem(itemKey)) return;
    
    p.gold -= price;
    const item = this.worldData.items[itemKey];
    this.log(`🏪 购买了 ${item.name}，花费 ${price} G`, 'item');
    this.addEvent('🏪', '购买', `购买了${item.name}`);
    
    document.getElementById('shop-gold').textContent = `💰 ${p.gold} G`;
    this.renderShop();
    this.updateUI();
  },

  // Check quests
  checkQuests() {
    this.switchTab('quests');
    this.updateQuestList();
  },

  // Open collection
  openCollection() {
    this.switchTab('achievements');
    this.updateAchievementList();
  },

  // Switch tab
  switchTab(tabName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
    
    document.querySelector(`.tab-btn:nth-child(${tabName === 'quests' ? 1 : tabName === 'events' ? 2 : 3})`).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');
  },

  // Start combat
  startCombat(enemyKeys) {
    const enemies = enemyKeys.map(key => {
      const enemyData = this.worldData.enemies[key];
      return {
        ...enemyData,
        key: key,
        currentHp: enemyData.hp,
        statusEffects: []
      };
    });

    this.state.combat = {
      enemies: enemies,
      turn: 1,
      turnOrder: [],
      playerDefending: false,
      playerBuffs: [],
      playerDebuffs: [],
      log: []
    };

    // Calculate turn order based on agility
    this.calculateTurnOrder();
    
    // Show combat overlay
    document.getElementById('combat-overlay').classList.add('active');
    this.renderCombat();
    
    this.log(`⚔️ 战斗开始！遭遇了 ${enemies.map(e => e.name).join(', ')}！`, 'combat');
  },

  // Calculate turn order
  calculateTurnOrder() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const playerSpd = this.state.player.attributes.dex + (this.state.player.equipment.weapon ? (this.worldData.items[this.state.player.equipment.weapon]?.stats?.spd || 0) : 0);
    
    combat.turnOrder = [
      { type: 'player', spd: playerSpd },
      ...combat.enemies.map(e => ({ type: 'enemy', key: e.key, spd: e.spd }))
    ].sort((a, b) => b.spd - a.spd);
  },

  // Render combat
  renderCombat() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;

    // Player info
    document.getElementById('combat-player-name').textContent = p.name;
    document.getElementById('combat-player-level').textContent = p.level;
    document.getElementById('combat-player-hp').style.width = `${(p.hp / p.maxHp) * 100}%`;
    document.getElementById('combat-player-mp').style.width = `${(p.mp / p.maxMp) * 100}%`;
    document.getElementById('combat-turn-info').textContent = `回合 ${combat.turn}`;

    // Enemy list
    const enemyList = document.getElementById('enemy-list');
    enemyList.innerHTML = '';
    
    combat.enemies.forEach((enemy, index) => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'combatant';
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="combatant-name">
          <span>${enemy.name}</span>
          <span>HP: ${enemy.currentHp}/${enemy.maxHp}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="combatant-bars">
          <div class="combat-bar"><div class="combat-bar-fill hp" style="width: ${(enemy.currentHp / enemy.maxHp) * 100}%"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="status-effects">
          ${enemy.statusEffects.map(se => `<span class="status-badge debuff">${se.name}</span>`).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
      enemyList.appendChild(div);
    });

    // Combat log
    const logDiv = document.getElementById('combat-log');
    logDiv.innerHTML = combat.log.map(entry => `<div class="log-entry ${entry.type}">${entry.text}</div>`).join('');
    logDiv.scrollTop = logDiv.scrollHeight;
  },

  // Player action in combat
  playerAction(action) {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    if (!combat) return;

    const p = this.state.player;
    let actionSuccess = false;

    switch (action) {
      case 'attack':
        this.combatAttack();
        actionSuccess = true;
        break;
      case 'skill':
        this.combatSkill();
        actionSuccess = true;
        break;
      case 'defend':
        combat.playerDefending = true;
        combat.log.push({ text: '🛡️ 你进入了防御姿态！', type: 'info' });
        actionSuccess = true;
        break;
      case 'item':
        this.combatUseItem();
        actionSuccess = true;
        break;
      case 'flee':
        this.combatFlee();
        actionSuccess = true;
        break;
    }

    if (actionSuccess) {
      // Check if all enemies are defeated
      if (combat.enemies.every(e => e.currentHp <= 0)) {
        this.combatVictory();
        return;
      }

      // Enemy turns
      setTimeout(() => this.enemyTurns(), 500);
    }
  },

  // Combat attack
  combatAttack() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    const atk = this.calculateAttack();
    
    // Target first alive enemy
    const target = combat.enemies.find(e => e.currentHp > 0);
    if (!target) return;

    const def = target.def || 0;
    const damage = Math.max(1, atk - def + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5));
    target.currentHp = Math.max(0, target.currentHp - damage);

    combat.log.push({ text: `⚔️ 你攻击了 ${target.name}，造成 ${damage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
    
    // Check for critical hit
    if (Math.random() < p.attributes.lck / 100) {
      const critDamage = Math.floor(damage * 0.5);
      target.currentHp = Math.max(0, target.currentHp - critDamage);
      combat.log.push({ text: `💥 暴击！额外造成 ${critDamage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
    }

    this.renderCombat();
  },

  // Combat skill
  combatSkill() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    
    // Show skill selection
    const skillType = prompt('选择技能树 (fury/arcane/nature):');
    if (!skillType) return;
    
    const skillTree = this.worldData.skills[skillType];
    if (!skillTree) {
      combat.log.push({ text: '❌ 无效的技能树！', type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      return;
    }

    const skillIndex = prompt(`选择技能 (0-${skillTree.skills.length - 1}):\n${skillTree.skills.map((s, i) => `${i}. ${s.name} (MP: ${s.cost})`).join('\n')}`);
    if (skillIndex === null) return;
    
    const index = parseInt(skillIndex);
    if (isNaN(index) || index < 0 || index >= skillTree.skills.length) {
      combat.log.push({ text: '❌ 无效的技能选择！', type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      return;
    }

    const skill = skillTree.skills[index];
    if (p.mp < skill.cost) {
      combat.log.push({ text: `❌ MP不足！需要 ${skill.cost} MP`, type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      return;
    }

    p.mp -= skill.cost;

    if (skill.type === 'attack' || skill.type === 'magic') {
      const multiplier = skill.multiplier || 1.5;
      const baseAtk = skill.type === 'magic' ? p.attributes.int : this.calculateAttack();
      const target = combat.enemies.find(e => e.currentHp > 0);
      if (!target) return;

      let damage = Math.floor(baseAtk * multiplier);
      if (skill.aoe) {
        combat.enemies.forEach(e => {
          if (e.currentHp > 0) {
            e.currentHp = Math.max(0, e.currentHp - damage);
          }
        });
        combat.log.push({ text: `✨ 你使用了 ${skill.name}，对全体敌人造成 ${damage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
      } else {
        target.currentHp = Math.max(0, target.currentHp - damage);
        combat.log.push({ text: `✨ 你使用了 ${skill.name}，对 ${target.name} 造成 ${damage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
      }
    } else if (skill.type === 'heal') {
      p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.hp + skill.value);
      combat.log.push({ text: `✨ 你使用了 ${skill.name}，恢复了 ${skill.value} 点HP！`, type: 'heal' });
    } else if (skill.type === 'buff') {
      p.buffs.push({ stat: skill.stat, value: skill.value, duration: skill.duration });
      combat.log.push({ text: `✨ 你使用了 ${skill.name}，${skill.stat} +${skill.value}，持续 ${skill.duration} 回合！`, type: 'info' });
    } else if (skill.type === 'debuff') {
      const target = combat.enemies.find(e => e.currentHp > 0);
      if (target) {
        target.statusEffects.push({ name: skill.name, stat: skill.stat, value: skill.value, duration: skill.duration });
        combat.log.push({ text: `✨ 你使用了 ${skill.name}，${target.name} 的 ${skill.stat} -${skill.value}，持续 ${skill.duration} 回合！`, type: 'info' });
      }
    }

    // Update skill tree progress
    p.skills[skillType] = Math.min(100, p.skills[skillType] + 2);
    
    this.renderCombat();
  },

  // Combat use item
  combatUseItem() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    
    // Find consumable items
    const consumables = p.inventory.map((itemKey, index) => ({ key: itemKey, index, item: this.worldData.items[itemKey] }))
      .filter(x => x.item && x.item.type === 'consumable');
    
    if (consumables.length === 0) {
      combat.log.push({ text: '❌ 没有可用的消耗品！', type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      return;
    }

    const itemIndex = prompt(`选择道具 (0-${consumables.length - 1}):\n${consumables.map((c, i) => `${i}. ${c.item.name}`).join('\n')}`);
    if (itemIndex === null) return;
    
    const idx = parseInt(itemIndex);
    if (isNaN(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= consumables.length) {
      combat.log.push({ text: '❌ 无效的选择！', type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      return;
    }

    const { key, index } = consumables[idx];
    const item = this.worldData.items[key];
    
    if (item.effect) {
      if (item.effect.hp) {
        p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.hp + item.effect.hp);
        combat.log.push({ text: `🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，HP +${item.effect.hp}`, type: 'heal' });
      }
      if (item.effect.mp) {
        p.mp = Math.min(p.maxMp, p.mp + item.effect.mp);
        combat.log.push({ text: `🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，MP +${item.effect.mp}`, type: 'heal' });
      }
      if (item.effect.stamina) {
        p.stamina = Math.min(p.maxStamina, p.stamina + item.effect.stamina);
        combat.log.push({ text: `🧪 使用了 ${item.name}，体力 +${item.effect.stamina}`, type: 'heal' });
      }
    }
    
    p.inventory.splice(index, 1);
    this.renderCombat();
  },

  // Combat flee
  combatFlee() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    const fleeChance = 0.3 + (p.attributes.dex / 100);
    
    if (Math.random() < fleeChance) {
      combat.log.push({ text: '🏃 你成功逃跑了！', type: 'info' });
      this.log('🏃 你成功逃跑了！', 'info');
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('combat-overlay').classList.remove('active');
        this.state.combat = null;
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      combat.log.push({ text: '❌ 逃跑失败！', type: 'system' });
      this.renderCombat();
      setTimeout(() => this.enemyTurns(), 500);
    }
  },

  // Enemy turns
  enemyTurns() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;

    combat.enemies.forEach(enemy => {
      if (enemy.currentHp <= 0) return;

      // Simple AI
      const action = Math.random();
      if (action < 0.7) {
        // Attack
        const atk = enemy.atk || 10;
        const def = p.attributes.vit / 2;
        const damage = Math.max(1, atk - def + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3));
        
        let finalDamage = damage;
        if (combat.playerDefending) {
          finalDamage = Math.floor(damage * 0.5);
        }

        p.hp = Math.max(0, p.hp - finalDamage);
        combat.log.push({ text: `💢 ${enemy.name} 攻击了你，造成 ${finalDamage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
      } else if (action < 0.9 && enemy.skills && enemy.skills.length > 0) {
        // Use skill
        const skill = enemy.skills[Math.floor(Math.random() * enemy.skills.length)];
        combat.log.push({ text: `💢 ${enemy.name} 使用了 ${skill}！`, type: 'damage' });
        
        const atk = enemy.atk || 10;
        const def = p.attributes.vit / 2;
        const damage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(atk * 1.5) - def);
        
        p.hp = Math.max(0, p.hp - damage);
        combat.log.push({ text: `💢 ${enemy.name} 的技能造成 ${damage} 点伤害！`, type: 'damage' });
      } else {
        combat.log.push({ text: `💢 ${enemy.name} 等待时机...`, type: 'info' });
      }

      // Process status effects
      enemy.statusEffects = enemy.statusEffects.filter(se => {
        se.duration--;
        return se.duration > 0;
      });
    });

    combat.playerDefending = false;
    
    // Process player buffs
    p.buffs = p.buffs.filter(buff => {
      buff.duration--;
      return buff.duration > 0;
    });

    combat.turn++;
    
    // Check player death
    if (p.hp <= 0) {
      this.combatDefeat();
      return;
    }

    this.renderCombat();
  },

  // Combat victory
  combatVictory() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    
    let totalXP = 0;
    let totalGold = 0;
    
    combat.enemies.forEach(enemy => {
      totalXP += enemy.xp || 0;
      totalGold += enemy.gold || 0;
      
      // Drop items
      if (enemy.drops && Math.random() < 0.5) {
        const dropKey = enemy.drops[Math.floor(Math.random() * enemy.drops.length)];
        if (this.addItem(dropKey)) {
          const dropItem = this.worldData.items[dropKey];
          this.log(`✨ 获得了 ${dropItem?.name || dropKey}！`, 'item');
        }
      }
    });

    p.xp += totalXP;
    p.gold += totalGold;
    
    this.log(`🎉 战斗胜利！获得了 ${totalXP} XP 和 ${totalGold} G！`, 'quest');
    
    // Check level up
    while (p.xp >= p.xpToNext) {
      p.xp -= p.xpToNext;
      p.level++;
      p.xpToNext = Math.floor(p.xpToNext * 1.5);
      p.maxHp += 10;
      p.maxMp += 5;
      p.hp = p.maxHp;
      p.mp = p.maxMp;
      p.attributes.str += 2;
      p.attributes.dex += 2;
      p.attributes.int += 2;
      p.attributes.vit += 2;
      p.attributes.lck += 1;
      
      this.log(`🌟 等级提升！现在是 Lv.${p.level}！`, 'quest');
      this.addEvent('🌟', '升级', `达到了 Lv.${p.level}`);
    }

    // Update quests
    this.updateQuestProgress('kill', combat.enemies.map(e => e.key));

    // Check achievements
    this.checkAchievements();

    // Save game
    this.saveGame();

    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('combat-overlay').classList.remove('active');
      this.state.combat = null;
      this.updateUI();
      this.updateQuestList();
    }, 1500);
  },

  // Combat defeat
  combatDefeat() {
    const combat = this.state.combat;
    const p = this.state.player;
    
    this.log('💀 你被击败了...', 'combat');
    this.log('💀 你失去了部分金币和XP...', 'combat');
    
    p.gold = Math.max(0, p.gold - Math.floor(p.gold * 0.1));
    p.xp = Math.max(0, p.xp - Math.floor(p.xpToNext * 0.2));
    p.hp = Math.floor(p.maxHp * 0.5);
    p.mp = Math.floor(p.maxMp * 0.5);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('combat-overlay').classList.remove('active');
      this.state.combat = null;
      this.updateUI();
    }, 2000);
  },

  // Calculate attack power
  calculateAttack() {
    const p = this.state.player;
    let atk = p.attributes.str + Math.floor(p.attributes.str / 2);
    
    // Equipment bonus
    if (p.equipment.weapon) {
      const weapon = this.worldData.items[p.equipment.weapon];
      if (weapon?.stats?.atk) atk += weapon.stats.atk;
    }
    
    // Buff bonus
    p.buffs.forEach(buff => {
      if (buff.stat === 'atk') atk += buff.value;
    });
    
    return atk;
  },

  // Update quest progress
  updateQuestProgress(objectiveType, target) {
    this.state.quests.forEach(quest => {
      const questData = this.worldData.quests[quest.id];
      if (!questData) return;
      
      questData.objectives.forEach(obj => {
        if (obj.type === objectiveType) {
          if (obj.type === 'kill') {
            if (target.includes(obj.target)) {
              obj.current = (obj.current || 0) + 1;
            }
          }
        }
      });
      
      // Check if quest is complete
      const complete = questData.objectives.every(obj => (obj.current || 0) >= (obj.count || 1));
      if (complete && !this.state.completedQuests.includes(quest.id)) {
        this.completeQuest(quest.id);
      }
    });
  },

  // Complete quest
  completeQuest(questId) {
    const questData = this.worldData.quests[questId];
    if (!questData) return;
    
    const p = this.state.player;
    p.xp += questData.rewards.xp || 0;
    p.gold += questData.rewards.gold || 0;
    
    if (questData.rewards.item) {
      this.addItem(questData.rewards.item);
      this.log(`🎁 获得了 ${this.worldData.items[questData.rewards.item]?.name || questData.rewards.item}！`, 'quest');
    }
    
    this.state.completedQuests.push(questId);
    this.state.quests = this.state.quests.filter(q => q.id !== questId);
    
    this.log(`📜 任务完成：${questData.title}！`, 'quest');
    this.addEvent('📜', '任务完成', questData.title);
    
    // Faction reputation
    if (questData.giver) {
      const loc = this.worldData.continents[this.state.world.currentContinent].regions[this.state.world.currentRegion].locations[questData.giver];
      if (loc?.faction) {
        this.state.factions[loc.faction] = Math.min(100, (this.state.factions[loc.faction] || 0) + 10);
      }
    }
    
    this.updateQuestList();
    this.checkAchievements();
    this.saveGame();
  },

  // Trigger random event
  triggerRandomEvent() {
    const events = [
      { icon: '🎲', title: '幸运抽奖', desc: '你发现了一个神秘的箱子...', effect: () => {
        const gold = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 10;
        this.state.player.gold += gold;
        this.log(`🎲 你获得了 ${gold} G！`, 'event');
      }},
      { icon: '🌟', title: '奇遇', desc: '你遇到了一位神秘的旅人...', effect: () => {
        this.state.player.attributes.lck += 1;
        this.log(`🌟 神秘旅人提升了你的幸运！LCK +1`, 'event');
      }},
      { icon: '⚡', title: '闪电击中', desc: '一道闪电击中了你！', effect: () => {
        this.state.player.hp = Math.max(1, this.state.player.hp - 10);
        this.log(`⚡ 你被闪电击中了！HP -10`, 'damage');
      }},
      { icon: '🍀', title: '幸运草', desc: '你发现了一株四叶草！', effect: () => {
        this.state.player.attributes.lck += 2;
        this.log(`🍀 你获得了四叶草！LCK +2`, 'event');
      }},
      { icon: '🏴‍☠️', title: '强盗袭击', desc: '一群强盗袭击了你！', effect: () => {
        this.startCombat(['bandit']);
      }}
    ];
    
    const event = events[Math.floor(Math.random() * events.length)];
    event.effect();
    this.addEvent(event.icon, event.title, event.desc);
  },

  // Add event
  addEvent(icon, title, desc) {
    this.state.events.push({ icon, title, desc, time: new Date().toLocaleString() });
    if (this.state.events.length > 50) {
      this.state.events.shift();
    }
    this.updateEventList();
  },

  // Check achievements
  checkAchievements() {
    Object.entries(this.worldData.achievements).forEach(([key, ach]) => {
      if (!this.state.achievements.includes(key) && ach.condition(this.state)) {

        this.log(`🏆 成就解锁：${ach.name}！

||---------------|------------------------|| Ground-based running | Aerial flight mechanics || Train tracks | Sky lanes with cloud corridors || Jump/roll/dodge | Pitch up/down, barrel roll, boost || Coin collection | Fuel orbs + cargo packages || Police chase | Storm cloud pursuit system |## Game Mechanics1. **Movement:** 3-lane horizontal system (left, center, right) + vertical pitch control2. **Actions:** - Swipe Up: Climb altitude - Swipe Down: Dive - Swipe Left/Right: Change lanes - Double Tap: Barrel roll (invincibility frame)3. **Obstacles:** - Other aircraft (must dodge) - Storm clouds (slowdown zone) - Bird flocks (damage) - Air traffic control towers - Turbulence zones4. **Collectibles:** - Fuel orbs (extend run time) - Cargo crates (bonus points) - Golden propellers (currency) - Power-ups: Turbo boost, Shield, Magnet## Visual Style- **Art Direction:** Low-poly stylized 3D (like Subway Surfers but aviation-themed)- **Color Palette:** Sky blues, sunset oranges, cloud whites, metallic grays- **Environment:** Dynamic skybox with day/night cycle, volumetric clouds- **Player Character:** Customizable pilot with different aircraft skins- **UI:** Minimalist HUD, altitude meter, fuel gauge, score counter## Technical Stack- **Engine:** Unity 2023 LTS or Three.js (for web-based)- **Language:** C# (Unity) or JavaScript/TypeScript (Three.js)- **Physics:** Custom arcade physics (not realistic flight sim)- **Platform:** Mobile (iOS/Android) + Web GL- **Performance:** 60 FPS target, LOD system for distant objects## Required Features1. **Main Menu:** Hangar scene structure- Player controller script with swipe gestures- Obstacle spawning system (object pooling)- Collision detection and damage system- UI manager (score, fuel, game over screen)- 3 sample aircraft models (placeholder or procedurally generated)- Background music + SFX placeholders## Unique Selling Points1. **Verticality:** Unlike Subway Surfers, players can change altitude2. **Aircraft Customization:** Wings, engines, paint jobs, contrail effects3. **Weather System:** Dynamic weather affects gameplay (rain = slippery, wind = lane drift)4. **Multiplayer Mode:** Real-time race against ghost data of other players# OutputGenerate the complete codebase structure, core gameplay scripts, and UI components. Include comments for easy customization. Make it modular for future feature additions.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>🛸 Jeu de l'Imposteur - Party Game</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka+One&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #6c5ce7;
            --secondary: #a29bfe;
            --accent: #fd79a8;
            --imposter: #e74c3c;
            --crewmate: #00b894;
            --dark: #2d3436;
            --light: #dfe6e9;
            --bg-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #0c0c1d 0%, #1a1a3e 50%, #2d1b69 100%);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-gradient);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: white;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        .stars {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .star {
            position: absolute;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: twinkle var(--duration) infinite;
        }

        @keyframes twinkle {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; }
            50% { opacity: 1; }
        }

        .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .screen {
            display: none;
            animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease;
        }

        .screen.active {
            display: block;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-30px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }

        @keyframes shake {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
            25% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
            75% { transform: translateX(5px); }
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        @keyframes glow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.5); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.8); }
        }

        h1 {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 3em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, #fd79a8, #6c5ce7, #00b894);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            text-shadow: none;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 2em;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--secondary);
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .subtitle {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 1.2em;
            color: var(--secondary);
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 15px 30px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: -100%;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent);
            transition: left 0.5s;
        }

        .btn:hover::before {
            left: 100%;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--crewmate), #00cec9);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-success:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 184, 148, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--imposter), #e17055);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-danger:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-center {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .grid-2 {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
        }

        .grid-3 {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        }

        .option-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .option-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-color: var(--secondary);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .option-card.selected {
            background: rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.3);
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.3);
        }

        .option-card .icon {
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            display: block;
        }

        .option-card .label {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1em;
        }

        .option-card .desc {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: var(--secondary);
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        .player-input {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .player-input input {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 200px;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: white;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1em;
            outline: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .player-input input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.3);
        }

        .player-input input::placeholder {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
        }

        .player-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .player-tag {
            background: rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.3);
            border: 1px solid var(--primary);
            border-radius: 50px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        .player-tag .remove {
            cursor: pointer;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }

        .player-tag .remove:hover {
            transform: scale(1.2);
        }

        .player-tag .color-dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .word-display {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .word-display .word {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            font-size: 3em;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin: 20px 0;
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        }

        .word-display .category-label {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            color: var(--secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
        }

        .role-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 10px 25px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }

        .role-crewmate {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--crewmate), #00cec9);
            color: white;
        }

        .role-imposter {
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--imposter), #e17055);
            color: white;
            animation: glow 2s infinite;
        }

        .timer {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 4em;
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .timer.warning {
            color: var(--imposter);
            animation: shake 0.5s infinite;
        }

        .vote-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 15px 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .vote-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-color: var(--primary);
            transform: translateX(5px);
        }

        .vote-card.voted {
            background: rgba(108, 92, 231, 0.3);
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .vote-card .vote-avatar {
            width: 45px;
            height: 45px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5em;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .vote-card .vote-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .vote-card .vote-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1em;
        }

        .vote-card .vote-count {
            color: var(--secondary);
            font-size: 0.9em;
        }

        .vote-card .vote-check {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .vote-card.voted .vote-check {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            border-radius: 10px;
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
        }

        .emoji-big {
            font-size: 5em;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
            animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .result-card {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 30px;
        }

        .result-card .winner {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .result-card .winner.imposter-win {
            color: var(--imposter);
        }

        .result-card .winner.crewmate-win {
            color: var(--crewmate);
        }

        .category-icon {
            font-size: 3em;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .language-flag {
            font-size: 2em;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .hidden {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .modal {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a3e, #2d1b69);
            border-radius: 25px;
            padding: 40px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modal h2 {
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .modal p {
            color: var(--secondary);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .settings-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 12px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .settings-row:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .settings-row label {
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .settings-row input[type="number"] {
            width: 80px;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1em;
            text-align: center;
            outline: none;
        }

        .settings-row input[type="number"]:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .tab-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 5px;
        }

        .tab {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 10px;
            text-align: center;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tab.active {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .tab:hover:not(.active) {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .discussion-box {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 15px 0;
            max-height: 300px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .discussion-message {
            padding: 10px 15px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        .discussion-message .msg-author {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .discussion-message .msg-text {
            color: var(--light);
        }

        .discussion-input {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .discussion-input input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            color: white;
            font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
            outline: none;
        }

        .discussion-input input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .discussion-input button {
            padding: 12px 25px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: var(--primary);

            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .discussion-input button:hover {
            background: var(--accent);

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));

            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .score-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .score-card .score-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .score-card .score-value {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            font-size: 2em;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .score-card .score-label {
            font-size: 0.85em;
            color: var(--secondary);
        }

        .imposter-reveal {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 30px;
        }

        .imposter-reveal .imposter-name {
            font-family: 'Fredoka One', cursive;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            color: var(--imposter);
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .confetti {
            position: fixed;

            left: 0;

            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;

            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            top: -10px;
            animation: confetti-fall var(--fall-duration) linear forwards;

                transform: rotate(var(--rotation)) translateX(var(--translate));

        .scrollable {

<body>
    <div class="stars" id="stars"></div>
    <div class="confetti" id="confetti"></div>

    <div class="container">
        <!-- SCREEN 1: Welcome -->
        <div class="screen active" id="screen-welcome">
            <div class="emoji-big">🛸</div>
            <h1>Jeu de l'Imposteur</h1>
            <p class="subtitle">Who is the imposter among us?</p>
            <div class="card">
                <h3>🌍 Select Language / Choisir la langue</h3>
                <div class="grid grid-3" id="language-grid">
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="fr" onclick="selectLanguage('fr')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇫🇷</span>
                        <span class="label">Français</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="en" onclick="selectLanguage('en')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇬🇧</span>
                        <span class="label">English</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="es" onclick="selectLanguage('es')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇪🇸</span>
                        <span class="label">Español</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="pt" onclick="selectLanguage('pt')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇧🇷</span>
                        <span class="label">Português</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="de" onclick="selectLanguage('de')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇩🇪</span>
                        <span class="label">Deutsch</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="option-card" data-lang="it" onclick="selectLanguage('it')">
                        <span class="language-flag">🇮🇹</span>
                        <span class="label">Italiano</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="btn-center">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-next-lang" onclick="goToScreen('screen-players')" disabled>
                        Next →
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SCREEN 2: Players -->
        <div class="screen" id="screen-players">
            <h2>👥 <span data-i18n="players_title">Add Players</span></h2>
            <div class="card">
                <div class="player-input">
                    <input type="text" id="player-name-input" placeholder="Enter player name..." onkeypress="if(event.key==='Enter')addPlayer()">
                    <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="addPlayer()">+ <span data-i18n="add">Add</span></button>
                </div>
                <div class="player-list" id="player-list"></div>
                <p style="color: var(--secondary); text-align: center; margin: 10px 0;">
                    <span data-i18n="min_players">Minimum 3 players required</span>
                </p>
                <div class="btn-center">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-next-players" onclick="goToScreen('screen-settings')" disabled>
                        Next →
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SCREEN 3: Settings -->
        <div class="screen" id="screen-settings">
            <h2>⚙️ <span data-i18n="settings">Settings</span></h2>
            <div class="card">
                <h3>📂 <span data-i18n="category">Category</span></h3>
                <div class="grid" id="category-grid"></div>
                <div class="btn-center" style="margin-top: 20px;">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-next-settings" onclick="startGame()" disabled>
                        🚀 <span data-i18n="start_game">Start Game</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SCREEN 4: Role Reveal -->
        <div class="screen" id="screen-reveal">
            <h2>🎭 <span data-i18n="role_reveal">Role Reveal</span></h2>
            <div class="card">
                <p style="text-align: center; color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 20px;" data-i18n="reveal_instruction">
                    Pass the device to each player to reveal their role
                </p>
                <div class="word-display" id="reveal-display">
                    <div class="category-label" id="reveal-category"></div>
                    <div class="word" id="reveal-word"></div>
                    <div class="role-badge" id="reveal-role"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="btn-center">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="nextReveal()">
                        <span data-i18n="next_player">Next Player →</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p style="text-align: center; color: var(--secondary); margin-top: 15px;" id="reveal-counter"></p>
            </div>

            discussionTime: 180,
            discussionTimer: null,
            currentVote: null,
            votes: {},
            scores: {},
            round: 1
        };

        const PLAYER_COLORS = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#9b59b6', '#1abc9c', '#e67e22', '#e91e63', '#00bcd4', '#8bc34a', '#ff5722', '#607d8b'];

            loadScores();

                star.style.top = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
                star.style.width = Math.random() * 3 + 'px';
                star.style.height = star.style.width;
                star.style.setProperty('--duration', (Math.random() * 3 + 2) + 's');
                starsContainer.appendChild(star);
            }

        function loadScores() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('imposter_scores');
            if (saved) {
                state.scores = JSON.parse(saved);
            }
