        function saveScores() {
            localStorage.setItem('imposter_scores', JSON.stringify(state.scores));
        }

        // ==================== LANGUAGE ====================
        function selectLanguage(lang) {
            state.language = lang;
            document.querySelectorAll('#language-grid .option-card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.toggle('selected', card.dataset.lang === lang);
            });
            document.getElementById('btn-next-lang').disabled = false;
            updateI18n();
        }

        function updateI18n() {
            const lang = GAME_DATA[state.language];
            if (!lang) return;
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (lang.i18n[key]) {
                    el.textContent = lang.i18n[key];
                }
            });
        }

        function t(key) {
            return GAME_DATA[state.language]?.i18n[key] || key;
        }

        // ==================== SCREENS ====================
        function goToScreen(screenId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
            document.getElementById(screenId).classList.add('active');

            if (screenId === 'screen-settings') {
                renderCategories();
            }
        }

        // ==================== PLAYERS ====================
        function addPlayer() {
            const input = document.getElementById('player-name-input');
            const name = input.value.trim();
            if (!name) return;
            if (state.players.length >= 12) {
                alert('Maximum 12 players!');
                return;
            }
            if (state.players.includes(name)) {
                alert('Player already exists!');
                return;
            }

            state.players.push(name);
            input.value = '';
            renderPlayerList();
            document.getElementById('btn-next-players').disabled = state.players.length < 3;
        }

        function removePlayer(index) {
            state.players.splice(index, 1);
            renderPlayerList();
            document.getElementById('btn-next-players').disabled = state.players.length < 3;
        }

        function renderPlayerList() {
            const list = document.getElementById('player-list');
            list.innerHTML = state.players.map((name, i) => `
                <div class="player-tag">
                    <span class="color-dot" style="background: ${PLAYER_COLORS[i % PLAYER_COLORS.length]}"></span>
                    <span>${name}</span>
                    <span class="remove" onclick="removePlayer(${i})">✕</span>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // ==================== CATEGORIES ====================
        function renderCategories() {
            const lang = GAME_DATA[state.language];
            const grid = document.getElementById('category-grid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            Object.keys(lang.categories).forEach(key => {
                const cat = lang.categories[key];
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'option-card';
                card.onclick = () => selectCategory(key);
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="category-icon">${cat.icon}</span>
                    <span class="label">${cat.name}</span>
                    <span class="desc">${cat.words.length} ${t('words') || 'words'}</span>
                `;
                card.dataset.category = key;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function selectCategory(key) {
            state.selectedCategory = key;
            document.querySelectorAll('#category-grid .option-card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.toggle('selected', card.dataset.category === key);
            });
            document.getElementById('btn-next-settings').disabled = false;
        }

        // ==================== GAME START ====================
        function startGame() {
            if (!state.selectedCategory) return;

            // Assign roles
            state.imposterIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * state.players.length);
            state.roles = state.players.map((_, i) => i === state.imposterIndex ? 'imposter' : 'crewmate');

            // Get words
            const lang = GAME_DATA[state.language];
            const category = lang.categories[state.selectedCategory];
            const words = [...category.words];
            shuffleArray(words);

            // Assign words to players
            state.playerWords = state.players.map((_, i) => {
                if (i === state.imposterIndex) {
                    // Imposter gets a different word
                    return words[words.length - 1]; // Last word for imposter
                }
                return words[i % (words.length - 1)];
            });

            state.currentRevealIndex = 0;
            showReveal();
            goToScreen('screen-reveal');
        }

        function showReveal() {
            const playerIndex = state.currentRevealIndex;
            const playerName = state.players[playerIndex];
            const word = state.playerWords[playerIndex];
            const role = state.roles[playerIndex];

            document.getElementById('reveal-category').textContent = GAME_DATA[state.language].categories[state.selectedCategory].name;
            document.getElementById('reveal-word').textContent = word;
            document.getElementById('reveal-role').textContent = t(role === 'imposter' ? 'imposter' : 'crewmate');
            document.getElementById('reveal-role').className = 'role-badge ' + (role === 'imposter' ? 'role-imposter' : 'role-crewmate');
            document.getElementById('reveal-counter').textContent = `${playerIndex + 1} / ${state.players.length}`;

            // Blur the word initially
            document.getElementById('reveal-word').style.filter = 'blur(10px)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.getElementById('reveal-word').style.filter = 'none';
            }, 500);
        }

        function nextReveal() {
            state.currentRevealIndex++;
            if (state.currentRevealIndex >= state.players.length) {
                startDiscussion();
            } else {
                showReveal();
            }
        }

        // ==================== DISCUSSION ====================
        function startDiscussion() {
            state.discussionTime = 180;
            state.votes = {};
            state.currentVote = null;
            state.discussionMessages = [];

            goToScreen('screen-discussion');
            updateTimerDisplay();
            startTimer();

            // Add initial messages
            addDiscussionMessage('System', t('describe_your_word'));
        }

        function startTimer() {
            if (state.discussionTimer) clearInterval(state.discussionTimer);
            state.discussionTimer = setInterval(() => {
                state.discussionTime--;
                updateTimerDisplay();
                if (state.discussionTime <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(state.discussionTimer);
                    startVoting();
                }
            }, 1000);
        }

        function updateTimerDisplay() {
            const minutes = Math.floor(state.discussionTime / 60);
            const seconds = state.discussionTime % 60;
            const timerEl = document.getElementById('discussion-timer');
            timerEl.textContent = `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;

            const progress = (state.discussionTime / 180) * 100;
            document.getElementById('discussion-progress').style.width = progress + '%';

            if (state.discussionTime <= 30) {
                timerEl.classList.add('warning');
            } else {
                timerEl.classList.remove('warning');
            }
        }

        function addDiscussionMessage(author, text) {
            state.discussionMessages.push({ author, text, time: Date.now() });
            const box = document.getElementById('discussion-box');
            const msg = document.createElement('div');
            msg.className = 'discussion-message';
            msg.innerHTML = `
                <div class="msg-author">${author}</div>
                <div class="msg-text">${text}</div>
            `;
            box.appendChild(msg);
            box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        }

        function sendDiscussion() {
            const input = document.getElementById('discussion-input');
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;

            // Use current player's name (simplified - in real game would track who's speaking)
            const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentRevealIndex] || state.players[0];
            addDiscussionMessage(currentPlayer, text);
            input.value = '';
        }

        // ==================== VOTING ====================
        function startVoting() {
            if (state.discussionTimer) clearInterval(state.discussionTimer);

            goToScreen('screen-voting');
            renderVotingList();
        }

        function renderVotingList() {
            const list = document.getElementById('voting-list');
            list.innerHTML = state.players.map((player, i) => `
                <div class="vote-card" onclick="selectVote(${i})" id="vote-${i}">
                    <div class="vote-avatar" style="background: ${PLAYER_COLORS[i % PLAYER_COLORS.length]}">
                        ${player.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div class="vote-info">
                        <div class="vote-name">${player}</div>
                        <div class="vote-count">${state.votes[i] || 0} ${t('votes')}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="vote-check">✅</div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function selectVote(index) {
            state.currentVote = index;
            document.querySelectorAll('.vote-card').forEach(card => card.classList.remove('voted'));
            document.getElementById(`vote-${index}`).classList.add('voted');
            document.getElementById('btn-submit-vote').disabled = false;
        }

        function submitVote() {
            if (state.currentVote === null) return;

            // Simulate votes from all players
            state.votes = {};
            state.players.forEach((_, i) => {
                // Each player votes for a random different player
                let voteTarget = Math.floor(Math.random() * state.players.length);
                while (voteTarget === i) {
                    voteTarget = Math.floor(Math.random() * state.players.length);
                }
                state.votes[voteTarget] = (state.votes[voteTarget] || 0) + 1;
            });

            // Ensure the current player's vote is counted
            state.votes[state.currentVote] = (state.votes[state.currentVote] || 0) + 1;

            // Find who got most votes
            let maxVotes = 0;
            let eliminated = -1;
            Object.keys(state.votes).forEach(key => {
                if (state.votes[key] > maxVotes) {
                    maxVotes = state.votes[key];
                    eliminated = parseInt(key);
                }
            });

            showResults(eliminated);
        }

        // ==================== RESULTS ====================
        function showResults(eliminated) {
            goToScreen('screen-results');

            const imposterWas = eliminated === state.imposterIndex;
            const crewmatesWon = !imposterWas;

            document.getElementById('result-emoji').textContent = crewmatesWon ? '🎉' : '😈';
            document.getElementById('result-text').textContent = crewmatesWon ? t('crewmates_won') : t('imposter_won');
            document.getElementById('result-text').className = 'winner ' + (crewmatesWon ? 'crewmate-win' : 'imposter-win');

            document.getElementById('imposter-reveal').innerHTML = `
                <p style="color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 10px;">${t('imposter_was')}</p>
                <div class="imposter-name">${state.players[state.imposterIndex]} 🛸</div>
                <p style="color: var(--secondary);">${state.players[eliminated]} ${t('imposter_was')} ${eliminated === state.imposterIndex ? t('crewmate') : '❌'}</p>
            `;

            // Update scores
            if (!state.scores[state.players[state.imposterIndex]]) {
                state.scores[state.players[state.imposterIndex]] = { imposter: 0, crewmate: 0 };
            }
            if (!state.scores[state.players[eliminated]]) {
                state.scores[state.players[eliminated]] = { imposter: 0, crewmate: 0 };
            }

            if (imposterWas) {
                state.scores[state.players[eliminated]].crewmate++;
            } else {
                state.scores[state.players[state.imposterIndex]].imposter++;
            }

            saveScores();
            createConfetti();
        }

        function createConfetti() {
            const container = document.getElementById('confetti');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const colors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#9b59b6', '#e91e63', '#00bcd4'];

            for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                const piece = document.createElement('div');
                piece.className = 'confetti-piece';
                piece.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
                piece.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                piece.style.setProperty('--fall-duration', (Math.random() * 2 + 2) + 's');
                piece.style.setProperty('--rotation', (Math.random() * 720) + 'deg');
                piece.style.setProperty('--translate', (Math.random() * 200 - 100) + 'px');
                piece.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 2 + 's';
                container.appendChild(piece);
            }

            setTimeout(() => { container.innerHTML = ''; }, 5000);
        }

        // ==================== GAME FLOW ====================
        function newRound() {
            state.selectedCategory = null;
            state.imposterIndex = -1;
            state.currentRevealIndex = 0;
            state.currentVote = null;
            state.votes = {};
            state.round++;
            goToScreen('screen-settings');
        }

        function resetGame() {
            state.players = [];
            state.selectedCategory = null;
            state.imposterIndex = -1;
            state.currentRevealIndex = 0;
            state.currentVote = null;
            state.votes = {};
            state.round = 1;
            state.playerWords = [];
            state.roles = [];
            state.discussionMessages = [];
            if (state.discussionTimer) clearInterval(state.discussionTimer);
            renderPlayerList();
            document.getElementById('btn-next-players').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('btn-next-settings').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('btn-next-lang').disabled = true;
            goToScreen('screen-welcome');
        }

        // ==================== UTILITIES ====================
        function shuffleArray(array) {
            for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
            }
            return array;
        }

        // ==================== INIT ====================
        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Caveat:wght@400;700&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0f0f1a;
            --bg-secondary: #1a1a2e;
            --bg-card: #16213e;
            --accent-1: #e94560;
            --accent-2: #ff6b6b;
            --accent-3: #feca57;
            --accent-4: #48dbfb;
            --accent-5: #ff9ff3;
            --text-primary: #f5f5f5;
            --text-secondary: #a0a0b0;
            --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Animated background */
        .bg-animation {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .bg-animation .orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            opacity: 0.3;
            animation: float 20s infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        .orb:nth-child(1) {
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: var(--accent-1);
            top: -100px;
            left: -100px;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .orb:nth-child(2) {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: var(--accent-4);
            top: 50%;
            right: -100px;
            animation-delay: -5s;
        }

        .orb:nth-child(3) {
            width: 350px;
            height: 350px;
            background: var(--accent-5);
            bottom: -100px;
            left: 30%;
            animation-delay: -10s;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            25% { transform: translate(50px, -50px) scale(1.1); }
            50% { transform: translate(-30px, 30px) scale(0.9); }
            75% { transform: translate(40px, 20px) scale(1.05); }
        }

        .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 20px;

                    <p>Voici le résultat de votre cadavre exquis !</p>
                </div>

                <div class="story-card" id="storyCard">
                    <!-- Phrases will be inserted here -->
                </div>

                <div class="reveal-actions">
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="copyStory()">📋 Copier</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="playAgain()">🔄 Rejouer</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Pass device modal -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="passModal">
        <div class="modal">
            <div class="icon">📱</div>
            <h2>Passer la main !</h2>
            <p id="modalMessage">Transmettez l'appareil au prochain joueur</p>
            <div class="player-name-display" id="modalPlayerName">Joueur 1</div>
            <br>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeModal()">
                ✅ C'est parti !
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Confetti container -->
    <div class="confetti-container" id="confettiContainer"></div>

    <script>
        // Game state
        let gameState = {
            players: [],
            currentPlayerIndex: 0,
            phrases: [],
            playerCount: 3,
            gameStarted: false
        };

        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            updatePlayerNamesInput();
            setupPlayerCountSelector();
            setupPhraseInput();
        });

        function setupPlayerCountSelector() {
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.player-count-btn');
            buttons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    buttons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
                    btn.classList.add('selected');
                    gameState.playerCount = parseInt(btn.dataset.count);
                    updatePlayerNamesInput();
                });
            });
        }

        function updatePlayerNamesInput() {
            const container = document.getElementById('playerNamesInput');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            const defaultNames = [
                'Joueur 1', 'Joueur 2', 'Joueur 3', 'Joueur 4',
                'Joueur 5', 'Joueur 6', 'Joueur 7', 'Joueur 8'
            ];

            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.playerCount; i++) {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'player-name-input';
                div.style.animationDelay = `${i * 0.1}s`;
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="player-number">${i + 1}</div>
                    <input 
                        type="text" 
                        placeholder="${defaultNames[i]}" 
                        maxlength="20"
                        data-index="${i}"
                    >
                `;
                container.appendChild(div);
            }
        }

        function setupPhraseInput() {
            const input = document.getElementById('phraseInput');
            const charCount = document.getElementById('charCount');
            
            input.addEventListener('input', () => {
                charCount.textContent = input.value.length;
            });

            input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) {
                    submitPhrase();
                }
            });
        }

        function startGame() {
            // Collect player names
            const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('.player-name-input input');
            gameState.players = [];
            
            inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
                const name = input.value.trim() || `Joueur ${index + 1}`;
                gameState.players.push(name);
            });

            gameState.phrases = [];
            gameState.currentPlayerIndex = 0;
            gameState.gameStarted = true;

            // Show pass modal for first player
            showPassModal(0);
        }

        function showPassModal(playerIndex) {
            const modal = document.getElementById('passModal');
            const playerName = document.getElementById('modalPlayerName');
            const message = document.getElementById('modalMessage');

            playerName.textContent = gameState.players[playerIndex];
            
            if (playerIndex === 0) {
                message.textContent = "C'est à toi de commencer ! Écris la première phrase de l'histoire.";
            } else {
                message.textContent = `C'est à ${gameState.players[playerIndex]} de jouer !`;
            }

            modal.classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('passModal');
            modal.classList.remove('active');
            
            if (gameState.currentPlayerIndex === 0) {
                showGameScreen();
            } else {
                showGameScreen();
            }
        }

        function showGameScreen() {
            // Switch screens
            document.getElementById('welcomeScreen').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('revealScreen').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('gameScreen').classList.add('active');

            updateGameUI();
        }

        function updateGameUI() {
            const playerIndex = gameState.currentPlayerIndex;
            const playerCount = gameState.players.length;

            // Update turn indicator
            document.getElementById('turnText').textContent = 
                `Tour de ${gameState.players[playerIndex]} (${playerIndex + 1}/${playerCount})`;

            // Update progress
            const progress = (playerIndex / playerCount) * 100;
            document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = `${progress}%`;
            document.getElementById('progressText').textContent = 
                `${playerIndex} / ${playerCount} phrases`;

            // Update previous phrase
            const prevPhraseEl = document.getElementById('previousPhrase');
            if (playerIndex > 0) {
                prevPhraseEl.textContent = gameState.phrases[playerIndex - 1];
                prevPhraseEl.classList.add('blurred');
                prevPhraseEl.classList.remove('revealed');
            } else {
                prevPhraseEl.textContent = '✨ Commencez l\'histoire !';
                prevPhraseEl.classList.remove('blurred');
                prevPhraseEl.classList.add('revealed');
            }

            // Update history
            updateHistory();

            // Clear input
            document.getElementById('phraseInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('charCount').textContent = '0';

            // Focus input
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.getElementById('phraseInput').focus();
            }, 300);
        }

        function updateHistory() {
            const historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');
            historyList.innerHTML = '';

            const colors = ['#e94560', '#48dbfb', '#ff9ff3', '#feca57', '#2ed573', '#74b9ff', '#ff6b6b', '#a29bfe'];

            gameState.phrases.forEach((phrase, index) => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'history-phrase';
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="author-badge" style="background: ${colors[index % colors.length]}">
                        ${gameState.players[index].charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div class="phrase-text">${phrase}</div>
                `;
                historyList.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        function submitPhrase() {
            const input = document.getElementById('phraseInput');
            const phrase = input.value.trim();

            if (!phrase) {
                input.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-1)';
                input.style.animation = 'pulse 0.5s ease';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    input.style.borderColor = '';
                    input.style.animation = '';
                }, 1000);
                return;
            }

            // Save phrase
            gameState.phrases.push(phrase);
            gameState.currentPlayerIndex++;

            // Check if game is over
            if (gameState.currentPlayerIndex >= gameState.players.length) {
                showRevealScreen();
            } else {
                // Show pass modal for next player
                showPassModal(gameState.currentPlayerIndex);
            }
        }

        function skipPhrase() {
            // Add a default phrase
            const defaults = [
                "Tout à coup, quelque chose d'étrange s'est produit.",
                "Personne ne s'attendait à ce qui allait se passer ensuite.",
                "C'est alors que la situation a complètement basculé.",
                "Soudain, un bruit étrange a retenti dans la pièce.",
                "Il a réalisé que tout allait changer pour toujours.",
                "La réponse était plus simple qu'ils ne l'auraient cru.",
                "Et c'est ainsi que tout a commencé.",
                "Personne n'aurait pu prévoir la fin de cette histoire."
            ];
            
            const randomDefault = defaults[Math.floor(Math.random() * defaults.length)];
            gameState.phrases.push(randomDefault);
            gameState.currentPlayerIndex++;

            if (gameState.currentPlayerIndex >= gameState.players.length) {
                showRevealScreen();
            } else {
                showPassModal(gameState.currentPlayerIndex);
            }
        }

        function showRevealScreen() {
            // Switch screens
            document.getElementById('gameScreen').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('revealScreen').classList.add('active');

            // Build story
            const storyCard = document.getElementById('storyCard');
            storyCard.innerHTML = '';

            const colors = ['#e94560', '#48dbfb', '#ff9ff3', '#feca57', '#2ed573', '#74b9ff', '#ff6b6b', '#a29bfe'];

            gameState.phrases.forEach((phrase, index) => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'story-phrase';
                div.setAttribute('data-author', gameState.players[index]);
                div.textContent = phrase;
                storyCard.appendChild(div);

                // Animate each phrase appearing
                setTimeout(() => {
                    div.classList.add('visible');
                }, 300 + (index * 400));
            });

            // Add final text
            const finalDiv = document.createElement('div');
            finalDiv.className = 'story-final';
            finalDiv.textContent = '— Fin du cadavre exquis —';
            storyCard.appendChild(finalDiv);

            setTimeout(() => {
                finalDiv.classList.add('visible');
                launchConfetti();
            }, 300 + (gameState.phrases.length * 400) + 500);
        }

        function launchConfetti() {
            const container = document.getElementById('confettiContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            const colors = ['#e94560', '#48dbfb', '#ff9ff3', '#feca57', '#2ed573', '#74b9ff', '#ff6b6b', '#a29bfe', '#fff'];
            const shapes = ['■', '●', '▲', '★', '♦', '❤'];

            for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                const confetti = document.createElement('div');
                confetti.className = 'confetti';
                confetti.textContent = shapes[Math.floor(Math.random() * shapes.length)];
                confetti.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
                confetti.style.color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                confetti.style.fontSize = (Math.random() * 20 + 10) + 'px';
                confetti.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 3 + 2) + 's';
                confetti.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 2 + 's';
                container.appendChild(confetti);
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                container.innerHTML = '';
            }, 6000);
        }

        function copyStory() {
            let story = '📝 Cadavre Exquis 📝\n\n';
            gameState.phrases.forEach((phrase, index) => {
                story += `${gameState.players[index]}: ${phrase}\n`;
            });
            story += '\n— Fin du cadavre exquis —';

            navigator.clipboard.writeText(story).then(() => {
                const btn = event.target;
                const originalText = btn.textContent;
                btn.textContent = '✅ Copié !';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.textContent = originalText;
                }, 2000);
            }).catch(() => {
                // Fallback
                const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
                textarea.value = story;
                document.body.appendChild(textarea);
                textarea.select();
                document.execCommand('copy');
                document.body.removeChild(textarea);
                
                const btn = event.target;
                const originalText = btn.textContent;
                btn.textContent = '✅ Copié !';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.textContent = originalText;
                }, 2000);
            });
        }

        function playAgain() {
            // Reset state
            gameState = {
                players: [],
                currentPlayerIndex: 0,
                phrases: [],
                playerCount: 3,
                gameStarted: false
            };

            // Switch screens
            document.getElementById('revealScreen').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('welcomeScreen').classList.add('active');

            // Reset player names
            updatePlayerNamesInput();
        }

        // Add some keyboard shortcuts
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                const modal = document.getElementById('passModal');
                if (modal.classList.contains('active')) {
                    closeModal();
                }
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Doodle Jump Clone</title>
<style>
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', cursive;
}
canvas {
    border: 3px solid #333;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    max-height: 100vh;
    max-width: 100vw;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// Responsive canvas
const MAX_WIDTH = 400;
const MAX_HEIGHT = 600;
canvas.width = MAX_WIDTH;
canvas.height = MAX_HEIGHT;

// Game state
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('doodleJumpHighScore')) || 0;
let cameraY = 0;
let difficulty = 1;

// Audio context for sound effects
let audioCtx = null;
function initAudio() {
    if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    }
}

function playSound(freq, duration, type = 'square', volume = 0.15) {
    if (!audioCtx) return;
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playJumpSound() {
    playSound(400, 0.1, 'sine', 0.1);
    playSound(600, 0.15, 'sine', 0.08);
}

function playSpringSound() {
    playSound(300, 0.1, 'sine', 0.12);
    playSound(500, 0.1, 'sine', 0.1);
    playSound(700, 0.15, 'sine', 0.08);
}

function playBreakSound() {
    playSound(150, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.08);
}

function playGameOverSound() {
    playSound(300, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.1);
    setTimeout(() => playSound(200, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.1), 150);
    setTimeout(() => playSound(100, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.1), 300);
}

// Doodle player
const player = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: canvas.height - 100,
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    speed: 6,
    jumpForce: -13,
    springJumpForce: -22,
    gravity: 0.45,
    facing: 1, // 1 = right, -1 = left
    onSpring: false,
    legAnimation: 0,
    trail: []
};

// Platforms
let platforms = [];
const PLATFORM_TYPES = {
    NORMAL: 'normal',
    MOVING: 'moving',
    BREAKABLE: 'breakable',
    SPRING: 'spring',
    VIOLET: 'violet'
};

class Platform {
    constructor(x, y, type = PLATFORM_TYPES.NORMAL) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = 70;
        this.height = 15;
        this.type = type;
        this.speed = type === PLATFORM_TYPES.MOVING ? (2 + Math.random() * 2) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) : 0;
        this.broken = false;
        this.breakAnimation = 0;
        this.springActive = false;
        this.springTimer = 0;
    }

    update() {
        if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.MOVING && !this.broken) {
            this.x += this.speed;
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= canvas.width) {
                this.speed *= -1;
            }
        }
        if (this.broken) {
            this.breakAnimation += 0.1;
        }
        if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.SPRING) {
            if (this.springTimer > 0) {
                this.springTimer--;
                if (this.springTimer <= 0) {
                    this.springActive = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    draw() {
        if (this.broken && this.breakAnimation > 2) return;

        ctx.save();
        if (this.broken) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - this.breakAnimation / 2;
            ctx.translate(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.breakAnimation * 5);
            ctx.rotate(this.breakAnimation * 0.5);
            ctx.translate(-(this.x + this.width / 2), -(this.y + this.breakAnimation * 5));
        }

        // Platform shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
        ctx.fillRect(this.x + 3, this.y + 3, this.width, this.height);

        if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.NORMAL) {
            // Green platform
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#5DA830';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y + this.height - 4, this.width, 4);
            // Highlight
            ctx.fillStyle = '#9FE870';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x + 2, this.y + 2, this.width - 4, 3);
            // Doodle outline
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
        } else if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.MOVING) {
            // Blue moving platform
            ctx.fillStyle = '#5BA3D9';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3A7CB8';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y + this.height - 4, this.width, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7BC3F0';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x + 2, this.y + 2, this.width - 4, 3);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#2A5C88';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            // Arrow indicators
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '12px Comic Sans MS';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('↔', this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + 11);
        } else if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.BREAKABLE) {
            // Brown breakable platform
            ctx.fillStyle = '#C4883C';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#8B5E3C';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y + this.height - 4, this.width, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A85C';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x + 2, this.y + 2, this.width - 4, 3);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#5A3A1A';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            // Crack lines
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#5A3A1A';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(this.x + this.width * 0.3, this.y);
            ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width * 0.4, this.y + this.height * 0.5);
            ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width * 0.35, this.y + this.height);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(this.x + this.width * 0.7, this.y);
            ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width * 0.6, this.y + this.height * 0.6);
            ctx.stroke();
        } else if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.SPRING) {
            // Green platform with spring
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#5DA830';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y + this.height - 4, this.width, 4);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);

            // Spring
            const springX = this.x + this.width / 2 - 8;
            const springY = this.y - 15;
            const springH = this.springActive ? 5 : 15;

            ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6B6B';
            ctx.fillRect(springX, springY + springH, 16, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4444';
            // Spring coils
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                ctx.fillRect(springX + 2, springY + springH - i * 5 - 3, 12, 3);
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#CC0000';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.strokeRect(springX, springY + springH, 16, 5);
        } else if (this.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.VIOLET) {
            // Violet platform (extra bouncy)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#9B59B6';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#7D3C98';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y + this.height - 4, this.width, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#BB7DD6';
            ctx.fillRect(this.x + 2, this.y + 2, this.width - 4, 3);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#5B2C6F';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            // Star symbol
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '10px Comic Sans MS';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('★', this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + 11);
        }

        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Particles
let particles = [];

class Particle {
    constructor(x, y, color, type = 'jump') {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.color = color;
        this.type = type;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
        this.vy = Math.random() * -3 - 1;
        this.life = 1;
        this.decay = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03;
        this.size = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
    }

    update() {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;
        this.vy += 0.1;
        this.life -= this.decay;
    }

    draw() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = this.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Monsters
let monsters = [];

class Monster {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = 50;
        this.height = 50;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        this.vy = 0;
        this.alive = true;
        this.animationTimer = 0;
        this.type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'flyer' : 'walker';
    }

    update() {
        this.animationTimer += 0.05;
        if (this.type === 'flyer') {
            this.x += this.vx;
            this.y += Math.sin(this.animationTimer) * 0.5;
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= canvas.width) {
                this.vx *= -1;
            }
        } else {
            this.x += this.vx;
            if (this.x <= 0 || this.x + this.width >= canvas.width) {
                this.vx *= -1;
            }
        }
    }

    draw() {
        if (!this.alive) return;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height / 2);

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, this.width / 2, this.height / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#C0392B';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-8, -8, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(8, -8, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Pupils
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-6, -8, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(10, -8, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Mouth
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#C0392B';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 5, 10, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Teeth
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        for (let i = -8; i <= 8; i += 4) {
            ctx.fillRect(i - 1, 5, 3, 5);
        }

        // Legs
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#C0392B';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        const legAnim = Math.sin(this.animationTimer * 3) * 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-15, 20);
        ctx.lineTo(-20 + legAnim, 35);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(15, 20);
        ctx.lineTo(20 - legAnim, 35);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Initialize platforms
function generatePlatforms() {
    platforms = [];
    monsters = [];

    // Starting platform
    platforms.push(new Platform(canvas.width / 2 - 35, canvas.height - 50, PLATFORM_TYPES.NORMAL));

    // Generate initial platforms
    let y = canvas.height - 150;
    while (y > -200) {
        y -= 60 + Math.random() * 40;
        const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 70);
        const type = getRandomPlatformType();
        platforms.push(new Platform(x, y, type));
    }
}

function getRandomPlatformType() {
    const rand = Math.random();
    const diff = Math.min(difficulty, 5);

    if (rand < 0.5) return PLATFORM_TYPES.NORMAL;
    if (rand < 0.7) return PLATFORM_TYPES.MOVING;
    if (rand < 0.85) return PLATFORM_TYPES.BREAKABLE;
    if (rand < 0.95) return PLATFORM_TYPES.SPRING;
    return PLATFORM_TYPES.VIOLET;
}

function generateMorePlatforms() {
    const highestPlatform = Math.min(...platforms.map(p => p.y));
    while (highestPlatform > cameraY - 200) {
        const y = highestPlatform - (60 + Math.random() * 40);
        const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 70);
        const type = getRandomPlatformType();
        platforms.push(new Platform(x, y, type));
        highestPlatform = y;

        // Chance to spawn monster
        if (Math.random() < 0.05 * difficulty && y < cameraY + canvas.height) {
            monsters.push(new Monster(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 50), y - 80));
        }
    }
}

function cleanupPlatforms() {
    platforms = platforms.filter(p => p.y < cameraY + canvas.height + 100 && !p.broken);
    monsters = monsters.filter(m => m.y < cameraY + canvas.height + 100 && m.alive);
}

// Input handling
const keys = {};
let touchLeft = false;
let touchRight = false;

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (gameState === 'menu' || gameState === 'gameover') {
        if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
            initAudio();
            startGame();
        }
    }
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.key] = false;
});

// Touch controls
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    initAudio();
    if (gameState === 'menu' || gameState === 'gameover') {
        startGame();
        return;
    }
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (touch.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    if (x < canvas.width / 2) {
        touchLeft = true;
        touchRight = false;
    } else {
        touchRight = true;
        touchLeft = false;
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (touch.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    if (x < canvas.width / 2) {
        touchLeft = true;
        touchRight = false;
    } else {
        touchRight = true;
        touchLeft = false;
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchLeft = false;
    touchRight = false;
});

// Mouse controls
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    initAudio();
    if (gameState === 'menu' || gameState === 'gameover') {
        startGame();
        return;
    }
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    if (x < canvas.width / 2) {
        touchLeft = true;
        touchRight = false;
    } else {
        touchRight = true;
        touchLeft = false;
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    touchLeft = false;
    touchRight = false;
});

function startGame() {
    gameState = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    cameraY = 0;
    difficulty = 1;
    player.x = canvas.width / 2 - player.width / 2;
    player.y = canvas.height - 100;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onSpring = false;
    player.trail = [];
    particles = [];
    generatePlatforms();
}

// Collision detection
function checkCollision(rect1, rect2) {
    return rect1.x < rect2.x + rect2.width &&
           rect1.x + rect1.width > rect2.x &&
           rect1.y < rect2.y + rect2.height &&
           rect1.y + rect1.height > rect2.y;
}

// Update game
function update() {
    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

    // Input
    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || touchLeft) {
        player.vx = -player.speed;
        player.facing = -1;
    } else if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || touchRight) {
        player.vx = player.speed;
        player.facing = 1;
    } else {
        player.vx *= 0.8;
    }

    // Physics
    player.vy += player.gravity;
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // Screen wrapping
    if (player.x + player.width < 0) {
        player.x = canvas.width;
    } else if (player.x > canvas.width) {
        player.x = -player.width;
    }

    // Trail
    if (player.vy < 0) {
        player.trail.push({ x: player.x + player.width / 2, y: player.y + player.height, life: 1 });
    }
    player.trail = player.trail.filter(t => {
        t.life -= 0.05;
        t.y += 1;
        return t.life > 0;
    });

    // Platform collision (only when falling)
    if (player.vy > 0) {
        for (const platform of platforms) {
            if (platform.broken) continue;

            const playerBottom = player.y + player.height;
            const playerPrevBottom = playerBottom - player.vy;

            if (player.x + player.width > platform.x + 5 &&
                player.x < platform.x + platform.width - 5 &&
                playerBottom >= platform.y &&
                playerPrevBottom <= platform.y + 5) {

                if (platform.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.BREAKABLE) {
                    platform.broken = true;
                    platform.breakAnimation = 0;
                    playBreakSound();
                    // Break particles
                    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        particles.push(new Particle(
                            platform.x + Math.random() * platform.width,
                            platform.y,
                            '#C4883C',
                            'break'
                        ));
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                player.y = platform.y - player.height;
                player.vy = player.jumpForce;
                playJumpSound();

                // Jump particles
                for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    particles.push(new Particle(
                        player.x + player.width / 2,
                        player.y + player.height,
                        '#7EC850',
                        'jump'
                    ));
                }

                // Spring platform
                if (platform.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.SPRING) {
                    player.vy = player.springJumpForce;
                    platform.springActive = true;
                    platform.springTimer = 20;
                    playSpringSound();
                    // Extra spring particles
                    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                        particles.push(new Particle(
                            platform.x + platform.width / 2,
                            platform.y - 10,
                            '#FF6B6B',
                            'spring'
                        ));
                    }
                }

                // Violet platform (extra bouncy)
                if (platform.type === PLATFORM_TYPES.VIOLET) {
                    player.vy = player.springJumpForce * 0.9;
                    playSpringSound();
                }

                player.onSpring = false;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Monster collision
    for (const monster of monsters) {
        if (!monster.alive) continue;

        if (checkCollision(player, monster)) {
            // Jump on top to kill monster
            if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - 10 < monster.y + monster.height / 2) {
                monster.alive = false;
                player.vy = player.jumpForce * 1.2;
                playJumpSound();
                score += 50;
                // Death particles
                for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                    particles.push(new Particle(
                        monster.x + monster.width / 2,
                        monster.y + monster.height / 2,
                        '#E74C3C',
                        'monster'
                    ));
                }
            } else {
                // Player dies
                gameState = 'gameover';
                playGameOverSound();
                if (score > highScore) {
                    highScore = score;
                    localStorage.setItem('doodleJumpHighScore', highScore);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // Camera follow
    if (player.y < cameraY + canvas.height * 0.4) {
        const diff = cameraY + canvas.height * 0.4 - player.y;
        cameraY = player.y;
        score += Math.floor(diff / 10);
        difficulty = 1 + Math.floor(score / 500) * 0.5;
    }

    // Generate more platforms
    generateMorePlatforms();
    cleanupPlatforms();

    // Update platforms
    for (const platform of platforms) {
        platform.update();
    }

    // Update monsters
    for (const monster of monsters) {
        monster.update();
    }

    // Update particles
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.update();
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    // Game over - fell below screen
    if (player.y > cameraY + canvas.height + 50) {
        gameState = 'gameover';
        playGameOverSound();
        if (score > highScore) {
            highScore = score;
            localStorage.setItem('doodleJumpHighScore', highScore);
        }
    }

    // Leg animation
    player.legAnimation += 0.2;
}

// Draw doodle character
function drawPlayer() {
    ctx.save();

    const screenX = player.x;
    const screenY = player.y - cameraY;

    ctx.translate(screenX + player.width / 2, screenY + player.height / 2);
    ctx.scale(player.facing, 1);

    // Trail
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.save();
    for (const t of player.trail) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = t.life * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(t.x, t.y - cameraY, 3 * t.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(screenX + player.width / 2, screenY + player.height / 2);
    ctx.scale(player.facing, 1);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 18, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Belly
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9FE870';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 3, 12, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-6, -8, 7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.ellipse(6, -8, 7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Pupils - look in movement direction
    const pupilOffset = player.vx * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-5 + pupilOffset, -8, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(7 + pupilOffset, -8, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eye shine
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-4 + pupilOffset, -10, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(8 + pupilOffset, -10, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Nose/snout
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5DA830';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 4, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (player.vy < -5) {
        // Open mouth when jumping up
        ctx.arc(0, 8, 5, 0, Math.PI);
    } else {
        // Smile
        ctx.arc(0, 6, 4, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const legAnim = Math.sin(player.legAnimation) * (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? 8 : 2);

    // Left leg
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-8, 15);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-12 + legAnim, 22, -10 + legAnim, 28);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Right leg
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(8, 15);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(12 - legAnim, 22, 10 - legAnim, 28);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Feet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5DA830';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-10 + legAnim, 28, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(10 - legAnim, 28, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    const armAnim = Math.sin(player.legAnimation + Math.PI) * 5;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-15, -5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-22, 0 + armAnim, -20, 8 + armAnim);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(15, -5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(22, 0 - armAnim, 20, 8 - armAnim);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
}

// Draw background
function drawBackground() {
    // Gradient background
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.5, '#B0E0E6');
    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#E0F7FA');
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Grid pattern (notebook paper style)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const gridSize = 30;
    const offsetY = cameraY % gridSize;

    for (let y = -gridSize + offsetY; y < canvas.height; y += gridSize) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += gridSize) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Clouds
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
    const cloudOffset = cameraY * 0.1;
    drawCloud(50, 100 - cloudOffset % 300);
    drawCloud(250, 200 - cloudOffset % 300);
    drawCloud(150, 350 - cloudOffset % 300);
    drawCloud(320, 50 - cloudOffset % 300);
}

function drawCloud(x, y) {
    if (y < -50 || y > canvas.height + 50) return;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 25, y - 10, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 50, y, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 25, y + 5, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
}

// Draw UI
function drawUI() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 150, 35);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 35);

    // High score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(canvas.width - 160, 10, 150, 35);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + highScore, canvas.width - 20, 35);
}

// Draw menu
function drawMenu() {
    drawBackground();

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, 150);

    // Title shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Doodle Jump', 3, 3);

    // Title text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
    ctx.fillText('Doodle Jump', 0, 0);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeText('Doodle Jump', 0, 0);

    ctx.restore();

    // Doodle character on menu
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, 280);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 25, 30, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Belly
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9FE870';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 5, 16, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-8, -10, 10, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.ellipse(8, -10, 10, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-6, -10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(10, -10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-5, -12, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(11, -12, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Nose
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5DA830';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 5, 5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 10, 6, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '20px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or TAP to start', canvas.width / 2, 400);

    ctx.font = '16px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#CCC';
    ctx.fillText('Use ← → arrows or touch sides', canvas.width / 2, 440);
    ctx.fillText('to move left/right', canvas.width / 2, 465);

    // High score
    if (highScore > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.font = 'bold 18px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
        ctx.fillText('High Score: ' + highScore, canvas.width / 2, 520);
    }
}

// Draw game over
function drawGameOver() {
    drawBackground();

    // Overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Game over box
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 120, 150, 240, 250, 20);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Game over text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Game Over!', canvas.width / 2, 200);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = '24px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, 260);

    // High score
    if (score >= highScore && score > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
        ctx.fillText('🎉 New High Score! 🎉', canvas.width / 2, 300);
    } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
        ctx.font = '18px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
        ctx.fillText('Best: ' + highScore, canvas.width / 2, 300);
    }

    // Restart button
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 80, 340, 160, 45, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A6B18';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.fillText('Play Again', canvas.width / 2, 370);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    ctx.font = '14px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or TAP', canvas.width / 2, 420);
}

// Main game loop
function gameLoop() {
    update();

    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        drawMenu();
    } else if (gameState === 'playing') {
        drawBackground();

        // Draw platforms
        for (const platform of platforms) {
            const screenY = platform.y - cameraY;
            if (screenY > -50 && screenY < canvas.height + 50) {
                platform.draw();
            }
        }

        // Draw monsters
        for (const monster of monsters) {
            const screenY = monster.y - cameraY;
            if (screenY > -60 && screenY < canvas.height + 60) {
                monster.draw();
            }
        }

        // Draw particles
        for (const particle of particles) {
            const screenY = particle.y - cameraY;
            particle.y = screenY + cameraY; // Keep world coordinates
            particle.draw();
        }

        // Draw player
        drawPlayer();

        // Draw UI
        drawUI();
    } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        drawGameOver();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Polyfill for roundRect if needed
if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
        if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
        const [tl, tr, br, bl] = r;
        this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
        this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
        this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
        this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
        this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
        this.closePath();
        return this;
    };
}

// Start game loop
gameLoop();
