<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Mojocreate - Buy & Sell</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #6C63FF;
            --secondary: #FF6584;
            --accent: #00C9A7;
            --warning: #FFB800;
            --danger: #FF4757;
            --dark: #2D3436;
            --light: #F8F9FA;
            --gradient1: linear-gradient(135deg, #6C63FF, #FF6584);
            --gradient2: linear-gradient(135deg, #00C9A7, #6C63FF);
            --gradient3: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6584, #FFB800);
            --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            --shadow-hover: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f7fa 0%, #c3cfe2 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* Header */
        .header {
            background: var(--gradient1);
            padding: 15px 20px;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .header-content {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }

        .nav-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .nav-btn {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border: 2px solid white;
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border-radius: 25px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-btn:hover, .nav-btn.active {
            background: white;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .nav-btn.admin-btn {
            background: var(--warning);
            border-color: var(--warning);
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .nav-btn.admin-btn:hover {
            background: #FFC940;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            background: var(--gradient2);
            padding: 40px 20px;
            text-align: center;
            color: white;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            animation: rotate 20s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 16px;
            opacity: 0.9;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Search Bar */
        .search-container {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: -25px auto 20px;
            padding: 0 20px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .search-bar {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 15px 20px 15px 50px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 16px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            outline: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .search-bar:focus {
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 35px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        /* Main Content */
        .main-content {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        /* Section Title */
        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .section-title h2 {
            font-size: 28px;
            color: var(--dark);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .section-title .underline {
            width: 80px;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--gradient1);
            margin: 0 auto;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* Product Grid */
        .product-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 25px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .product-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        .product-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
        }

        .product-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 220px;
            object-fit: cover;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0e0e0, #f5f5f5);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 60px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .product-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        .stock-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            right: 15px;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: white;
        }

        .stock-badge.in-stock {
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        .stock-badge.low-stock {
            background: var(--warning);
        }

        .stock-badge.out-of-stock {
            background: var(--danger);
        }

        .product-info {
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .product-name {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dark);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .product-price {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .product-price span {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #999;
            text-decoration: line-through;
            margin-left: 8px;
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .product-stock {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .stock-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        .view-details-btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            background: var(--gradient1);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .view-details-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.4);
        }

        /* Modal */
        .modal-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
        }

        .modal-overlay.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 25px;
            max-width: 500px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            animation: modalSlide 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlide {
            from {
                transform: translateY(50px);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            padding: 20px 25px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .modal-header h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .modal-close {
            width: 35px;
            height: 35px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: none;
            background: #f0f0f0;
            font-size: 18px;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .modal-close:hover {
            background: var(--danger);
            color: white;
        }

        .modal-body {
            padding: 25px;
        }

        /* Payment Modal */
        .payment-modal .product-preview {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding: 15px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 15px;
        }

        .payment-modal .preview-image {
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            object-fit: cover;
            background: #e0e0e0;
        }

        .payment-modal .preview-info h4 {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--dark);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .payment-modal .preview-info .price {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .qr-container {
            text-align: center;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }

        .qr-code {
            width: 200px;
            height: 200px;
            background: white;
            border: 3px solid var(--primary);
            border-radius: 15px;
            margin: 0 auto 15px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .qr-code canvas {
            width: 180px;
            height: 180px;
        }

        .qr-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .payment-amount {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary);
            text-align: center;
            margin: 15px 0;
        }

        .payment-amount span {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: #999;
        }

        .pay-btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 15px;
            background: var(--gradient2);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .pay-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.4);
        }

        .pay-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.6;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }

        .locked-details {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .locked-details::before {
            content: '🔒 LOCKED';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            background: rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.9);
            color: white;
            padding: 10px 25px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 16px;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .locked-content {
            filter: blur(8px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .detail-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 12px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
        }

        .detail-row:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .detail-label {
            color: #666;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .detail-value {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .unlocked-details {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            animation: unlockAnimation 0.5s ease;
        }

        @keyframes unlockAnimation {
            from {
                transform: scale(0.8);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .unlocked-details .detail-row {
            border-bottom-color: #a5d6a7;
        }

        .contact-btn {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 10px;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .call-btn {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: white;
        }

        .message-btn {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .contact-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }

        /* Post Product Form */
        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--dark);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .form-group input,
        .form-group textarea,
        .form-group select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            border: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 16px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            outline: none;
            font-family: inherit;
        }

        .form-group input:focus,
        .form-group textarea:focus,
        .form-group select:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .form-group textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 100px;
        }

        .image-upload {
            border: 2px dashed #e0e0e0;
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 30px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            background: #f8f9fa;
        }

        .image-upload:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            background: #f0f0ff;
        }

        .image-upload .upload-icon {
            font-size: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .image-upload p {
            color: #666;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .image-preview {
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 200px;
            object-fit: cover;
            border-radius: 12px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            display: none;
        }

        .submit-btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 15px;
            background: var(--gradient1);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .submit-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.4);
        }

        /* Admin Panel */
        .admin-panel {
            display: none;
        }

        .admin-panel.active {
            display: block;
        }

        .admin-header {
            background: var(--gradient3);
            padding: 20px;
            color: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .admin-header h2 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .admin-stats {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: white;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .stat-card .stat-number {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        .admin-table-container {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .admin-table-header {
            padding: 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .admin-table-header h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .admin-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .admin-table th {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: left;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .admin-table td {
            padding: 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .admin-table tr:hover {
            background: #f8f9fa;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            margin: 2px;
        }

        .approve-btn {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: white;
        }

        .reject-btn {
            background: var(--danger);
            color: white;
        }

        .delete-btn {
            background: var(--warning);
            color: white;
        }

        .edit-btn {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .action-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        /* Admin Login */
        .admin-login {
            max-width: 400px;
            margin: 50px auto;
            background: white;
            padding: 40px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .admin-login h2 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .admin-login p {
            color: #666;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .admin-login .lock-icon {
            font-size: 60px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        /* Tabs */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding-bottom: 5px;
        }

            background: white;
            border-radius: 25px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .tab-content {
            display: none;
        }

        .tab-content.active {
            display: block;
        }

        /* Toast Notification */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
            background: var(--dark);
            color: white;
            padding: 15px 25px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            z-index: 3000;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .toast.show {
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }

        .toast.success {
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        .toast.error {
            background: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Empty State */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 60px 20px;
            color: #999;
        }

        .empty-state .empty-icon {
            font-size: 80px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .empty-state h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            color: #666;
        }

        .footer {
            background: var(--dark);
            color: white;
            padding: 30px 20px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 40px;
        }

        .footer p {
            opacity: 0.8;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .footer .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .footer .footer-links a {
            color: white;
            text-decoration: none;
            opacity: 0.6;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .footer .footer-links a:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 10px;
            }

            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 24px;
            }

                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));

            }

            .product-image {
                height: 160px;
            }

            .product-info {
                padding: 15px;
            }

            .product-name {
                font-size: 14px;
            }

            .product-price {
                font-size: 18px;
            }

            .admin-table {
                font-size: 12px;

                justify-content: center;

        /* Category Filter */

        /* User Products Section */

            color: #ef6c00;
        }

        .status-rejected {

        .payment-item {

        }

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;

        .payment-avatar {

        .payment-amount-badge {

            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Animations */
        .fade-in {
            animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .slide-in {
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { transform: translateX(-100%); }
            to { transform: translateX(0); }
        }

        /* Floating Action Button */
        .fab {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 25px;
            right: 25px;
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gradient1);

        function generateQRCode(productId) {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('qrCanvas');
            if (!canvas) return;

            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const size = 180;
            const cellSize = 6;
            const cells = Math.floor(size / cellSize);

            // Clear canvas
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

            // Generate pseudo-random QR pattern based on product ID
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            let seed = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < productId.length; i++) {
                seed += productId.charCodeAt(i);
            }

            function pseudoRandom() {
                seed = (seed * 16807 + 0) % 2147483647;
                return seed / 2147483647;
            }

            // Draw QR-like pattern
            for (let row = 0; row < cells; row++) {
                for (let col = 0; col < cells; col++) {
                    // Skip corner positions for finder patterns
                    if ((row < 7 && col < 7) || (row < 7 && col > cells - 8) || (row > cells - 8 && col < 7)) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (pseudoRandom() > 0.5) {
                        ctx.fillRect(col * cellSize, row * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Draw finder patterns
            drawFinderPattern(ctx, 0, 0, cellSize);
            drawFinderPattern(ctx, (cells - 7) * cellSize, 0, cellSize);
            drawFinderPattern(ctx, 0, (cells - 7) * cellSize, cellSize);

            // Draw center logo
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.fillRect(size/2 - 15, size/2 - 15, 30, 30);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#6C63FF';
            ctx.font = '16px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText('₹', size/2, size/2);
        }

        function drawFinderPattern(ctx, x, y, cellSize) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            // Outer box
            for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                    if (i === 0 || i === 6 || j === 0 || j === 6 || (i >= 2 && i <= 4 && j >= 2 && j <= 4)) {
                        ctx.fillRect(x + j * cellSize, y + i * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

                loadAdminDashboard();

            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('show');
            }, 3000);
        }

        // ==================== INITIALIZATION ====================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initData();
            renderProducts();

            // Close modals on overlay click
            document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(overlay => {
                overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    if (e.target === this) {
                        this.classList.remove('active');

                });
            });

            // Enter key for admin login
            document.getElementById('adminPassword').addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {

                    adminLogin();

    <h1>✦ Mot Croisé ✦</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Découvrez les trésors du Royans et de ses environs</p>

    <div class="game-container">
        <div class="crossword-board">
            <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="clues-panel">
            <div class="clues-section">
                <h2>➜ Horizontaux</h2>
                <div id="across-clues"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="clues-section">
                <h2>➜ Verticaux</h2>
                <div id="down-clues"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="buttons">
                <button class="btn primary" onclick="checkAnswers()">✓ Vérifier</button>
                <button class="btn" onclick="showSolution()">💡 Solution</button>
                <button class="btn" onclick="resetGrid()">↺ Recommencer</button>
            </div>

            <div class="message" id="message"></div>

            <div class="legend">
                💡 Cliquez sur une case pour commencer • Utilisez les flèches pour naviguer
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const gridConfig = {
            rows: 10,
            cols: 12
        };

        const words = [
            {
                word: "ROCHICHINARD",
                direction: "across",
                row: 6,
                col: 0,
                number: 1,
                clue: "Bourg du Royans connu pour ses grottes et son patrimoine"
            },
            {
                word: "CHATEAU",
                direction: "down",
                row: 1,
                col: 9,
                number: 1,
                clue: "Résidence seigneuriale fortifiée"
            },
            {
                word: "ZIZIM",
                direction: "down",
                row: 3,
                col: 4,
                number: 2,
                clue: "Prénom oriental d'un prince ottoman"
            },
            {
                word: "ALLEMAN",
                direction: "down",
                row: 0,
                col: 8,
                number: 3,
                clue: "Commune iséroise au pied du Vercors"
            },
            {
                word: "ROYANS",
                direction: "down",
                row: 4,
                col: 1,
                number: 4,
                clue: "Bastide du département de l'Isère, capitale du Royans"
            }
        ];

        const grid = [];
        let selectedCell = null;
        let currentDirection = "across";

        // Initialize grid
        function initGrid() {
            const gridEl = document.getElementById('grid');
            gridEl.innerHTML = '';
            grid.length = 0;

            for (let r = 0; r < gridConfig.rows; r++) {
                grid[r] = [];
                for (let c = 0; c < gridConfig.cols; c++) {
                    grid[r][c] = {
                        letter: '',
                        isBlank: true,
                        number: null,
                        words: []
                    };
                }
            }

            // Place words on grid
            words.forEach(w => {
                for (let i = 0; i < w.word.length; i++) {
                    let r, c;
                    if (w.direction === 'across') {
                        r = w.row;
                        c = w.col + i;
                    } else {
                        r = w.row + i;
                        c = w.col;
                    }
                    grid[r][c].isBlank = false;
                    grid[r][c].letter = w.word[i];
                    grid[r][c].words.push(w);
                    if (i === 0) {
                        grid[r][c].number = w.number;
                    }
                }
            });

            // Create DOM elements
            for (let r = 0; r < gridConfig.rows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < gridConfig.cols; c++) {
                    const cell = document.createElement('div');
                    cell.className = 'cell';
                    cell.dataset.row = r;
                    cell.dataset.col = c;

                    if (grid[r][c].isBlank) {
                        cell.classList.add('empty');
                    } else {
                        if (grid[r][c].number) {
                            const num = document.createElement('span');
                            num.className = 'number';
                            num.textContent = grid[r][c].number;
                            cell.appendChild(num);
                        }

                        const input = document.createElement('input');
                        input.type = 'text';
                        input.maxLength = 1;
                        input.dataset.row = r;
                        input.dataset.col = c;
                        input.addEventListener('input', handleInput);
                        input.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
                        input.addEventListener('focus', () => highlightCell(r, c));
                        input.addEventListener('click', () => handleClick(r, c));
                        cell.appendChild(input);
                    }

                    gridEl.appendChild(cell);
                }
            }

            renderClues();
        }

        function renderClues() {
            const acrossContainer = document.getElementById('across-clues');
            const downContainer = document.getElementById('down-clues');
            acrossContainer.innerHTML = '';
            downContainer.innerHTML = '';

            words.forEach(w => {
                const clueEl = document.createElement('div');
                clueEl.className = 'clue';
                clueEl.dataset.word = w.word;
                clueEl.innerHTML = `<span class="clue-number">${w.number}</span><span class="clue-direction">${w.direction === 'across' ? '→' : '↓'}</span> ${w.clue}`;
                clueEl.addEventListener('click', () => selectWord(w));

                if (w.direction === 'across') {
                    acrossContainer.appendChild(clueEl);
                } else {
                    downContainer.appendChild(clueEl);
                }
            });
        }

        function handleInput(e) {
            const input = e.target;
            const r = parseInt(input.dataset.row);
            const c = parseInt(input.dataset.col);
            const val = input.value.toUpperCase();

            if (val && val.match(/[A-Z]/)) {
                grid[r][c].userLetter = val;
                input.value = val;

                // Move to next cell
                moveToNextCell(r, c);
            } else {
                input.value = '';
                grid[r][c].userLetter = '';
            }
        }

        function handleKeydown(e) {
            const r = parseInt(e.target.dataset.row);
            const c = parseInt(e.target.dataset.col);

            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowRight':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    moveCell(r, c, 0, 1);
                    break;
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    moveCell(r, c, 0, -1);
                    break;
                case 'ArrowDown':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    moveCell(r, c, 1, 0);
                    break;
                case 'ArrowUp':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    moveCell(r, c, -1, 0);
                    break;
                case 'Backspace':
                    if (e.target.value === '') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        moveToPrevCell(r, c);
                    }
                    break;
                case 'Tab':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    moveToNextWord();
                    break;
            }
        }

        function handleClick(r, c) {
            if (selectedCell && selectedCell.row === r && selectedCell.col === c) {
                // Toggle direction
                currentDirection = currentDirection === 'across' ? 'down' : 'across';
                highlightCell(r, c);
            }
        }

        function highlightCell(r, c) {
            // Clear previous highlights
            document.querySelectorAll('.cell').forEach(cell => {
                cell.classList.remove('highlight', 'active');
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.clue').forEach(clue => {
                clue.classList.remove('active');
            });

            // Highlight current cell
            const cell = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${r}"][data-col="${c}"]`);
            if (cell) cell.classList.add('active');

            // Highlight word
            const cellData = grid[r][c];
            let word = null;
            if (cellData.words.length > 0) {
                word = cellData.words.find(w => w.direction === currentDirection);
                if (!word && cellData.words.length > 0) {
                    word = cellData.words[0];
                    currentDirection = word.direction;
                }
            }

            if (word) {
                // Highlight all cells in the word
                for (let i = 0; i < word.word.length; i++) {
                    let wr, wc;
                    if (word.direction === 'across') {
                        wr = word.row;
                        wc = word.col + i;
                    } else {
                        wr = word.row + i;
                        wc = word.col;
                    }
                    const cellEl = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${wr}"][data-col="${wc}"]`);
                    if (cellEl) cellEl.classList.add('highlight');
                }

                // Highlight clue
                const clueEl = document.querySelector(`.clue[data-word="${word.word}"]`);
                if (clueEl) clueEl.classList.add('active');
            }

            selectedCell = { row: r, col: c };
        }

        function moveCell(r, c, dr, dc) {
            let nr = r + dr;
            let nc = c + dc;

            while (nr >= 0 && nr < gridConfig.rows && nc >= 0 && nc < gridConfig.cols) {
                if (!grid[nr][nc].isBlank) {
                    const input = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${nr}"][data-col="${nc}"] input`);
                    if (input) {
                        input.focus();
                        highlightCell(nr, nc);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                nr += dr;
                nc += dc;
            }
        }

        function moveToNextCell(r, c) {
            let nr, nc;
            if (currentDirection === 'across') {
                nc = c + 1;
                nr = r;
            } else {
                nr = r + 1;
                nc = c;
            }

            while (nr >= 0 && nr < gridConfig.rows && nc >= 0 && nc < gridConfig.cols) {
                if (!grid[nr][nc].isBlank) {
                    const input = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${nr}"][data-col="${nc}"] input`);
                    if (input) {
                        input.focus();
                        highlightCell(nr, nc);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                nr += currentDirection === 'across' ? 0 : 1;
                nc += currentDirection === 'across' ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }

        function moveToPrevCell(r, c) {
            let nr, nc;
            if (currentDirection === 'across') {
                nc = c - 1;
                nr = r;
            } else {
                nr = r - 1;
                nc = c;
            }

            while (nr >= 0 && nr < gridConfig.rows && nc >= 0 && nc < gridConfig.cols) {
                if (!grid[nr][nc].isBlank) {
                    const input = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${nr}"][data-col="${nc}"] input`);
                    if (input) {
                        input.focus();
                        highlightCell(nr, nc);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                nr += currentDirection === 'across' ? 0 : -1;
                nc += currentDirection === 'across' ? -1 : 0;
            }
        }

        function selectWord(word) {
            currentDirection = word.direction;
            const input = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${word.row}"][data-col="${word.col}"] input`);
            if (input) {
                input.focus();
                highlightCell(word.row, word.col);
            }
        }

        function moveToNextWord() {
            const currentWordIndex = words.findIndex(w => {
                if (w.direction !== currentDirection) return false;
                for (let i = 0; i < w.word.length; i++) {
                    let wr, wc;
                    if (w.direction === 'across') {
                        wr = w.row;
                        wc = w.col + i;
                    } else {
                        wr = w.row + i;
                        wc = w.col;
                    }
                    if (selectedCell && selectedCell.row === wr && selectedCell.col === wc) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            });

            const nextIndex = (currentWordIndex + 1) % words.length;
            const nextWord = words[nextIndex];
            selectWord(nextWord);
        }

        function checkAnswers() {
            let allCorrect = true;
            let allFilled = true;

            for (let r = 0; r < gridConfig.rows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < gridConfig.cols; c++) {
                    if (!grid[r][c].isBlank) {
                        const cell = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${r}"][data-col="${c}"]`);
                        const input = cell.querySelector('input');
                        const userLetter = input ? input.value.toUpperCase() : '';

                        cell.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');

                        if (!userLetter) {
                            allFilled = false;
                            allCorrect = false;
                        } else if (userLetter === grid[r][c].letter) {
                            cell.classList.add('correct');
                        } else {
                            cell.classList.add('wrong');
                            allCorrect = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            const messageEl = document.getElementById('message');
            if (allCorrect && allFilled) {
                messageEl.className = 'message success';
                messageEl.textContent = '🎉 Félicitations ! Vous avez complété le mot croisé !';
            } else if (!allFilled) {
                messageEl.className = 'message error';
                messageEl.textContent = '⚠️ Il reste des cases à remplir.';
            } else {
                messageEl.className = 'message error';
                messageEl.textContent = '❌ Certaines lettres sont incorrectes. Les cases rouges indiquent les erreurs.';
            }
        }

        function showSolution() {
            for (let r = 0; r < gridConfig.rows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < gridConfig.cols; c++) {
                    if (!grid[r][c].isBlank) {
                        const cell = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${r}"][data-col="${c}"]`);
                        const input = cell.querySelector('input');
                        if (input) {
                            input.value = grid[r][c].letter;
                            grid[r][c].userLetter = grid[r][c].letter;
                            cell.classList.remove('wrong');
                            cell.classList.add('correct');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            const messageEl = document.getElementById('message');
            messageEl.className = 'message success';
            messageEl.textContent = '💡 Solution affichée !';
        }

        function resetGrid() {
            for (let r = 0; r < gridConfig.rows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < gridConfig.cols; c++) {
                    if (!grid[r][c].isBlank) {
                        const cell = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-row="${r}"][data-col="${c}"]`);
                        const input = cell.querySelector('input');
                        if (input) {
                            input.value = '';
                            grid[r][c].userLetter = '';
                        }
                        cell.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong', 'highlight', 'active');
                    }
                }
            }

            const messageEl = document.getElementById('message');
            messageEl.className = 'message';
            messageEl.textContent = '';
            selectedCell = null;
            currentDirection = 'across';
        }

        // Initialize on load
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initGrid);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>FitFlux — AI Fitness Companion</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Orbitron:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

  :root {
    --bg-primary: #0a0a0f;
    --bg-secondary: #12121a;
    --bg-tertiary: #1a1a2e;
    --bg-card: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    --neon-blue: #00d4ff;
    --neon-red: #ff3366;
    --neon-purple: #8b5cf6;
    --neon-green: #10b981;
    --neon-orange: #f59e0b;
    --text-primary: #ffffff;
    --text-secondary: #a0a0b0;
    --text-muted: #6b6b80;
    --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    --glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    --shadow-blue: 0 0 30px rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
    --shadow-red: 0 0 30px rgba(255,51,102,0.3);
    --shadow-purple: 0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
  }

  * {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  html, body {
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }

  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: -50%;
    left: -50%;
    width: 200%;
    height: 200%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(0,212,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 80%, rgba(255,51,102,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(139,92,246,0.03) 0%, transparent 70%);
    animation: bgFloat 20s ease-in-out infinite;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  @keyframes bgFloat {
    0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
    33% { transform: translate(2%, -2%) rotate(1deg); }
    66% { transform: translate(-1%, 1%) rotate(-1deg); }
  }

  .app-container {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Header */
  .app-header {
    padding: 16px 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: rgba(10,10,15,0.8);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 100;
  }

  .app-logo {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .app-logo-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-blue);
    animation: logoPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes logoPulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,0.3); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,212,255,0.5); }
  }

  .app-logo-text {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .header-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .header-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--glass-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .header-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: var(--neon-blue);
    border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  }

  /* Pages */
  .pages-container {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .page {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    padding: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 100px;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(30px);
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .page::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .page.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
    pointer-events: all;
  }

  .page.exit-left {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-30px);
  }

  /* Bottom Navigation */
  .bottom-nav {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 480px;
    background: rgba(10,10,15,0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    padding: 8px 0;
    padding-bottom: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    z-index: 100;
  }

  .nav-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
    min-width: 64px;
  }

  .nav-item::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
    width: 24px;
    height: 3px;
    background: var(--neon-blue);
    border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .nav-item.active::before {
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
  }

  .nav-item.active {
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.1);
  }

  .nav-icon {
    font-size: 22px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }

  .nav-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .nav-item.active .nav-label {
    color: var(--neon-blue);
  }

  .nav-item.active .nav-icon {
    color: var(--neon-blue);
  }

  /* Home Page - Rock Chat */
  .rock-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .rock-avatar-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
  }

  .rock-avatar {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 48px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,212,255,0.4);
    animation: avatarFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes avatarFloat {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  }

  .rock-avatar-ring {
    position: absolute;
    top: -5px;
    left: -5px;
    right: -5px;
    bottom: -5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--neon-blue);
    opacity: 0.3;
    animation: ringPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .rock-avatar-ring:nth-child(2) {
    top: -10px;
    left: -10px;
    right: -10px;
    bottom: -10px;
    animation-delay: 0.5s;
    border-color: var(--neon-purple);
  }

  @keyframes ringPulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.3; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 0.1; }
  }

  .rock-status {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--neon-green);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .status-dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    background: var(--neon-green);
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: statusBlink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes statusBlink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0.3; }
  }

  .rock-title {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, var(--neon-blue));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }

  .rock-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }

  /* Daily Tip */
  .daily-tip {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,92,246,0.1), rgba(0,212,255,0.1));
    border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.2);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .daily-tip::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-purple), var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    animation: tipGradient 3s linear infinite;
    background-size: 200% 100%;
  }

  @keyframes tipGradient {
    0% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
    100% { background-position: 200% 0%; }
  }

  .daily-tip-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--neon-purple);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .daily-tip-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }

  /* Chat Container */
  .chat-container {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    min-height: 300px;
    max-height: 450px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .chat-messages {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1) transparent;
  }

  .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
  }

  .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }

  .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .message {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    max-width: 85%;
    animation: messageSlide 0.3s ease-out;
  }

  @keyframes messageSlide {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .message.user {
    align-self: flex-end;
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
  }

  .message-avatar {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .message.rock .message-avatar {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
  }

  .message.user .message-avatar {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-red), var(--neon-orange));
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,51,102,0.3);
  }

  .message-bubble {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    position: relative;
  }

  .message.rock .message-bubble {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-top-left-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  .message.user .message-bubble {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.2), rgba(139,92,246,0.2));
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
    border-top-right-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  .message-time {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-top: 4px;
    display: block;
  }

  .typing-indicator {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .typing-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: var(--neon-blue);
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: typingBounce 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .typing-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .typing-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

  @keyframes typingBounce {
    0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.3; }
    30% { transform: translateY(-8px); opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* Chat Input */
  .chat-input-container {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  }

  .chat-input {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    outline: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }

  .chat-input:focus {
    border-color: var(--neon-blue);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,0.1);
  }

  .chat-input::placeholder {
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .chat-send-btn {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    border: none;
    color: white;
    font-size: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
  }

  .chat-send-btn:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,212,255,0.5);
  }

  .chat-send-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }

  .chat-voice-btn {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }

  .chat-voice-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255,51,102,0.1);
    border-color: var(--neon-red);
    color: var(--neon-red);
  }

  /* Quick Actions */
  .quick-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .quick-action-btn {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    background: var(--glass-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .quick-action-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.1);
    border-color: var(--neon-blue);
    color: var(--neon-blue);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  /* CTA Button */
  .cta-container {
    margin-top: 20px;
  }

  .cta-button {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
    border: none;
    border-radius: 16px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,212,255,0.3);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .cta-button::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -100%;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent);
    transition: left 0.5s ease;
  }

  .cta-button:hover::before {
    left: 100%;
  }

  .cta-button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,212,255,0.5);
  }

  .cta-button:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  /* Calorie Tracker Page */
  .page-title {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, var(--neon-blue));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }

  .page-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  /* Food Upload */
  .food-upload-area {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 2px dashed var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 32px 20px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .food-upload-area:hover {
    border-color: var(--neon-blue);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.05);
  }

  .food-upload-area.dragover {
    border-color: var(--neon-blue);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.1);
    transform: scale(1.02);
  }

  .upload-icon {
    font-size: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: block;
  }

  .upload-text {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .upload-subtext {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .upload-preview {
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 200px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    display: none;
  }

  .analyze-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-red), var(--neon-orange));
    border: none;
    border-radius: 14px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;

  function speakText(text) {
    if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      const cleanText = text.replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/[🏋️💪🔥🥗🍎⏰💧🚫🧘🦵🔄😴📊⚡1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣4️⃣5️⃣✅🤔🍗💡🏃🚴🔥🛌🧊😪👋😊🙌🚀]/g, '').substring(0, 500);
      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText);
      utterance.rate = 1;
      utterance.pitch = 1;
      utterance.volume = 0.8;

      // Try to find a good English voice
      const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
      const englishVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('en') && v.name.includes('Google')) || voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('en'));
      if (englishVoice) utterance.voice = englishVoice;

      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    }
  }

      voiceBtn.style.borderColor = '';
      voiceBtn.style.color = '';
      voiceBtn.textContent = '🎤';

      voiceBtn.style.background = '';
      voiceBtn.style.borderColor = '';
      voiceBtn.style.color = '';
      voiceBtn.textContent = '🎤';
    };

    recognition.start();
  }

  function handleFileUpload(event) {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const preview = document.getElementById('uploadPreview');
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = function(e) {
      preview.src = e.target.result;
      preview.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('analyzeBtn').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('foodUploadArea').querySelector('.upload-text').textContent = file.name;
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function analyzeFood() {
    const preview = document.getElementById('uploadPreview');
    if (!preview.src || preview.style.display === 'none') {
      alert('Please upload a food photo first!');
      return;
    }

    // Simulate food analysis
    const foodKeys = Object.keys(foodDatabase);
    const randomFood = foodKeys[Math.floor(Math.random() * foodKeys.length)];
    const food = foodDatabase[randomFood];

    document.getElementById('foodResultName').textContent = randomFood.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + randomFood.slice(1);
    document.getElementById('foodResultConfidence').textContent = `Confidence: ${85 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 14)}%`;
    document.getElementById('resultCalories').textContent = food.calories;
    document.getElementById('resultProtein').textContent = food.protein + 'g';
    document.getElementById('resultCarbs').textContent = food.carbs + 'g';
    document.getElementById('resultFat').textContent = food.fat + 'g';

    document.getElementById('foodResult').style.display = 'block';

    // Add to log
    addFoodToLog(randomFood, food);
  }

  function addManualFood() {
    const input = document.getElementById('manualFoodInput');
    const foodName = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!foodName) return;

    // Search in database
    let foundFood = null;
    let foundKey = '';

    for (const key of Object.keys(foodDatabase)) {
      if (foodName.includes(key) || key.includes(foodName)) {
        foundFood = foodDatabase[key];
        foundKey = key;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!foundFood) {
      // Generate random nutrition if not found
      foundFood = {
        calories: 100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300),
        protein: 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20),
        carbs: 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 40),
        fat: 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 15),
        emoji: '🍽️'
      };
      foundKey = foodName;
    }

    document.getElementById('foodResultName').textContent = foundKey.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + foundKey.slice(1);
    document.getElementById('foodResultConfidence').textContent = `Confidence: ${foundFood ? '100%' : 'Estimated'}`;
    document.getElementById('resultCalories').textContent = foundFood.calories;
    document.getElementById('resultProtein').textContent = foundFood.protein + 'g';
    document.getElementById('resultCarbs').textContent = foundFood.carbs + 'g';
    document.getElementById('resultFat').textContent = foundFood.fat + 'g';

    document.getElementById('foodResult').style.display = 'block';

    addFoodToLog(foundKey, foundFood);
    input.value = '';
  }

  function addFoodToLog(name, food) {
    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    dailyLog.push({
      name: name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1),
      calories: food.calories,
      protein: food.protein,
      carbs: food.carbs,
      fat: food.fat,
      emoji: food.emoji,
      time: time
    });

    totalCalories += food.calories;
    totalProtein += food.protein;
    totalMeals++;

    updateLogDisplay();
  }

  function updateLogDisplay() {
    const logEntries = document.getElementById('logEntries');
    const logTotal = document.getElementById('logTotal');
    const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
    const progressPercent = document.getElementById('progressPercent');

    logTotal.textContent = totalCalories + ' cal';
    document.getElementById('totalCalories').textContent = totalCalories;
    document.getElementById('totalProtein').textContent = totalProtein + 'g';
    document.getElementById('totalMeals').textContent = totalMeals;

    const percent = Math.min((totalCalories / DAILY_GOAL) * 100, 100);
    progressFill.style.width = percent + '%';
    progressPercent.textContent = Math.round(percent) + '%';

    if (dailyLog.length === 0) {
      logEntries.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px;">No meals logged yet. Start tracking!</div>';
      return;
    }

    logEntries.innerHTML = dailyLog.map(entry => `
      <div class="log-entry">
        <div class="log-entry-info">
          <span class="log-entry-emoji">${entry.emoji}</span>
          <div>
            <div class="log-entry-name">${entry.name}</div>
            <div class="log-entry-time">${entry.time}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="log-entry-cal">${entry.calories} cal</div>
      </div>
    `).reverse().join('');
  }

  function toggleBMICalculator() {
    const bmiCalc = document.getElementById('bmiCalculator');

  function calculateBMI() {
    const height = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bmiHeight').value);
    const weight = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bmiWeight').value);

    if (!height || !weight || height <= 0 || weight <= 0) {
      alert('Please enter valid height and weight values!');
      return;
    }

    const heightM = height / 100;
    const bmi = weight / (heightM * heightM);
    const bmiRounded = bmi.toFixed(1);

    let category = '';
    let color = '';
    let info = '';

    if (bmi < 18.5) {
      category = 'Underweight';
      color = 'var(--neon-blue)';
      info = 'You may need to gain some weight. Consult a nutritionist for a healthy weight gain plan.';
    } else if (bmi < 25) {
      category = 'Normal Weight';
      color = 'var(--neon-green)';
      info = 'Great job! You\'re in the healthy weight range. Keep maintaining your lifestyle!';
    } else if (bmi < 30) {
      category = 'Overweight';
      color = 'var(--neon-orange)';
      info = 'Consider increasing physical activity and reviewing your diet for better health.';
    } else {
      category = 'Obese';
      color = 'var(--neon-red)';
      info = 'It\'s recommended to consult a healthcare provider for a personalized health plan.';
    }

    document.getElementById('bmiValue').textContent = bmiRounded;
    document.getElementById('bmiValue').style.color = color;
    document.getElementById('bmiCategory').textContent = category;
    document.getElementById('bmiCategory').style.color = color;
    document.getElementById('bmiInfo').textContent = info;

    // Position indicator
    const pos = Math.min(Math.max((bmi - 15) / 25 * 100, 0), 100);
    document.getElementById('bmiIndicator').style.setProperty('--bmi-pos', pos);

    document.getElementById('bmiResult').classList.add('active');
  }

  function updateWaterDisplay() {
    const glasses = document.querySelectorAll('.water-glass');
    const filled = waterGlasses.filter(g => g).length;

    glasses.forEach((glass, i) => {
      if (waterGlasses[i]) {
        glass.classList.add('filled');
      } else {
        glass.classList.remove('filled');
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('waterCount').textContent = filled + '/8';
  }

      document.getElementById('stepCount').style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';

class ScreenCaptureService : Service() {

    private var mediaCodec: MediaCodec? = null
    private var virtualDisplay: VirtualDisplay? = null
    private var outputSurface: Surface? = null
    private var isRunning = false
    
    // Hardware encoding configuration
    private companion object {
        const val BIT_RATE = 8000000       // 8 Mbps
        const val FRAME_RATE = 60         // 60 FPS
        const val I_FRAME_INTERVAL = 10   // I-frame every 10s
        const val COLOR_FORMAT = 
            MediaCodecInfo.CodecCapabilities.COLOR_FormatSurface
        const val MIME_TYPE = "video/avc"   // H.264
    }

    fun startCapture(
        mediaProjection: MediaProjection,
        width: Int = 1920,
        height: Int = 1080,
        dpi: Int = 420
    ) {
        initializeEncoder(width, height)
        
        virtualDisplay = mediaProjection.createVirtualDisplay(
            "ScreenMirror",
            width, height, dpi,
            DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
            outputSurface,
            null, null
        )
        
        isRunning = true
        startEncodingLoop()
    }

    private fun initializeEncoder(width: Int, height: Int) {
        mediaCodec = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(MIME_TYPE)
        val format = MediaFormat.createVideoFormat(MIME_TYPE, width, height).apply {
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_COLOR_FORMAT, COLOR_FORMAT)
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, BIT_RATE)
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_FRAME_RATE, FRAME_RATE)
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_I_FRAME_INTERVAL, I_FRAME_INTERVAL)
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BITRATE_MODE, 
                MediaCodecInfo.EncoderCapabilities.BITRATE_MODE_CBR)
        }
        
        mediaCodec?.configure(format, null, null, 
            MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE)
        
        outputSurface = mediaCodec?.createInputSurface()
        mediaCodec?.start()
    }

    private fun startEncodingLoop() {
        thread(name = "EncodingThread") {
            val codec = mediaCodec ?: return@thread
            val timeoutUs = 10000L
            
            while (isRunning) {
                val inputBufIndex = codec.dequeueInputBuffer(timeoutUs)
                if (inputBufIndex >= 0) {
                    // Buffer is ready, virtualDisplay fills it
                    codec.queueInputBuffer(
                        inputBufIndex, 0, 0, 
                        System.currentTimeMillis() * 1000, 0
                    )
                }
                
                val outputBufIndex = codec.dequeueOutputBuffer(
                    bufferInfo, timeoutUs
                )
                
                when (outputBufIndex) {
                    MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED -> {
                        handleFormatChanged(codec.outputFormat)
                    }
                    MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER -> {
                        // No output available
                    }
                    else -> {
                        sendEncodedFrame(codec, outputBufIndex)
                        codec.releaseOutputBuffer(outputBufIndex, false)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun sendEncodedFrame(
        codec: MediaCodec, 
        index: Int
    ) {
        val buffer = codec.getOutputBuffer(index) ?: return
        val info = bufferInfo
        
        // Send via TCP socket
        clientSocket?.outputStream.write(byteArrayOf(
            0xAA.toByte(), 0x55.toByte() // Frame header
        ))
        clientSocket?.outputStream.write(
            info.size.toByteArray()
        )
        clientSocket?.outputStream.write(buffer)
        clientSocket?.outputStream.flush()
    }

@AccessibilityService
class InputRelayService : AccessibilityService() {

    private var clientSocket: Socket? = null
    
    // Input event types mapping
    enum class InputType {
        TOUCH, SWIPE, KEY_EVENT, SCROLL, NAVIGATION
    }

    override fun onAccessibilityEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent?) {
        // Forward accessibility events to TV if needed
    }

    override fun onInterrupt() {
        // Handle interruption
    }

    // Handle incoming input commands from TV
    fun handleInputCommand(command: ByteArray) {
        val reader = DataInputStream(
            ByteArrayInputStream(command)
        )
        
        try {
            val type = reader.readInt()
            val x = reader.readInt()
            val y = reader.readInt()
            val action = reader.readInt()
            
            when (type) {
                InputType.TOUCH.ordinal -> {
                    performTouchInput(x, y, action)
                }
                InputType.KEY_EVENT.ordinal -> {
                    performKeyEvent(x, action)
                }
                InputType.SWIPE.ordinal -> {
                    performSwipe(x, y, reader.readInt())
                }
            }
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            Log.e("InputRelay", "Error processing input", e)
        }
    }

    private fun performTouchInput(
        x: Int, y: Int, action: Int
    ) {
        val movementEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(
            System.uptimeMillis(),
            System.uptimeMillis(),
            action, x.toFloat(), y.toFloat(), 0
        )
        
        // Dispatch to current focused window
        val window = getCurrentWindow()
        window?.decorView?.dispatchTouchEvent(movementEvent)
        
        movementEvent.recycle()
    }

    private fun performKeyEvent(
        keyCode: Int, action: Int
    ) {
        val keyEvent = KeyEvent.obtain(
            System.uptimeMillis(),
            System.uptimeMillis(),
            action, keyCode, 0,
            KeyEvent.META_OFF
        )
        
        val window = getCurrentWindow()
        window?.decorView?.dispatchKeyEvent(keyEvent)
        
        keyEvent.recycle()
    }

    private fun performSwipe(
        startX: Int, startY: Int, endX: Int
    ) {
        val endY = startY
        val duration = 300L
        
        val downEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(
            System.uptimeMillis(), 
            System.uptimeMillis(),
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN,
            startX.toFloat(), startY.toFloat(), 0
        )
        
        val upEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(
            System.uptimeMillis() + duration,
            System.uptimeMillis() + duration,
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP,
            endX.toFloat(), endY.toFloat(), 0
        )
        
        getCurrentWindow()?.decorView?.dispatchTouchEvent(downEvent)
        getCurrentWindow()?.decorView?.dispatchTouchEvent(upEvent)
        
        downEvent.recycle()
        upEvent.recycle()
    }
