class ScreenOffManager private(val context: Context) {

    private var powerManager: PowerManager? = null
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
    private var windowManager: WindowManager? = null
    private var isScreenOff = false

    fun initialize() {
        powerManager = context.getSystemService(
            Context.POWER_SERVICE
        ) as PowerManager
        
        windowManager = context.getSystemService(
            Context.WINDOW_SERVICE
        ) as WindowManager
    }

    fun turnScreenOff() {
        // Keep CPU running but turn off display
        wakeLock = powerManager?.newWakeLock(
            PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK,
            "ScreenMirror::WakeLock"
        ).apply {
            acquire(30 * 60 * 1000L) // 30 min timeout
        }

        // Hide status bar and navigation bar
        val activity = context as Activity
        activity.window.addFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )

        // Create a transparent overlay to prevent screen from turning on
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams().apply {
            width = WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            type = WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
            flags = WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN
            format = PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        }

        val overlayView = View(context).apply {
            alpha = 0.01f // Nearly invisible
            background = Color.TRANSPARENT.getDrawable()
        }

        windowManager?.addView(overlayView, params)
        isScreenOff = true
    }

    fun turnScreenOn() {
        wakeLock?.release()
        isScreenOff = false
        
        val activity = context as Activity
        activity.window.clearFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
    }

    fun isScreenOff(): Boolean = isScreenOff
}

class TVMainActivity : LeanbackActivity() {

    private lateinit var tcpSocket: Socket
    private lateinit var udpSocket: DatagramSocket
    private var isConnected = false
    
    // Hardware decoder
    private lateinit var mediaCodec: MediaCodec
    private lateinit var surfaceView: SurfaceView
    private lateinit var surface: Surface
    
    // Input relay

    // CPU monitor

            handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
        }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_tv_main)
        
        surfaceView = findViewById(R.id.surfaceView)
        surface = surfaceView.surfaceHolder.addCallback(
            object : SurfaceHolder.Callback {
                override fun surfaceCreated(holder: SurfaceHolder) {
                    surface = holder.surface
                    initializeDecoder()
                }
            }
        )
        
        startCpuMonitor()
        setupInputListeners()
    }

    fun connectToMobile(view: View) {
        thread(name = "ConnectThread") {
            try {
                // Connect to mobile's hotspot IP
                tcpSocket = Socket("192.168.43.1", 8080)
                udpSocket = DatagramSocket()
                
                updateStatus("Connected to Mobile")
                isConnected = true
                
                startVideoDecoder()
                startInputRelay()
                
            } catch (e: IOException) {
                updateStatus("Connection failed: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun initializeDecoder() {
        val format = MediaFormat.createVideoFormat(
            "video/avc", 1920, 1080
        ).apply {
            setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_COLOR_FORMAT,
                MediaCodecInfo.CodecCapabilities.COLOR_FormatSurface)
        }
        
        mediaCodec = MediaCodec.createDecoderByType("video/avc")
        mediaCodec.configure(format, surface, null, 0)
        mediaCodec.start()
    }

    private fun startVideoDecoder() {
        thread(name = "DecoderThread") {
            val inputStream = tcpSocket.inputStream
            val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
            val codec = mediaCodec
            
            while (isConnected) {
                val bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)
                if (bytesRead > 0) {
                    decodeFrame(buffer, bytesRead)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun decodeFrame(
        data: ByteArray, length: Int
    ) {
        val codec = mediaCodec
        val inputBufIndex = codec.dequeueInputBuffer(10000L)
        
        if (inputBufIndex >= 0) {
            val inputBuffer = codec.getInputBuffer(inputBufIndex)
            inputBuffer?.put(data, 0, length)
            
            codec.queueInputBuffer(
                inputBufIndex, 0, length,
                System.currentTimeMillis() * 1000, 0
            )
        }
        
        val outputBufIndex = codec.dequeueOutputBuffer(
            bufferInfo, 10000L
        )
        
        if (outputBufIndex >= 0) {
            codec.releaseOutputBuffer(outputBufIndex, true)
        }
    }

    private fun setupInputListeners() {
        // Handle TV remote input
        findViewById<View>(R.id.surfaceView)
            .setOnKeyListener { v, keyCode, event ->
                if (event.action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                    sendInputToMobile(
                        InputType.KEY_EVENT, 
                        keyCode, 0, 
                        event.action
                    )
                    true
                } else {
                    false
                }
            }
        
        // Handle touch/mouse input
        findViewById<View>(R.id.surfaceView)
            .setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
                sendInputToMobile(
                    InputType.TOUCH,
                    event.x.toInt(),
                    event.y.toInt(),
                    event.action
                )
                true
            }
    }

    private fun sendInputToMobile(
        type: InputType,
        x: Int,
        y: Int,
        action: Int
    ) {
        val outputStream = tcpSocket.outputStream
        val data = ByteArray(16).apply {
            putInt(0, type.ordinal)
            putInt(4, x)
            putInt(8, y)
            putInt(12, action)
        }
        outputStream.write(data)
        outputStream.flush()
    }
}

class InputSender private(val socket: Socket) {

    enum class InputType {
        TOUCH, SWIPE, KEY_EVENT, SCROLL, NAVIGATION
    }

    fun sendTouchEvent(
        x: Float, y: Float, action: Int
    ) {
        val data = ByteArray(20).apply {
            putInt(0, InputType.TOUCH.ordinal)
            putInt(4, x.toInt())
            putInt(8, y.toInt())
            putInt(12, action)
            putFloat(16, pressure)
        }
        send(data)
    }

    fun sendKeyEvent(
        keyCode: Int, action: Int
    ) {
        val data = ByteArray(16).apply {
            putInt(0, InputType.KEY_EVENT.ordinal)
            putInt(4, keyCode)
            putInt(8, action)
        }
        send(data)
    }

    fun sendSwipeEvent(
        startX: Float, startY: Float,
        endX: Float, endY: Float
    ) {
        val data = ByteArray(24).apply {
            putInt(0, InputType.SWIPE.ordinal)
            putInt(4, startX.toInt())
            putInt(8, startY.toInt())
            putInt(12, endX.toInt())
            putInt(16, endY.toInt())
        }
        send(data)
    }

    private fun send(data: ByteArray) {
        try {
            socket.outputStream.write(data)
            socket.outputStream.flush()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            Log.e("InputSender", "Failed to send input", e)
        }
    }
}

Protocol Specification

/*
 * ============================================
 * SCREEN MIRRORING PROTOCOL SPECIFICATION
 * ============================================
 * 
 * Transport: TCP (video) + UDP (input/controls)
 * Video Codec: H.264 (AVC) / H.265 (HEVC)
 * Frame Rate: 30-60 FPS
 * Resolution: Up to 1920x1080
 * Bitrate: 4-16 Mbps (adaptive)
 * Latency Target: < 50ms
 */

// === TCP Protocol (Video Stream) ===

// Frame Header Structure (16 bytes)
struct FrameHeader {
    uint32  magic;        // 0xAA55AA55
    uint32  frameNumber;  // Sequential frame counter
    uint32  dataSize;     // Size of payload in bytes
    uint32  timestamp;    // Unix timestamp in microseconds
}

// Video Frame Payload
struct VideoFrame {
    FrameHeader header;
    byte[]      payload;  // Encoded H.264 NAL units
}

// === UDP Protocol (Input Commands) ===

// Input Command Structure (32 bytes)
struct InputCommand {
    uint8   type;         // 0=TOUCH, 1=KEY, 2=SWIPE, 3=SCROLL
    uint8   action;       // DOWN, UP, MOVE
    int16   x;            // X coordinate
    int16   y;            // Y coordinate
    uint32  keyCode;      // For KEY events
    uint32  timestamp;    // Timestamp in microseconds
    uint16  padding;      // Alignment padding
}

// === Control Messages (TCP) ===

enum ControlMessage : uint8 {
    CONNECT_REQUEST = 0x01,
    CONNECT_RESPONSE = 0x02,
    DISCONNECT = 0x03,
    SCREEN_OFF = 0x04,
    SCREEN_ON = 0x05,
    HEARTBEAT = 0x06,
    QUALITY_CHANGE = 0x07,
    DEVICE_INFO = 0x08,
}

// === Connection Handshake ===

// 1. Mobile starts TCP server on port 8080
// 2. TV connects to Mobile's IP:8080
// 3. TV sends CONNECT_REQUEST with device info
// 4. Mobile responds with CONNECT_RESPONSE + capabilities
// 5. Video stream begins

// === Heartbeat (every 5 seconds) ===
struct Heartbeat {
    uint8   type = HEARTBEAT;
    uint32  mobileCpu;    // Mobile CPU usage %
    uint32  tvCpu;        // TV CPU usage %
    uint32  latency;      // Round-trip latency in ms
    uint32  bitrate;      // Current bitrate in kbps
}

// === Quality Adaptation ===
// If latency > 100ms for 3+ seconds:
//   → Reduce bitrate by 25%
//   → Reduce frame rate to 30 FPS
// If latency < 30ms for 5+ seconds:
//   → Increase bitrate by 25%
//   → Increase frame rate to 60 FPS

Network Configuration

📶

Mobile Hotspot

Mobile creates a Wi-Fi hotspot (192.168.43.1/24). TV connects to this hotspot for direct low-latency communication.

🔌

TCP Port 8080

Primary video stream channel. Reliable delivery for encoded video frames with proper sequencing.

⚡

UDP Port 8081

Input commands and control messages. Low-latency delivery for touch/keyboard events.

🔒

Encryption

TLS 1.3 overlay for secure communication. AES-256 encryption for all data in transit.

⚙️ Step-by-Step Setup Guide

Prerequisites

  • Android Mobile Device

    Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher. Must support MediaProjection API. Recommended: Android 12+ for best H.265 support.

  • Android TV Device

    Android TV 9.0 (API 28) or higher. Must support hardware H.264/H.265 decoding. Android TV Emulator or physical TV box.

  • Development Environment

    Android Studio Hedgehog or later. Kotlin 1.9+. Minimum SDK 26. Target SDK 34.

Installation Steps

  • Step 1: Clone & Build Mobile App

    Open the mobile app project in Android Studio. Sync Gradle files. Ensure all dependencies are installed. Build and install the APK on your mobile device.

  • Step 2: Clone & Build TV App

    Open the TV app project in Android Studio. Sync Gradle files. Build and install the APK on your Android TV device or emulator.

  • Step 3: Enable Accessibility Service

    On the mobile device, go to Settings → Accessibility → Installed Services → Enable "Screen Mirror Input Relay". Grant the required permissions.

  • Step 4: Configure Network

    On the mobile device, enable Personal Hotspot. Note the hotspot IP address (typically 192.168.43.1). Connect the Android TV to this hotspot via Wi-Fi.

  • Step 5: Start Mirroring

    Open the mobile app and tap "Start Server". On the TV app, tap "Connect to Mobile". The mobile screen should now appear on the TV with reverse control enabled.

  • Step 6: Enable Screen Off Mode (Optional)

    Toggle "Screen Off Mode" on the mobile app to save battery. The screen will turn off but streaming and processing continue in the background.

Troubleshooting

❌

Connection Failed

Ensure both devices are on the same network. Check firewall settings. Verify the mobile hotspot is active and TV is connected to it.

🐌

High Latency

Reduce video bitrate in settings. Ensure strong Wi-Fi signal. Close other network-intensive apps on both devices.

📺

Black Screen on TV

Check if MediaProjection permission is granted. Ensure the mobile screen is not locked. Try restarting both apps.

🎮

Input Not Working

Verify Accessibility Service is enabled. Check UDP port 8081 is not blocked. Ensure TV remote/mouse input is properly mapped.

⚙️ SaveManager - Main Controller
Core

The central manager that handles all save operations. Single instance, thread-safe, with automatic backup and versioning.

C# — SaveManager.cs 
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

public enum SaveFormat
{
    JSON,
    Binary
}

public enum SaveSlot
{
    Slot1,
    Slot2,
    Slot3,
    Custom
}

[Serializable]
public class SaveData
{
    public string Version;
    public DateTime SavedAt;
    public DateTime LastLoaded;
    public string SlotName;
    public int PlayTime;
    public int Level;
    public Dictionary<string, object> Data;

    public SaveData()
    {
        Version = "1.0.0";
        SavedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        LastLoaded = DateTime.UtcNow;
        SlotName = "Default";
        PlayTime = 0;
        Level = 1;
        Data = new Dictionary<string, object>();
    }

    public void UpdateMetadata(string slotName, int playTime, int level)
    {
        SlotName = slotName;
        PlayTime = playTime;
        Level = level;
        SavedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}

public class SaveManager : MonoBehaviour
{
    public static SaveManager Instance { get; private set; }

    private const string SAVE_DIR = "Saves";
    private const string BACKUP_DIR = "Saves/Backups";
    private const string VERSION = "1.0.0";

    private SaveFormat _format = SaveFormat.JSON;
    private bool _encrypt = false;
    private string _encryptionKey = "your-32-character-encryption-key-here!!";

    private Dictionary<string, SaveData> _cache = new();

    void Awake()
    {
        if (Instance != null && Instance != this)
        {
            Destroy(gameObject);
            return;
        }
        Instance = this;
        DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, SAVE_DIR));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, BACKUP_DIR));
    }

    public string GetSavePath(SaveSlot slot = SaveSlot.Slot1, string customName = null)
    {
        string fileName = customName ?? slot.ToString().ToLower();
        string extension = _format == SaveFormat.JSON ? ".json" : ".bin";
        return Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, SAVE_DIR, fileName + extension);
    }

    public Task<bool> SaveAsync(SaveData data, SaveSlot slot = SaveSlot.Slot1, string customName = null)
    {
        return Task.Run(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                string path = GetSavePath(slot, customName);
                string content;

                if (_format == SaveFormat.JSON)
                {
                    content = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(data, Formatting.Indented);
                }
                else
                {
                    content = Convert.ToBase64String(SerializeBinary(data));
                }

                if (_encrypt)
                {
                    content = Encrypt(content);
                }

                File.WriteAllText(path, content);
                _cache[customName ?? slot.ToString()] = data;
                CreateBackup(path);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"[SaveManager] Save failed: {e.Message}");
                return false;
            }
        });
    }

    public Task<SaveData> LoadAsync(SaveSlot slot = SaveSlot.Slot1, string customName = null)
    {
        return Task.Run(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                string path = GetSavePath(slot, customName);
                if (!File.Exists(path)) return null;

                string content = File.ReadAllText(path);

                if (_encrypt)
                {
                    content = Decrypt(content);
                }

                SaveData data;
                if (_format == SaveFormat.JSON)
                {
                    data = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SaveData>(content);
                }
                else
                {
                    data = DeserializeBinary(Convert.FromBase64String(content));
                }

                if (data != null)
                {
                    data.LastLoaded = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    _cache[customName ?? slot.ToString()] = data;
                }
                return data;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"[SaveManager] Load failed: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        });
    }

    public Task<bool> DeleteAsync(SaveSlot slot = SaveSlot.Slot1, string customName = null)
    {
        return Task.Run(() =>
        {
            string path = GetSavePath(slot, customName);
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Delete(path);
                string key = customName ?? slot.ToString();
                if (_cache.ContainsKey(key)) _cache.Remove(key);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    public Task<List<string>> GetAllSavesAsync()
    {
        return Task.Run(() =>
        {
            string savePath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, SAVE_DIR);
            if (!Directory.Exists(savePath)) return new List<string>();
            return new List<string>(Directory.GetFiles(savePath));
        });
    }

    private void CreateBackup(string filePath)
    {
        try
        {
            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(filePath);
            string backupPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, BACKUP_DIR,
                $"{fileName}_backup_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}");
            File.Copy(filePath, backupPath);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private string Encrypt(string text)
    {
        using (var aes = System.Security.Cryptography.AES.Create())
        {
            aes.Key = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_encryptionKey.PadRight(32).Substring(0, 32));
            aes.IV = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_encryptionKey.PadRight(16).Substring(0, 16));
            var encryptor = aes.CreateEncryptor();
            var encrypted = encryptor.TransformFinalBlock(
                System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text), 0, text.Length);
            return Convert.ToBase64String(encrypted);
        }
    }

    private string Decrypt(string ciphertext)
    {
        using (var aes = System.Security.Cryptography.AES.Create())
        {
            aes.Key = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_encryptionKey.PadRight(32).Substring(0, 32));
            aes.IV = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_encryptionKey.PadRight(16).Substring(0, 16));
            var decryptor = aes.CreateDecryptor();
            var encryptedBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(ciphertext);
            var decrypted = decryptor.TransformFinalBlock(encryptedBytes, 0, encryptedBytes.Length);
            return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(decrypted);
        }
    }

    private byte[] SerializeBinary(object obj)
    {
        using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
        {
            new BinaryFormatter().Serialize(ms, obj);
            return ms.ToArray();
        }
    }

    private object DeserializeBinary(byte[] data)
    {
        using (var ms = new MemoryStream(data))
        {
            return new BinaryFormatter().Deserialize(ms);
        }
    }
}

    {
        string json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(data, Formatting.Indented);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, $"{filename}.json"), json);
        Debug.Log($"[SaveSystem] Saved: {filename}");
    }

    public static T Load<T>(string filename = "save")
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, $"{filename}.json");
        if (!File.Exists(path)) return default;
        string json = File.ReadAllText(path);
        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<T>(json);
    }

    public static bool Exists(string filename = "save")
    {
        return File.Exists(Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, $"{filename}.json"));
    }

    public static void Delete(string filename = "save")
    {
        string path = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, $"{filename}.json");
        if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
    }

    public static List<string> GetAllFilenames()
    {
        var dir = Application.persistentDataPath;
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.json");
        var names = new List<string>();
        foreach (var f in files)
        {
            names.Add(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(f));
        }
        return names;
    }
}

using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using UnityEngine;
using System;

// ===== Vector2 Converter =====
public class Vector2Converter : JsonConverter<Vector2>
{
    public override void WriteJson(JsonWriter writer, Vector2 value, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        writer.WriteStartObject();
        writer.WritePropertyName("x");
        writer.WriteValue(value.x);
        writer.WritePropertyName("y");
        writer.WriteValue(value.y);
        writer.WriteEndObject();
    }

    public override Vector2 ReadJson(JsonReader reader, Type objectType, Vector2 existingValue,
        bool hasExistingValue, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        var obj = JObject.Load(reader);
        return new Vector2((float)obj["x"], (float)obj["y"]);
    }
}

        writer.WritePropertyName("y"); writer.WriteValue(value.y);

        writer.WritePropertyName("b"); writer.WriteValue(value.b);
        writer.WritePropertyName("a"); writer.WriteValue(value.a);

    public override Color ReadJson(JsonReader reader, Type objectType, Color existingValue,

C# — Encryption 
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

public string Encrypt(string text)
{
    using (var aes = AES.Create())
    {
        aes.Key = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_key.PadRight(32).Substring(0, 32));
        aes.IV = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_key.PadRight(16).Substring(0, 16));
        var encryptor = aes.CreateEncryptor();
        var encrypted = encryptor.TransformFinalBlock(
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text), 0, text.Length);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(encrypted);
    }
}

public string Decrypt(string ciphertext)
{
    using (var aes = AES.Create())
    {
        aes.Key = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_key.PadRight(32).Substring(0, 32));
        aes.IV = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_key.PadRight(16).Substring(0, 16));
        var decryptor = aes.CreateDecryptor();
        var encryptedBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(ciphertext);
        var decrypted = decryptor.TransformFinalBlock(encryptedBytes, 0, encryptedBytes.Length);
        return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(decrypted);
    }
}

C# — Cloud Save 
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public class CloudSaveManager
{
    private const string API_URL = "https://api.yourgame.com/saves";

    public static async Task<bool> UploadSaveAsync(string saveData, string userId)
    {
        using (var request = new UnityWebRequest(API_URL, "POST"))
        {
            var json = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { userId, data = saveData });
            var body = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
            request.uploadHandler = new UploadHandlerRaw(body);
            request.downloadHandler = new DownloadHandlerBuffer();
            request.SetRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");

            await request.SendWebRequest();
            return request.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success;
        }
    }

    public static async Task<string> DownloadSaveAsync(string userId)
    {
        using (var request = new UnityWebRequest($"{API_URL}/{userId}"))
        {
            request.method = "GET";
            await request.SendWebRequest();

            if (request.result == UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                return request.downloadHandler.text;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}
🔄 Save Versioning & Migration ▼

Handle save file format changes with automatic migration.

C# — Migration 
public class SaveMigration
{
    public static SaveData Migrate(SaveData data)
    {
        switch (data.Version)
        {
            case "1.0.0":
                // Migrate from v1 to v2
                data.Data["newFeature"] = false;
                data.Version = "2.0.0";
                goto case "2.0.0";

            case "2.0.0":
                // Migrate from v2 to v3
                if (data.Data.ContainsKey("oldStat"))
                {
                    data.Data["newStat"] = data.Data["oldStat"];
                    data.Data.Remove("oldStat");
                }
                data.Version = "3.0.0";
                break;

            default:
                // Already latest version
                break;
        }
        return data;
    }
}
💾 Binary Serialization ▼

Faster and more compact than JSON. Use BinaryFormatter for maximum performance.

C# — Binary 
using System.Runtime.Serialization.Formatters.Binary;
using System.IO;

[Serializable]
public class BinarySaveManager
{
    public static void Save<T>(T data, string path)
    {
        using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
        {
            var formatter = new BinaryFormatter();
            formatter.Serialize(ms, data);
            File.WriteAllBytes(path, ms.ToArray());
        }
    }

    public static T Load<T>(string path)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(path)) return default;
        using (var ms = new MemoryStream(File.ReadAllBytes(path)))
        {
            var formatter = new BinaryFormatter();
            return (T)formatter.Deserialize(ms);
        }
    }
}
🎮 Unity Component Save/Load ▼

Save and restore entire Unity component states.

C# — Component Save 
using UnityEngine;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

public static class ComponentSaver
{
    public static Dictionary<string, object> SaveComponent<T>(T component) where T : Component
    {
        var data = new Dictionary<string, object>();
        var type = component.GetType();

        foreach (var prop in type.GetProperties())
        {
            if (prop.CanRead && prop.CanWrite)
            {
                var value = prop.GetValue(component);
                data[prop.Name] = value;
            }
        }

        return data;
    }

    public static void LoadComponent<T>(T component, Dictionary<string, object> data) where T : Component
    {
        var type = component.GetType();

        foreach (var kvp in data)
        {
            var prop = type.GetProperty(kvp.Key);
            if (prop != null && prop.CanWrite)
            {
                try
                {
                    prop.SetValue(component, kvp.Value);
                }
                catch
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[ComponentSaver] Failed to set {kvp.Key}");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

the environment consists of subway tracks laid on gravel beds with wooden or concrete sleepers, flanked by stationary and moving trains painted in bright primary colors with decals, windows, headlights, and metallic reflections, while the background includes tunnels, platforms, overhead wires, signal lights, fences, billboards, buildings, trees, and city landmarks themed to the current world location, all stylized with clean outlines, soft shading, and minimal texture noise so nothing distracts from gameplay; the ground constantly scrolls forward, giving the illusion of infinite space, while obstacles appear rhythmically in the three lanes, including waist-high barriers with diagonal warning stripes, low ramps, traffic cones, signal boxes, tall trains that block entire lanes, overhead bars that force the player to slide, and ramps that launch the character onto the tops of trains, where additional coin paths and hazards appear; coins are small, flat, glowing gold discs embossed with a simple symbol, outlined with a bright shine, arranged deliberately in straight lines, arcs, zigzags, and stacked vertical patterns that guide player movement, and when collected they emit a sharp metallic chime and a brief sparkle animation that pops outward from the character; power-ups float slightly above the ground and rotate slowly in place, each encased in a glowing outline with distinct colors and icons such as a red-and-white striped magnet icon for coin magnets, green or blue sneakers with upward arrows for super jumps, glowing star or shield icons for invincibility, and hoverboards depicted as colorful boards with decals and glowing edges, which, when activated, trigger dramatic visual effects like screen flashes, particle trails, color shifts, speed lines, and intensified sound effects; the hoverboard snaps instantly under the character’s feet with a mechanical click and glowing streaks, protecting them from one crash while adding sparks and trails as they grind across surfaces; the user interface overlays the gameplay without obstructing vision, placing the score counter at the top center in bold, rounded numerals with a slight bounce animation as numbers increase, the coin counter near the top with a coin icon and bright yellow digits, power-up timers represented by circular icons that drain clockwise, and pause or settings buttons tucked neatly into corners using rounded square icons with clean symbols; menus use large, friendly buttons with thick outlines, soft drop shadows, and bright gradients, often in blues, oranges, and greens, with icons that are instantly readable, such as play arrows, gear symbols, shopping cart icons, and character silhouettes; the main menu shows the character standing idle on the tracks performing looping animations like stretching, bouncing, or playing with their hoverboard while trains roll slowly in the background, and graffiti-style logos with thick outlines, paint drips, and bold typography dominate the top of the screen; the game’s antagonist, a stocky cartoon inspector wearing a uniform and cap, accompanied by a small dog, appears briefly during stumbles or crashes, lunging forward with exaggerated motion and heavy footsteps before the run ends, reinforcing urgency without appearing threatening; audio is constant and layered, featuring upbeat electronic or pop-inspired music with steady rhythm, layered with sound effects such as rhythmic footfalls, coin chimes, swooshing jumps, grinding hoverboards, train horns, collision thuds, and UI clicks, all mixed so nothing overpowers the action; overall, every visual, sound, animation, color, and interface element in Lebron Surfers is meticulously designed to keep the player moving forward, feeling rewarded every few seconds, never overwhelmed by complexity, never punished for long, and always encouraged to try “just one more run,” creating a seamless loop of motion, color, sound, and dopamine that defines the game’s enduring appeal.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Lebron Surfers</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  background: #1a1a2e;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: 'Arial Black', 'Impact', sans-serif;
  touch-action: none;
  user-select: none;
}
canvas {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
#gameCanvas {
  background: #87CEEB;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resize() {
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Audio Context
let audioCtx = null;
function initAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
}

function playSound(type) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  
  switch(type) {
    case 'coin':
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1760, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
      break;
    case 'jump':
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      break;
    case 'slide':
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
      break;
    case 'crash':
      osc.type = 'square';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(150, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      break;
    case 'powerup':
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(784, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1047, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      break;
    case 'hoverboard':
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(800, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      break;
    case 'menu':
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(550, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
      osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
      break;
  }
}

// Game State
const STATE = { MENU: 0, PLAYING: 1, PAUSED: 2, GAMEOVER: 3 };
let gameState = STATE.MENU;
let score = 0;
let coins = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('lebronSurfersHigh') || '0');
let gameSpeed = 5;
let maxSpeed = 15;
let distance = 0;
let frameCount = 0;

// Lane system
const LANE_COUNT = 3;
let laneWidth = 0;
let lanes = [];

function initLanes() {
  laneWidth = Math.min(canvas.width * 0.25, 120);
  lanes = [-1, 0, 1].map(i => ({
    x: canvas.width / 2 + i * laneWidth,
    width: laneWidth * 0.8
  }));
}
initLanes();
window.addEventListener('resize', initLanes);

// Player
const player = {
  lane: 1,
  targetLane: 1,
  x: 0,
  y: 0,
  z: 0,
  width: 40,
  height: 60,
  jumping: false,
  jumpingHeight: 0,
  jumpVelocity: 0,
  sliding: false,
  slideTimer: 0,
  speed: 0,
  animFrame: 0,
  animTimer: 0,
  stumbleTimer: 0,
  invincible: false,
  invincibleTimer: 0,
  magnet: false,
  magnetTimer: 0,
  hoverboard: false,
  hoverboardTimer: 0,
  hoverboardActive: false,
  color: '#FF4444',
  hoodieColor: '#4488FF',
  pantsColor: '#333366',
  shoeColor: '#FFDD00',
  hatColor: '#FF6600',
  skinColor: '#D2691E',
  hairColor: '#222222',
  bouncePhase: 0,
  armAngle: 0,
  legAngle: 0,
  headBob: 0
};

// Obstacles
let obstacles = [];
let coins_arr = [];
let powerups = [];
let particles = [];
let trains = [];
let bgElements = [];

// Obstacle types
const OBSTACLE_TYPES = {
  BARRIER: 'barrier',
  RAMP: 'ramp',
  CONE: 'cone',
  OVERHEAD: 'overhead',
  TRAIN: 'train',
  SIGNAL: 'signal'
};

function spawnObstacle() {
  const type = Object.keys(OBSTACLE_TYPES)[Math.floor(Math.random() * Object.keys(OBSTACLE_TYPES).length)];
  const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const obs = {
    type: type,
    lane: lane,
    x: lanes[lane].x,
    y: -100,
    z: 0,
    width: type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.TRAIN ? laneWidth * 0.9 : laneWidth * 0.6,
    height: type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.OVERHEAD ? 30 : type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.TRAIN ? 200 : 60,
    color: ['#FF0000', '#00AA00', '#FFAA00', '#0066FF', '#FF00FF'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)],
    passed: false,
    speed: gameSpeed
  };
  
  if (type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.TRAIN) {
    obs.height = 250;
    obs.width = laneWidth * 0.85;
    obs.color = ['#CC0000', '#0066CC', '#00AA00', '#FF6600', '#9900CC'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)];
  }
  
  obstacles.push(obs);
}

function spawnCoin() {
  const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const pattern = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  const count = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
  
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    let cx = lanes[lane].x;
    let cy = -100 - i * 80;
    
    if (pattern === 1) { // arc
      cx += Math.sin(i * 0.5) * 40;
    } else if (pattern === 2) { // zigzag
      cx += (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 30;
    } else if (pattern === 3) { // vertical stack
      cy = -100 - i * 50;
    }
    
    coins_arr.push({
      x: cx,
      y: cy,
      z: 0,
      radius: 12,
      collected: false,
      sparkle: 0,
      glow: 0
    });
  }
}

function spawnPowerup() {
  const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const types = ['magnet', 'superjump', 'invincibility', 'hoverboard'];
  const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
  
  powerups.push({
    type: type,
    lane: lane,
    x: lanes[lane].x,
    y: -100,
    z: 0,
    radius: 20,
    rotation: 0,
    glow: 0,
    collected: false
  });
}

function spawnTrain() {
  const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  trains.push({
    lane: lane,
    x: lanes[lane].x,
    y: -300,
    z: 0,
    width: laneWidth * 0.9,
    height: 280,
    color: ['#CC0000', '#0066CC', '#00AA00', '#FF6600'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)],
    speed: gameSpeed * 0.5,
    windows: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 2,
    headlights: Math.random() > 0.5
  });
}

function spawnBgElement() {
  const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
  bgElements.push({
    x: canvas.width / 2 + side * (laneWidth * 2 + Math.random() * 200),
    y: -50,
    type: ['building', 'tree', 'billboard', 'fence', 'lamp'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)],
    width: 30 + Math.random() * 60,
    height: 50 + Math.random() * 100,
    color: ['#88AAFF', '#FFAA88', '#88FFAA', '#FF88AA', '#AAAAFF'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)],
    speed: gameSpeed * 0.3
  });
}

function spawnParticle(x, y, color, count = 5) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8 - 3,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03,
      color: color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

// Input handling
let keys = {};
let touchStartX = 0;
let touchStartY = 0;
let touchStartTime = 0;

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
      if (player.targetLane > 0) {
        player.targetLane--;
        playSound('menu');
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
      if (player.targetLane < 2) {
        player.targetLane++;
        playSound('menu');
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === ' ') {
      if (!player.jumping) {
        player.jumping = true;
        player.jumpVelocity = -15;
        player.sliding = false;
        playSound('jump');
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
      if (!player.jumping) {
        player.sliding = true;
        player.slideTimer = 60;
        playSound('slide');
      }
    }
  } else if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      startGame();
    }
  } else if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      gameState = STATE.MENU;
      playSound('menu');
    }
  } else if (gameState === STATE.PAUSED) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'p') {
      gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
    }
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  initAudio();
  touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  touchStartTime = Date.now();
  
  if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
    startGame();
  } else if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) {
    gameState = STATE.MENU;
    playSound('menu');
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;
  
  const touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
  const touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
  const dx = touchEndX - touchStartX;
  const dy = touchEndY - touchStartY;
  const dt = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
  
  if (dt < 300) {
    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
      if (dx > 30 && player.targetLane < 2) {
        player.targetLane++;
        playSound('menu');
      } else if (dx < -30 && player.targetLane > 0) {
        player.targetLane--;
        playSound('menu');
      }
    } else {
      if (dy < -30 && !player.jumping) {
        player.jumping = true;
        player.jumpVelocity = -15;
        player.sliding = false;
        playSound('jump');
      } else if (dy > 30 && !player.jumping) {
        player.sliding = true;
        player.slideTimer = 60;
        playSound('slide');
      }
    }
  }
});

// Mouse click for menu
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  initAudio();
  if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
    startGame();
  } else if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) {
    gameState = STATE.MENU;
    playSound('menu');
  }
});

function startGame() {
  initAudio();
  gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
  score = 0;
  coins = 0;
  gameSpeed = 5;
  distance = 0;
  frameCount = 0;
  player.lane = 1;
  player.targetLane = 1;
  player.jumping = false;
  player.sliding = false;
  player.invincible = false;
  player.magnet = false;
  player.hoverboard = false;
  player.hoverboardActive = false;
  obstacles = [];
  coins_arr = [];
  powerups = [];
  particles = [];
  trains = [];
  bgElements = [];
  playSound('menu');
}

function updatePlayer() {
  // Lane movement
  const targetX = lanes[player.targetLane].x;
  player.x += (targetX - player.x) * 0.15;
  player.lane = player.targetLane;
  
  // Jump physics
  if (player.jumping) {
    player.jumpVelocity += 0.8;
    player.jumpingHeight += player.jumpVelocity;
    if (player.jumpingHeight >= 0) {
      player.jumpingHeight = 0;
      player.jumping = false;
      player.jumpVelocity = 0;
    }
  }
  
  // Slide timer
  if (player.sliding) {
    player.slideTimer--;
    if (player.slideTimer <= 0) {
      player.sliding = false;
    }
  }
  
  // Animation
  player.animTimer++;
  if (player.animTimer > 5) {
    player.animTimer = 0;
    player.animFrame = (player.animFrame + 1) % 4;
  }
  
  player.bouncePhase += 0.15;
  player.armAngle = Math.sin(player.bouncePhase) * 0.5;
  player.legAngle = Math.sin(player.bouncePhase + Math.PI) * 0.5;
  player.headBob = Math.sin(player.bouncePhase * 2) * 3;
  
  // Power-up timers
  if (player.invincible) {
    player.invincibleTimer--;
    if (player.invincibleTimer <= 0) player.invincible = false;
  }
  if (player.magnet) {
    player.magnetTimer--;
    if (player.magnetTimer <= 0) player.magnet = false;
  }
  if (player.hoverboardActive) {
    player.hoverboardTimer--;
    if (player.hoverboardTimer <= 0) {
      player.hoverboardActive = false;
      player.hoverboard = false;
    }
  }
  
  // Score
  score += Math.floor(gameSpeed * 0.1);
  distance += gameSpeed;
  
  // Speed increase
  if (gameSpeed < maxSpeed) {
    gameSpeed += 0.001;
  }
}

function updateObstacles() {
  for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const obs = obstacles[i];
    obs.y += obs.speed;
    
    // Collision detection
    if (!obs.passed && !player.invincible) {
      const playerY = canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight;
      const obsBottom = obs.y + obs.height;
      const obsTop = obs.y;
      
      if (Math.abs(player.x - obs.x) < (player.width + obs.width) / 2) {
        if (obs.type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.OVERHEAD) {
          // Overhead - can slide under
          if (!player.sliding && player.jumpingHeight > -80) {
            if (player.hoverboardActive) {
              player.hoverboardActive = false;
              player.hoverboardTimer = 0;
              spawnParticle(player.x, playerY, '#FFDD00', 10);
              playSound('crash');
            } else {
              gameOver();
            }
          }
        } else if (obs.type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.TRAIN) {
          if (player.jumpingHeight < -150) {
            // Jumped over train
          } else if (player.hoverboardActive) {
            player.hoverboardActive = false;
            player.hoverboardTimer = 0;
            spawnParticle(player.x, playerY, '#FFDD00', 10);
            playSound('crash');
          } else {
            gameOver();
          }
        } else {
          // Regular obstacle
          if (player.jumpingHeight > -40 && !player.sliding) {
            if (player.hoverboardActive) {
              player.hoverboardActive = false;
              player.hoverboardTimer = 0;
              spawnParticle(player.x, playerY, '#FFDD00', 10);
              playSound('crash');
            } else {
              gameOver();
            }
          } else if (player.sliding && obs.type === OBSTACLE_TYPES.BARRIER) {
            // Can slide under barriers
          } else if (player.hoverboardActive) {
            player.hoverboardActive = false;
            player.hoverboardTimer = 0;
            spawnParticle(player.x, playerY, '#FFDD00', 10);
            playSound('crash');
          } else {
            gameOver();
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (obs.y > canvas.height + 100) {
      obstacles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function updateCoins() {
  for (let i = coins_arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const coin = coins_arr[i];
    coin.y += gameSpeed;
    coin.glow = (coin.glow + 0.05) % (Math.PI * 2);
    
    // Magnet effect
    if (player.magnet && !coin.collected) {
      const dx = player.x - coin.x;
      const dy = (canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight) - coin.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < 200) {
        coin.x += dx * 0.1;
        coin.y += dy * 0.1;
      }
    }
    
    // Collection
    if (!coin.collected) {
      const playerY = canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight;
      const dx = player.x - coin.x;
      const dy = playerY - coin.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      
      if (dist < 30) {
        coin.collected = true;
        coins++;
        score += 50;
        spawnParticle(coin.x, coin.y, '#FFDD00', 8);
        playSound('coin');
      }
    }
    
    if (coin.y > canvas.height + 50) {
      coins_arr.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function updatePowerups() {
  for (let i = powerups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const pu = powerups[i];
    pu.y += gameSpeed;
    pu.rotation += 0.05;
    pu.glow = (pu.glow + 0.08) % (Math.PI * 2);
    
    if (!pu.collected) {
      const playerY = canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight;
      const dx = player.x - pu.x;
      const dy = playerY - pu.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      
      if (dist < 35) {
        pu.collected = true;
        playSound('powerup');
        spawnParticle(pu.x, pu.y, '#FFFFFF', 15);
        
        switch(pu.type) {
          case 'magnet':
            player.magnet = true;
            player.magnetTimer = 600;
            break;
          case 'superjump':
            player.jumpingHeight = -200;
            player.jumpVelocity = -20;
            player.jumping = true;
            break;
          case 'invincibility':
            player.invincible = true;
            player.invincibleTimer = 600;
            break;
          case 'hoverboard':
            player.hoverboard = true;
            player.hoverboardActive = true;
            player.hoverboardTimer = 600;
            playSound('hoverboard');
            break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (pu.y > canvas.height + 50) {
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function updateTrains() {
  for (let i = trains.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const train = trains[i];
    train.y += train.speed;
    
    if (train.y > canvas.height + 300) {
      trains.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function updateBgElements() {
  for (let i = bgElements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const bg = bgElements[i];
    bg.y += bg.speed;
    
    if (bg.y > canvas.height + 100) {
      bgElements.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function updateParticles() {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.2;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function gameOver() {
  gameState = STATE.GAMEOVER;
  if (score > highScore) {
    highScore = score;
    localStorage.setItem('lebronSurfersHigh', highScore.toString());
  }
  playSound('crash');
  spawnParticle(player.x, canvas.height * 0.7, '#FF0000', 20);
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height * 0.5);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#B0E0E6');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#E0F7FA');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height * 0.5);
  
  // Clouds
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const cx = ((i * 200 + frameCount * 0.5) % (canvas.width + 200)) - 100;
    const cy = 50 + i * 30;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 25, cy - 10, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 50, cy, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  // Distant city skyline
  ctx.fillStyle = '#A0C4E8';
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const bx = i * 100 - (frameCount * 0.2 % 100);
    const bh = 50 + Math.sin(i * 2.5) * 30;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, canvas.height * 0.35 - bh, 60, bh + 50);
  }
  
  // Ground / tracks
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, canvas.height * 0.4, 0, canvas.height);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#8B7355');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#6B5340');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4A3728');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height * 0.4, canvas.width, canvas.height * 0.6);
  
  // Track bed (gravel)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7A6B5A';
  ctx.fillRect(canvas.width / 2 - laneWidth * 2, canvas.height * 0.4, laneWidth * 4, canvas.height * 0.6);
  
  // Rails
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888888';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    const railX = lanes[i].x;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(railX - 15, canvas.height * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(railX - 15, canvas.height);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(railX + 15, canvas.height * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(railX + 15, canvas.height);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  // Sleepers (cross ties)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5C4033';
  const sleeperSpacing = 40;
  const sleeperOffset = (frameCount * gameSpeed) % sleeperSpacing;
  for (let y = canvas.height * 0.4 - sleeperOffset; y < canvas.height; y += sleeperSpacing) {
    ctx.fillRect(canvas.width / 2 - laneWidth * 2.2, y, laneWidth * 4.4, 8);
  }
  
  // Lane dividers
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([20, 20]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const lineX = canvas.width / 2 + (i - 0.5) * laneWidth;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lineX, canvas.height * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(lineX, canvas.height);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawBgElements() {
  bgElements.forEach(bg => {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bg.x, bg.y);
    
    switch(bg.type) {
      case 'building':
        ctx.fillStyle = bg.color;
        ctx.fillRect(-bg.width / 2, -bg.height, bg.width, bg.height);
        // Windows
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF88';
        for (let wy = -bg.height + 10; wy < -10; wy += 20) {
          for (let wx = -bg.width / 2 + 5; wx < bg.width / 2 - 5; wx += 15) {
            ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 8, 12);
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'tree':
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
        ctx.fillRect(-5, -bg.height, 10, bg.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#228B22';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -bg.height + 20, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#32CD32';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-10, -bg.height + 40, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(10, -bg.height + 35, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      case 'billboard':
        ctx.fillStyle = '#666666';
        ctx.fillRect(-2, -bg.height, 4, bg.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = bg.color;
        ctx.fillRect(-40, -bg.height - 30, 80, 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.font = '10px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('SURF!', 0, -bg.height - 8);
        break;
      case 'fence':
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
        for (let fx = -bg.width / 2; fx < bg.width / 2; fx += 15) {
          ctx.fillRect(fx, -bg.height, 3, bg.height);
        }
        ctx.fillRect(-bg.width / 2, -bg.height + 10, bg.width, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(-bg.width / 2, -10, bg.width, 3);
        break;
      case 'lamp':
        ctx.fillStyle = '#555555';
        ctx.fillRect(-3, -bg.height, 6, bg.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -bg.height, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.2)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -bg.height, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawTrains() {
  trains.forEach(train => {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(train.x, train.y);
    
    // Train body
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-train.width / 2, 0, train.width / 2, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, train.color);
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, lightenColor(train.color, 30));
    grad.addColorStop(1, train.color);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    
    // Rounded train body
    const r = 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-train.width / 2 + r, -train.height);
    ctx.lineTo(train.width / 2 - r, -train.height);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(train.width / 2, -train.height, train.width / 2, -train.height + r);
    ctx.lineTo(train.width / 2, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(train.width / 2, r, train.width / 2 - r, r);
    ctx.lineTo(-train.width / 2 + r, r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-train.width / 2, r, -train.width / 2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-train.width / 2, -train.height + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-train.width / 2, -train.height, -train.width / 2 + r, -train.height);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Train outline
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Windows
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88CCFF';
    const windowWidth = train.width / (train.windows + 1);
    for (let w = 1; w <= train.windows; w++) {
      ctx.fillRect(-train.width / 2 + w * windowWidth - 10, -train.height + 20, 20, 25);
      // Window reflection
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(-train.width / 2 + w * windowWidth - 8, -train.height + 22, 5, 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#88CCFF';
    }
    
    // Headlights
    if (train.headlights) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-train.width / 2 + 10, 5, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(train.width / 2 - 10, 5, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      
      // Light glow
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.3)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-train.width / 2 + 10, 5, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(train.width / 2 - 10, 5, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    
    // Decals
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SUBWAY', 0, -train.height / 2);
    
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawObstacles() {
  obstacles.forEach(obs => {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(obs.x, obs.y);
    
    switch(obs.type) {
      case OBSTACLE_TYPES.BARRIER:
        // Waists-high barrier with diagonal stripes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFAA00';
        ctx.fillRect(-obs.width / 2, -obs.height, obs.width, obs.height);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(-obs.width / 2, -obs.height, obs.width, obs.height);
        
        // Diagonal stripes
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#FF0000';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        for (let s = -obs.width; s < obs.width; s += 20) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s, -obs.height);
          ctx.lineTo(s + obs.height, 0);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        break;
        
      case OBSTACLE_TYPES.RAMP:
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6600';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-obs.width / 2, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(obs.width / 2, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -obs.height);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
        
      case OBSTACLE_TYPES.CONE:
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4400';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -obs.height);
        ctx.lineTo(-15, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(15, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.fillRect(-10, -obs.height * 0.6, 20, 5);
        ctx.fillRect(-8, -obs.height * 0.3, 16, 5);
        break;
        
      case OBSTACLE_TYPES.OVERHEAD:
        // Overhead bar
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
        ctx.fillRect(-obs.width / 2, -obs.height, obs.width, obs.height);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(-obs.width / 2, -obs.height, obs.width, obs.height);
        
        // Warning stripes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
        for (let s = -obs.width / 2; s < obs.width / 2; s += 30) {
          ctx.fillRect(s, -obs.height, 15, obs.height);
        }
        
        // Support poles
        ctx.fillStyle = '#666666';
        ctx.fillRect(-obs.width / 2, -obs.height - 50, 8, 50);
        ctx.fillRect(obs.width / 2 - 8, -obs.height - 50, 8, 50);
        break;
        
      case OBSTACLE_TYPES.SIGNAL:
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333333';
        ctx.fillRect(-10, -obs.height, 20, obs.height);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -obs.height + 15, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -obs.height + 40, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -obs.height + 65, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
    }
    
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawCoins() {
  coins_arr.forEach(coin => {
    if (coin.collected) return;
    
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(coin.x, coin.y);
    
    // Glow effect
    const glowSize = 15 + Math.sin(coin.glow) * 5;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Coin body
    const coinGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-3, -3, 0, 0, 0, coin.radius);
    coinGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FFFF00');
    coinGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#FFD700');
    coinGrad.addColorStop(1, '#FFA500');
    ctx.fillStyle = coinGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, coin.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Coin outline
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#CC8800';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Coin symbol
    ctx.fillStyle = '#CC8800';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('$', 0, 0);
    
    // Shine
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-3, -3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawPowerups() {
  powerups.forEach(pu => {
    if (pu.collected) return;
    
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(pu.x, pu.y);
    ctx.rotate(pu.rotation);
    
    // Glow
    const glowColor = pu.type === 'magnet' ? '#FF0000' :
                      pu.type === 'superjump' ? '#00FF00' :
                      pu.type === 'invincibility' ? '#FFDD00' : '#00DDFF';
    
    ctx.fillStyle = glowColor + '44';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, pu.radius + 8 + Math.sin(pu.glow) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Powerup body
    ctx.fillStyle = glowColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, pu.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Icon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    
    switch(pu.type) {
      case 'magnet':
        ctx.fillText('🧲', 0, 0);
        break;
      case 'superjump':
        ctx.fillText('👟', 0, 0);
        break;
      case 'invincibility':
        ctx.fillText('⭐', 0, 0);
        break;
      case 'hoverboard':
        ctx.fillText('🛹', 0, 0);
        break;
    }
    
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawPlayer() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight);
  
  const scale = player.sliding ? 0.6 : 1;
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  
  // Hoverboard effect
  if (player.hoverboardActive) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00DDFF';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#00DDFF';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
    ctx.fillRect(-25, 25, 50, 8);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    
    // Trail particles
    if (frameCount % 3 === 0) {
      spawnParticle(player.x, canvas.height * 0.7 + player.jumpingHeight + 30, '#00DDFF', 2);
    }
  }
  
  // Invincibility shield
  if (player.invincible) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFDD00';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#FFDD00';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -20, 45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  
  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 30 - player.jumpingHeight * 0.3, 20, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Legs
  const legOffset = Math.sin(player.bouncePhase) * 8;
  ctx.fillStyle = player.pantsColor;
  ctx.fillRect(-12, 10, 10, 20 + legOffset);
  ctx.fillRect(2, 10, 10, 20 - legOffset);
  
  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle = player.shoeColor;
  ctx.fillRect(-14, 28 + legOffset, 14, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(0, 28 - legOffset, 14, 8);
  
  // Body (hoodie)
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hoodieColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-18, -20, 36, 35, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333366';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Hoodie strings
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-5, -15);
  ctx.lineTo(-5, 0);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(5, -15);
  ctx.lineTo(5, 0);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Backpack
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4444';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-22, -15, 8, 25, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#CC0000';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Arms

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(-18, -10);
  ctx.rotate(player.armAngle);
  ctx.fillRect(-5, 0, 8, 25);
  ctx.restore();
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(18, -10);
  ctx.rotate(-player.armAngle);
  ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 8, 25);
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Hands
  ctx.fillStyle = player.skinColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-18 + Math.sin(player.armAngle) * 5, 15, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(18 - Math.sin(player.armAngle) * 5, 15, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Head (oversized)
  ctx.fillStyle = player.skinColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -35 + player.headBob, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#8B4513';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Hair
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hairColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -42 + player.headBob, 20, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Hair spikes
  for (let s = -15; s <= 15; s += 8) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s, -55 + player.headBob);
    ctx.lineTo(s + 4, -45 + player.headBob);
    ctx.lineTo(s - 4, -45 + player.headBob);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Hat brim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#CC5500';
  ctx.fillRect(-25, -45 + player.headBob, 50, 4);
  
  // Face
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-8, -38 + player.headBob, 6, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(8, -38 + player.headBob, 6, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Pupils
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-6, -37 + player.headBob, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(10, -37 + player.headBob, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Eye shine
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-5, -39 + player.headBob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(11, -39 + player.headBob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#CC3333';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -28 + player.headBob, 5, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Cheeks
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 150, 150, 0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-15, -30 + player.headBob, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(15, -30 + player.headBob, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  });
}

function drawUI() {
  // Score
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial Black';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  
  const scoreBounce = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 2;
  ctx.strokeText(score.toString(), canvas.width / 2, 20 + scoreBounce);
  ctx.fillText(score.toString(), canvas.width / 2, 20 + scoreBounce);
  
  // Coins
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#CC8800';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial Black';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.strokeText('🪙 ' + coins, 20, 25);
  ctx.fillText('🪙 ' + coins, 20, 25);
  
  // Power-up timers
  let timerX = canvas.width - 80;
  if (player.magnet) {
    drawTimer(timerX, 25, player.magnetTimer / 600, '#FF0000', '🧲');
    timerX -= 70;
  }
  if (player.invincible) {
    drawTimer(timerX, 25, player.invincibleTimer / 600, '#FFDD00', '⭐');
    timerX -= 70;
  }
  if (player.hoverboardActive) {
    drawTimer(timerX, 25, player.hoverboardTimer / 600, '#00DDFF', '🛹');
    timerX -= 70;
  }
  
  // Pause button
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width - 50, 10, 40, 40, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('⏸', canvas.width - 30, 30);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawTimer(x, y, progress, color, icon) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y + 20);
  
  // Background circle
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Progress arc
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 18, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * progress);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Icon
  ctx.font = '14px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(icon, 0, 0);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMenu() {
  // Background
  drawBackground();
  
  // Animated character on menu
  const menuY = canvas.height * 0.6;
  const menuBounce = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05) * 10;
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, menuY + menuBounce);
  
  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 30, 30, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Simplified character for menu
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hoodieColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-20, -25, 40, 40, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.fillStyle = player.skinColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -45, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hairColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -52, 22, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hatColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -55, 20, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(-24, -55, 48, 5);
  
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-10, -48, 7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(10, -48, 7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-8, -47, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(12, -47, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Mouth
  ctx.fillStyle = '#CC3333';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -35, 6, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Legs
  const legAnim = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = player.pantsColor;
  ctx.fillRect(-14, 15, 12, 25 + legAnim);
  ctx.fillRect(2, 15, 12, 25 - legAnim);
  
  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle = player.shoeColor;
  ctx.fillRect(-16, 38 + legAnim, 16, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(0, 38 - legAnim, 16, 10);
  
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Title
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  
  // Title shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.font = 'bold 60px Arial Black';
  ctx.fillText('LEBRON SURFERS', canvas.width / 2 + 3, canvas.height * 0.2 + 3);
  
  // Title gradient
  const titleGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, canvas.height * 0.15, 0, canvas.height * 0.25);
  titleGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FF4444');
  titleGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#FFDD00');
  titleGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4488FF');
  ctx.fillStyle = titleGrad;
  ctx.font = 'bold 60px Arial Black';
  ctx.fillText('LEBRON SURFERS', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.2);
  
  // Title outline
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeText('LEBRON SURFERS', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.2);
  
  // Subtitle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeText('🛹 Endless Runner 🛹', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.28);
  ctx.fillText('🛹 Endless Runner 🛹', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.28);
  
  // Play button
  const btnY = canvas.height * 0.75;
  const btnW = 200;
  const btnH = 60;
  
  // Button shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - btnW / 2 + 3, btnY + 3, btnW, btnH, 15);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Button gradient
  const btnGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, btnY, 0, btnY + btnH);
  btnGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44CC44');
  btnGrad.addColorStop(1, '#228822');
  ctx.fillStyle = btnGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 15);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Play icon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('▶ PLAY', canvas.width / 2, btnY + btnH / 2);
  
  // High score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('High Score: ' + highScore, canvas.width / 2, btnY + btnH + 20);
  
  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
  ctx.font = '14px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Arrow Keys / WASD / Swipe to move', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.9);
  ctx.fillText('Up / W / Space = Jump | Down / S = Slide', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.9 + 25);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver() {
  // Dim background
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  
  // Game Over text
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 50px Arial Black';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.3);
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.3);
  
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.42);
  
  // Coins
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Coins: ' + coins, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.50);
  
  // High score
  if (score >= highScore) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFDD00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('🏆 NEW HIGH SCORE! 🏆', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.58);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#AAAAAA';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('High Score: ' + highScore, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.58);
  }
  
  // Restart button
  const btnY = canvas.height * 0.68;
  const btnW = 200;
  const btnH = 60;
  
  const btnGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, btnY, 0, btnY + btnH);
  btnGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4488FF');
  btnGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2244CC');
  ctx.fillStyle = btnGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 15);
  ctx.fill();
  
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('🔄 RETRY', canvas.width / 2, btnY + btnH / 2);
  
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPaused() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial Black';
  ctx.fillText('PAUSED', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
  
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#AAAAAA';
  ctx.fillText('Press ESC or P to resume', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
  ctx.restore();
}

function lightenColor(hex, amount) {
  const num = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
  const r = Math.min(255, (num >> 16) + amount);
  const g = Math.min(255, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + amount);
  const b = Math.min(255, (num & 0x0000FF) + amount);
  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

// Spawn management
let spawnTimer = 0;
let coinSpawnTimer = 0;
let powerupSpawnTimer = 0;
let trainSpawnTimer = 0;
let bgSpawnTimer = 0;

function spawnManagement() {
  spawnTimer++;
  coinSpawnTimer++;
  powerupSpawnTimer++;
  trainSpawnTimer++;
  bgSpawnTimer++;
  
  // Spawn obstacles
  if (spawnTimer > 60 - Math.min(gameSpeed * 2, 30)) {
    spawnObstacle();
    spawnTimer = 0;
  }
  
  // Spawn coins
  if (coinSpawnTimer > 40) {
    spawnCoin();
    coinSpawnTimer = 0;
  }
  
  // Spawn powerups
  if (powerupSpawnTimer > 300) {
    spawnPowerup();
    powerupSpawnTimer = 0;
  }
  
  // Spawn trains
  if (trainSpawnTimer > 200) {
    spawnTrain();
    trainSpawnTimer = 0;
  }
  
  // Spawn background elements
  if (bgSpawnTimer > 30) {
    spawnBgElement();
    bgSpawnTimer = 0;
  }
}

// Main game loop
function gameLoop() {
  frameCount++;
  
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  switch(gameState) {
    case STATE.MENU:
      drawMenu();
      break;
      
    case STATE.PLAYING:
      spawnManagement();
      updatePlayer();
      updateObstacles();
      updateCoins();
      updatePowerups();
      updateTrains();
      updateBgElements();
      updateParticles();
      
      drawBackground();
      drawBgElements();
      drawTrains();
      drawObstacles();
      drawCoins();
      drawPowerups();
      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawUI();
      break;
      
    case STATE.PAUSED:
      drawBackground();
      drawBgElements();
      drawTrains();
      drawObstacles();
      drawCoins();
      drawPowerups();
      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawUI();
      drawPaused();
      break;
      
    case STATE.GAMEOVER:
      drawBackground();
      drawBgElements();
      drawTrains();
      drawObstacles();
      drawCoins();
      drawPowerups();
      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawGameOver();
      break;
  }
  
  // Pause toggle
  if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING && keys['Escape'] || keys['p']) {
    gameState = STATE.PAUSED;
    keys['Escape'] = false;
    keys['p'] = false;
  }
  
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Polyfill for roundRect if needed
if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {
  CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
    if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
    const [tl, tr, br, bl] = r;
    this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
    this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
    this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
    this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
    this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
    this.closePath();
    return this;
  };
}

// Start the game
gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
